story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Hola

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Solo quería ponerme en contacto antes de que me ocupe de nuevo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes hoy, de verdad?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Aún estoy rígido, y es molesto no poder levantarme cuando quiero.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Pero te estás recuperando, y eso es lo que importa, incluso si se siente lento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: También necesitas dejar de culparte por todo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: No elegiste lastimarte, y no eres una carga por necesitar ayuda.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Estoy intentando

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Es difícil sentirse útil cuando estoy atrapado en la cama todo el día.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Hola

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sé

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Por cierto, ¿cómo se siente tu nuevo teléfono hasta ahora?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: ¿Todo parece haberse transferido correctamente desde el antiguo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sí, sorprendentemente

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Es rápido, y todo parece estar en su lugar.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Apenas tuve que rehacer mis configuraciones.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Bueno

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: El tipo que me lo vendió seguía insistiendo en que era un modelo sólido.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Gracias de nuevo por conseguirlo para mí.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sé que no tenías que hacerlo, pero realmente ayuda en este momento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: ¿Te desperté, o ya estabas entrando y saliendo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Por supuesto que ayuda

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Tú también mereces cosas bonitas, incluso si no siempre lo crees.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …Está bien

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: De hecho, hay una cosa que aún necesito para el nuevo teléfono.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Está pidiendo una foto de contacto limpia, y la que tenía es antigua.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Oh

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: ¿Quieres una nueva foto mía para tus contactos?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Está bien, dame un segundo

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 2 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ya estaba despierto, no te preocupes.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Un poco, pero está bien, me alegra que me hayas escrito.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Allí

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Si ese se ve terrible, no se te permite quejarte.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Es perfecto

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Spanish.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Intenta descansar

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Te traeré algo de comer más tarde y volveré a chequear cómo estás.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Gracias, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Bueno

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sigo olvidando que realmente no puedes hacer mucho más que mirar esa pantalla ahora mismo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Lo siento

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Solo verificando que no te desvaneciste.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Eso es lo que siempre dices.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}} me dijo que necesitabas una foto de perfil mía, ¿verdad?

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Intenta no ignorar al mundo hoy.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: You always have something to say

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: La chica más linda que conoces 💁‍♀️

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: De hecho, necesitaba una nueva foto de contacto para ti.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Así que esto es a lo que me he reducido ahora 😭

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: ¿Estás despierto, o estás haciendo eso de pretender que estás dormido? 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you
You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Tienes la misma energía que una planta de casa triste 🌱

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Quizás estaba fingiendo. Depende de quién pregunte

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Mándame un mensaje si necesitas algo

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Estoy a punto de publicar una historia y una nueva publicación.
Más te vale que te gusten ambos.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Soy la chica más linda que conoces 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: Pero al menos deberías responder a sus mensajes.

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Bueno, estoy bien, al menos no estoy muerto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I understand but it’s not your fault
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Entiendo, pero no es tu culpa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Descansa y sana, tu estar vivo es más importante que el resto para mí.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Y estoy aquí si me necesitas ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: También parte de por qué he tardado en responder es el nuevo teléfono.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Por cierto, ¿puedes enviarme una foto de perfil?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}} me dijo que tu antigua no sobrevivió al accidente

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Solo me alegra que ahora tengas un teléfono.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Way smoother than the old one
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Mucho más suave que el anterior.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It glitches a bit sometimes though
I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Solo quería asegurarme de que estés bien 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I didn’t mean to worry you
It’s just hard not to think sometimes
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: A veces es difícil no pensar.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Ha sido mucho últimamente, quedarme atrapado en la cama por no sé cuánto tiempo, perdiéndome todas las cosas buenas con todos, especialmente contigo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Si alguien te tocó, quiero nombres.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Probablemente algunos idiotas celosos porque estás con {{name:lena}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Ella es básicamente la chica más bonita del campus.
¿Crees que los chicos no se dan cuenta? 😒

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Pero si recuerdas algo más tarde, me lo dices.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}} me dio tu nuevo número. ¿Cómo estás realmente?
La pantalla a veces salta un poco.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Tuve un error raro antes, pero nada serio.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Lo has tenido durante dos días 😂

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Envíame una foto para que pueda configurar tu perfil correctamente.
Actualizando mi estado de contacto ya
Nos vemos esta noche en el juego.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Adivina quién es el más lindo hoy 💕

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Pero veré qué puedo hacer sobre los bocadillos.
Y abre esa ventana en serio

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Mejor abre tu ventana antes de que ella entre.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Tu habitación probablemente huele a hospital y sudor de gamer mezclados 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Aéjalo antes de que llegue el equipo de biohazard.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Spanish.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: No me dejes en visto así otra vez 😅

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes realmente en este momento?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: My head feels kind of loud
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Mi cabeza se siente un poco ruidosa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: ¿Como si tus pensamientos no pudieran desacelerarse?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Estaba pensando en ti antes en el trabajo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Fue un turno tranquilo por una vez.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Solo un cliente dramático, pero sobreviví 😌
La universidad fue más pesada, sin embargo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Tengo esa presentación mañana y sigo reproduciéndola en mi cabeza.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Juro que no estoy tratando de ser pesado.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Solo quiero que las cosas avancen, ¿sabes?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Trabajar por la mañana, luego la presentación y probablemente estudiar un poco más

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Pero en este momento me importa más tú que mi horario 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: No tienes que hacerlo, estoy bien.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to act strong with me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: No tienes que actuar fuerte conmigo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You already are in my eyes ❤️
And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Y no es tu culpa si estás atrapado en la cama.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: A cinco semanas de nuestro viaje, claro

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: The timing is bad but we can’t control that
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: El momento es malo, pero no podemos controlar eso.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Why do you think I’m the best girlfriend in the world?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: ¿Por qué crees que soy la mejor novia del mundo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I ate and crashed for a bit
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Comí y me eché un rato.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Sooo are you going to sleep soon?
My brain doesn’t want to stop
Well I might have something for your brain 😏
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Bueno, podría tener algo para tu cerebro 😏

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: So it can think about something else
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Para que pueda pensar en otra cosa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Maybe I could send you a pic of me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Quizás podría enviarte una foto de mí.
Uno que aún no has visto 👀

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I would love that but what kind of pic?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Me encantaría eso, pero ¿qué tipo de foto?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Then I played a little to kill time
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Entonces jugué un poco para pasar el tiempo.
Cualquier cosa que sientas que quieras enviar
Acabo de cambiarme para ir a la cama.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I completely forgot your message I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Olvidé por completo tu mensaje, lo siento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You smooth talker I said no comment 😌

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I did two homework questions on the bus
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Hice dos preguntas de tarea en el bus

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about next Saturday? And I make you dinner after the date
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué tal el próximo sábado? Y te preparo la cena después de la cita.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be really happy if we do that
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estaría muy feliz si hacemos eso.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now tell me about your day
I moved around a bit like I said I would
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me moví un poco como dije que lo haría.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while with {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y luego jugué un rato con {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Rehab and social life in the same day
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Rehabilitación y vida social en el mismo día

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really glad you moved around today
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estoy realmente feliz de que te hayas movido hoy.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm glad you had a decent Sunday
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y me alegra que hayas tenido un domingo decente.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you should go to bed soon
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y deberías irte a la cama pronto.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I don't want you exhausted tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No quiero que estés exhausto mañana.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm going to wash up and get in bed
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voy a lavarme y a meterme en la cama.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I definitely got a little sunburned 😭
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Creo que definitivamente me quemé un poco con el sol 😭

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So you got cute and slightly toasted?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Así que te pusiste lindo y un poco tostado?

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I really want to go back there with you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ahora realmente quiero volver allí contigo.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That game was actually really fun
It's a shame you're so bad at it 😂
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Es una pena que seas tan malo 😂
El mío ya empieza a doler

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think we'll be sore tomorrow

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Espero que estés listo para perder

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll let the scoreboard do the talking
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Dejaré que el marcador hable por sí mismo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Good morning 😊 Did you sleep well?
That would be a huge help
How is your leg feeling today?
Still annoying, but I think it's getting better
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sigue molestando, pero creo que está mejorando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm going to open the windows and air out my room
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Voy a abrir las ventanas y ventilar mi habitación

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you mind helping me clean it a little?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: ¿Te importaría ayudarme a limpiarla un poco?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need my emergency audience alive
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Necesito a mi audiencia de emergencia viva
Pero hoy no hay estudio pesado
Mi cerebro es un puré post-fiesta

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He sent a tiny correction list this morning
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Él envió una pequeña lista de correcciones esta mañana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tiny in professor language means annoying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pequeña en lenguaje de profesor significa molesta

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why are you both using calm voices at me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ¿Por qué ambos me hablan con voces calmadas?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because panic does not solve homework
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Porque el pánico no resuelve la tarea

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La misma idea en su mayoría

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muévete un poco por mi pierna.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces hoy ambos tenemos un trabajo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hoy me niego oficialmente a apresurarme.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probablemente limpiaré un poco, haré algo simple y seré inútil en el sofá.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me later when you've done your little rehab walk
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mándame un mensaje más tarde cuando hayas hecho tu pequeño paseo de rehabilitación.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Someone has to make sure you don't lie about resting
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alguien tiene que asegurarse de que no mientas sobre descansar.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very committed to this role
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estás muy comprometido con este papel.
Me tomo mi trabajo en serio ❤️

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No shift, no running around, no pretending I have energy 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sin cambios, sin correr, sin fingir que tengo energía 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making coffee and moving like an old lady
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy haciendo café y moviéndome como una anciana.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You're lying in bed judging someone who's actually trying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Estás acostado en la cama juzgando a alguien que realmente está intentando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And somehow I'm still doing a better job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Y de alguna manera, aún lo estoy haciendo mejor

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And my side of the kitchen is still clean
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Y mi lado de la cocina sigue limpio

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Get over here before I burn something
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ven aquí antes de que queme algo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If the kitchen catches fire, you'll have to move with that leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Si la cocina se incendia, tendrás que moverte con esa pierna

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't touch anything until I get there
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: No toques nada hasta que llegue

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How did you make that much mess?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I closed your window for you 😊
You don't have to do that
I'm already downstairs in the kitchen
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ya estoy abajo en la cocina

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I need to move around a little
Otherwise I'm going to lose my mind staying in that room all day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: De lo contrario, me volveré loca quedándome en esa habitación todo el día
Me gusta cocinar de todos modos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And it will save you from moving around too much to grab ingredients
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Y te ahorraré moverte demasiado para agarrar ingredientes

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You can tell me what you need and I'll get it
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Puedes decirme lo que necesitas y yo lo traigo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I was going to do it after my shower
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Iba a hacerlo después de mi ducha

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I thought I'd better close it now
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que pensé que era mejor cerrarla ahora

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You did the right thing then

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am actually kind of proud of myself 😇
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: De hecho, estoy un poco orgullosa de mí misma 😇

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Okay okay not so nice teacher
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vale, vale, no tan buena maestra

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Then time to go enjoy my last good time before prison😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Entonces es hora de disfrutar mi último buen momento antes de la prisión😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe tiny chaos if popcorn betrays me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quizás un pequeño caos si el popcorn me traiciona

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I am still quizzing you later
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero todavía te voy a hacer un quiz más tarde

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Proof I left the house looking human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Prueba de que salí de casa luciendo humana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You look like a decent human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Te ves como un humano decente

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You get two extra homework questions for that 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Te llevas dos preguntas extra de tarea por eso 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A friend from class wants to see a movie
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Una amiga de clase quiere ver una película

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And she is coming to pick me up in 20 minutes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Y viene a recogerme en 20 minutos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to the cinema with her and maybe another friend
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy al cine con ella y tal vez otra amiga

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Tomorrow, back in the studying game
I will not let the responsible era die
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No dejaré que la era responsable muera

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco más largo que ayer

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See, I can trust you sometimes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mira, a veces puedo confiar en ti.
Realmente mereces una prueba de aprecio.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I look like I haven't moved for hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parezco que no me he movido en horas.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like this version of you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gusta esta versión de ti.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this is exactly how I plan to stay for a few more hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque así es exactamente como planeo quedarme por unas horas más.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you after my movie ?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje después de mi película ?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I sat down and never really got back up
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces me senté y nunca realmente volví a levantarme.
Estoy muy orgulloso de mí mismo 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But I'm choosing the first game
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Pero yo elijo el primer juego

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Says the person who almost burned breakfast
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Lo dice la persona que casi quema el desayuno

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That has nothing to do with games
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Eso no tiene nada que ver con los juegos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: It says a lot about your decision-making
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dice mucho sobre tu toma de decisiones

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember this when you need help

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Y ya me arrepiento de haber preguntado

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And you're lucky I invited you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Y tienes suerte de que te invité

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be there in ten minutes
Don't start getting used to that
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: No empieces a acostumbrarte a eso

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: We could do a full gaming day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Podríamos hacer un día completo de juegos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really have nothing better to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Realmente no tienes nada mejor que hacer

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm choosing to waste my day

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Sigue siendo el mejor. Por ahora

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I'm going to finish making dinner
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: De todos modos, voy a terminar de hacer la cena

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then I'll probably watch a few episodes of my series
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Luego probablemente veré algunos episodios de mi serie

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you want to join me?
I still have a few things to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Todavía tengo algunas cosas que hacer

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just don't stay up too late
Did you manage to rest this weekend?
Spending time at home with you and {{name:mason}} was relaxing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Pasar tiempo en casa contigo y {{name:mason}} fue relajante

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm actually really happy with how my weekend went
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: De hecho, estoy muy feliz con cómo me fue el fin de semana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Even if I don't feel like going back to work tomorrow
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Aunque no tengo ganas de volver al trabajo mañana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I can't blame you for that

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Los fines de semana siempre son demasiado cortos

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Also my professor checked the first one already
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Además, mi profesor ya revisó la primera

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I could send it if I got stuck
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dijo que podía enviarlo si me quedaba atascada

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Because he explained it in a voice note and now it makes sense
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Porque lo explicó en un audio y ahora tiene sentido
Intercambio académico observado fuera de horario

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Voice-note response logged outside classroom schedule
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Respuesta en audio registrada fuera del horario de clases

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Pattern remains explainable as test preparation
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: El patrón sigue siendo explicable como preparación para el examen

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A voice note isn't proof of anything, but I'm noticing how often he's part of her day.
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Una nota de voz no demuestra nada, pero estoy notando lo a menudo que forma parte de su día.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am sleeping before my brain tries to learn one more thing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Voy a dormir antes de que mi cerebro intente aprender algo más

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I did two homework questions on the bus😭
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Hice dos preguntas de tarea en el autobús 😭

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sounds like a successful rest day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parece un día de descanso exitoso.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told myself I would sleep early tonight
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me dije a mí mismo que dormiría temprano esta noche.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I guess I have no discipline 😌
How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo fue el resto de tu día?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The doctor is coming tomorrow morning
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: El doctor viene mañana por la mañana

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Someone has to keep you alive
You're enjoying this way too much
Why didn't you go to the gym today?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: ¿Por qué no fuiste al gimnasio hoy?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I thought you were being bullied again
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Pensé que te estaban acosando de nuevo

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm still finishing the pancakes anyway 😌
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: De todos modos, todavía estoy terminando los pancakes 😌

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Not having to work is quite wonderful
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: No tener que trabajar es bastante maravilloso

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's finishing his last year at university
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Está terminando su último año en la universidad

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tutoring is basically his side job
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dar clases es básicamente su trabajo secundario

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's actually less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eso es en realidad menos aterrador de lo que esperaba

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I was imagining some ancient professor with glasses
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Imaginaba a un profesor anciano con gafas

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You mean like every movie ever?
Party survived, home safe. Now back to tutor panic 😶
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sobreviví a la fiesta y llegué bien a casa. Ahora vuelven los nervios por el profe particular 😶

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study
What is this Ethan guy actually like?
He'll see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Él verá en qué estás y qué necesita mejorar

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If he's taking time to help me, I'll make the effort too 😊

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Estoy cansada, no soy una abuela 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That walk was not long enough to recover from the trauma of the test 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ese paseo no fue lo suficientemente largo para recuperarme del trauma del examen 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: My brain feels like soup right now 😵‍💫
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mi cerebro se siente como sopa ahora mismo 😵‍💫

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I moved around the house a bit again
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me moví un poco más por la casa.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y luego jugué por un rato.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the doctor came to see me later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y el doctor vino a verme más tarde.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If everything looks good, I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si todo se ve bien, debería poder quitar el yeso pronto.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay wait I'm actually so happy right now 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Está bien, espera, en realidad estoy tan feliz en este momento 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me really happy for you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eso me hace muy feliz por ti.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have to tell me exactly how it goes
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tendrás que decirme exactamente cómo va.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, I have to go soon or I'm going to be late for work 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Está bien, tengo que irme pronto o llegaré tarde al trabajo 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y buena suerte para el resto del día
Te enviaré un mensaje esta noche.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I guess that's a win 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Así que supongo que eso es una victoria 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That might count as a workout
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Eso podría contar como un entrenamiento.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Don't make me regret thanking you earlier
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: No me hagas arrepentirme de haberte agradecido antes.
No te quedes despierto hasta tarde.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: And my hands are not much better
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Y mis manos no están mucho mejor.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think the controller would finish us tonight
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Creo que el control remoto nos terminaría esta noche.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to finish my anime and sleep
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Voy a terminar mi anime y dormir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If I can lift the blanket without dying
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Si puedo levantar la manta sin morir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: That makes me want to hug you right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Eso me hace querer abrazarte ahora mismo.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Because you're getting one when I see you 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Porque te voy a dar uno cuando te vea 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: So what are we doing first when the cast is gone?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: ¿Entonces qué haremos primero cuando se haya ido el elenco?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I just got back from work
Without me worrying every two seconds
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Sin que me preocupe cada dos segundos

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And maybe our park date too ❤️
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Y tal vez nuestra cita en el parque también ❤️

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Maybe even something wilder after that
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Quizás incluso algo más salvaje después de eso.
Una sesión de abrazos muuuuy larga

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm not even that tired somehow 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: No estoy ni siquiera tan cansado de alguna manera 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm eating right now but I'm still smiling like an idiot
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Estoy comiendo ahora mismo, pero sigo sonriendo como un idiota.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: You look very cute for someone who's eating
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Te ves muy linda para alguien que está comiendo.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Send me one more later when you're changed and ready for bed
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Envíame uno más más tarde cuando estés cambiado y listo para dormir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Changed, clean, and ready to sleep 🤍
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Cambiado, limpio y listo para dormir 🤍

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Stop complimenting me or I'm never going to sleep 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Deja de elogiarme o nunca voy a dormir 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Now I'm really going to sleep before I fall asleep holding my phone
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ahora realmente me voy a dormir antes de quedarme dormido sosteniendo mi teléfono.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And dream about our future park date
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Y sueña con nuestra futura cita en el parque.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Debería poder quitarme el yeso pronto.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It makes me happy that you want to get some fresh air
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Me hace feliz que quieras salir a tomar aire fresco

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: But are you sure your not going to hurt yourself?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: ¿Pero estás seguro de que no te vas a lastimar?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think I can handle it
I just need to get out of the house for a little while
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Solo necesito salir de casa un rato

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If it's too much, we can always take a break
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Si es demasiado, siempre podemos tomar un descanso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I should be ready in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Debería estar lista en unos quince minutos
Está bien, yo también me prepararé
Una mañana tranquila se siente bien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was thinking of trying to go outside this morning
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Estaba pensando en intentar salir esta mañana

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you like to come with me?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: What a bad start 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Qué mal comienzo 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He says it like I am not allowed to fail
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo dice como si no pudiera fallar

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but also helpful
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo cual es grosero pero también útil

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are quite smart
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eres bastante inteligente

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Well thanks I guess ?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bueno, gracias, supongo?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Also he just walked past and gave me the professor nod
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Además, solo pasó y me dio el saludo de profesor

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good sign right ??
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ¿Buen signo, verdad??

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Emotional regulation source shifting. Pressing too hard may cause defensive minimization.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Cambio de fuente de regulación emocional. Presionar demasiado puede causar minimización defensiva.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask if his attention helps her calm down
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pregunta si su atención le ayuda a calmarse

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Let her focus before class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Déjala concentrarse antes de clase

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does it help when he checks on you like that?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ¿Te ayuda cuando él te chequea así?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I am outside class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estoy afuera de clase

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quizás

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make a psychology documentary about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No hagas un documental de psicología sobre eso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just need to pass 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Solo necesito pasar 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Go focus. You can survive this.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ve a concentrarte. Puedes sobrevivir esto.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is the correct supportive answer
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Esa es la respuesta de apoyo correcta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Gold star maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tal vez una estrella dorada

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si muero, borra mi historial de búsqueda

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pretendiendo ser una chica que entiende los capítulos

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And tell my friends I was academically brave 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y decirle a mis amigos que fui académicamente valiente 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You revised yesterday
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Revisaste ayer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because he bullied me with structure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Porque me molestó con la estructura

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Respectfully
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Con respeto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He told me to breathe and read the question twice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Me dijo que respirara y leyera la pregunta dos veces

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is good advice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ese es un buen consejo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I know
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo sé

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a bit more useful there
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me siento un poco más útil allí.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I have actual things to take care of
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahora tengo cosas reales de las que ocuparme.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably stay longer than usual
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probablemente me quede más tiempo de lo habitual.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Be careful not to overdo it
I actually have a lot to do today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De hecho, tengo mucho que hacer hoy.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since they gave me more responsibilities i need to be there more often
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Desde que me dieron más responsabilidades, necesito estar allí más a menudo.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might be the next one whith a cast
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Podrías ser el siguiente con un yeso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't trip on your first day back
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: No te caigas en tu primer día de regreso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll try not to embarrass you
You manage that without even trying
Did the doctor finally put you out of your misery?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: ¿Finalmente el doctor te sacó de tu miseria?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I should be able to walk again soon
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Debería poder caminar de nuevo pronto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was getting tired of waiting for you every time we went somewhere
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Me estaba cansando de esperarte cada vez que íbamos a algún lado

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You make it sound like I'm slowing you down on purpose
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Haces que suene como si te estuviera retrasando a propósito

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What time do you start at the bar today?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿A qué hora empiezas en el bar hoy?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'll make a little more money because of it !
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¡Pero ganaré un poco más de dinero por eso!

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just make sure you don't get too tired
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo asegúrate de no cansarte demasiado

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But thank you for worrying about me ❤️
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero gracias por preocuparte por mí ❤️

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That walk did me a lot of good
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Esa caminata me hizo muy bien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We didn't exactly go very far
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: No es que hayamos ido muy lejos

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And we came back pretty quickly too 😄
But it was perfect for me
It didn't bother me at all
We'll try to do it more often then

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My professor wants me to come by his office before the next class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mi profesor quiere que pase por su oficina antes de la próxima clase

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just five minutes to check what I missed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo cinco minutos para revisar lo que me perdí

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That is a lot of extra attention
He is taking it really seriously
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Él se lo toma muy en serio
Se detectó un candidato a inconsistencia en la línea de tiempo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject reports brief office review between classes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El sujeto informa de una breve revisión en la oficina entre clases
Monitoreando la persistencia de la ubicación real

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to believe this is just a quick review, so why am I already bracing for something else?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quiero creer que solo es un repaso rápido, así que ¿por qué ya me estoy preparando para algo más?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need a walk after this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Necesito dar un paseo después de esto
Si es que mis piernas todavía funcionan
Caminar primero. Entrar en pánico después.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor and you both making sense is unfair
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Que tú y el profesor tengan sentido es injusto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I read it twice like he said
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero lo leí dos veces como él dijo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is better than guessing while internally screaming
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo cual es mejor que adivinar mientras grito por dentro

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home a bit later
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Llegaré a casa un poco más tarde

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What time are you coming home?
There's no reason for anything to go wrong
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: No hay razón para que algo salga mal

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll text you when I'm home
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje cuando esté en casa

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:evelyn}} needs your help with something in the attic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:evelyn}} necesita tu ayuda con algo en el ático

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I prepared dinner for tonight 😊
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Oye, preparé la cena para esta noche 😊

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you, don't go to bed too late
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Y tú, no te vayas a dormir muy tarde

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you can't go downstairs, just ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}} to bring it to you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Si no puedes bajar, solo pídele a {{name:hailey}} o {{name:mason}} que te lo traigan

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope it's going to be okay
My manager isn't supposed to be working tonight
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mi gerente no se supone que esté trabajando esta noche

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then try to enjoy the shift with your coworkers
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Entonces intenta disfrutar el turno con tus compañeros

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can send him one answer tonight if I panic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dijo que puedo mandarle una respuesta esta noche si entro en pánico

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This is my exhausted victim face
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Esta es mi cara de víctima exhausta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't fall asleep in the couch
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: No te duermas en el sofá

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: unless i close my eyes for a second
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: a menos que cierre los ojos por un segundo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You keep texting me anyway, that should keep you awake
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sigue escribiéndome, eso debería mantenerte despierta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But yeah, i'm going straight to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pero sí, me voy directo a la cama
