story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: No sé ni cómo agradecerte por hacer todo esto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: ¿Cómo te fue en tu segundo día de trabajo?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Una sonrisa y un beso, entonces

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Entonces tal vez tenga que enviarte más de ellas

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ven a comer antes de que la cena se enfríe

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Y no te vayas a dormir muy tarde esta noche

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It was calmer than yesterday too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Fue más tranquilo que ayer también

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I managed to buy everything we needed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Logré comprar todo lo que necesitábamos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: We are almost out of money

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: He decidido ser útil esta noche

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So I am repaying my debt
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Así que estoy pagando mi deuda

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: {{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} entra a tu habitación para traerte comida y limpiar tu cuarto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pero desenchufaste toda mi PC mientras limpiabas

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ¿Cómo te atreves a tomarme una foto?
Voy a llamar a la policía 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Se ve claramente que tocas los cables

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Gracias por pedirle a {{name:mason}} que me recogiera

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Muestra a una chica trabajadora e inocente siendo incriminada

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quizás el cable me atacó primero

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
And you are taking secret pictures of me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Y tú estás tomando fotos secretas de mí

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ve a revisar antes de destruir más electrónicos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pero si la PC muere, ya estaba débil

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Se detectó un aumento en la frecuencia cardíaca durante la reciente interacción privada
Cruce de referencias visuales y emocionales...

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante archivada en HAK Evidence

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Estar cerca de {{name:hailey}} se me quedó grabado, y quiero más momentos así.
¿Así que estás a salvo en casa?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Viva, a salvo y solo un poco dramática

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
I finally collapsed on the couch
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Finalmente me desplomé en el sofá.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y estoy robando bocadillos de la cocina como una ratita.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lamento mucho haber perdido tus llamadas.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tuve un día muy glamoroso de estrés y pequeños desastres.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y un cliente que actuó como si yo hubiera arruinado su vida personalmente.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Seguí pensando en estar en casa y hablar contigo, aunque...

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Esa parte la puedes hacer ahora

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Por eso quería quedarme aquí contigo un poco más.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aún no deberías acostarte demasiado tarde.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo quería un poco más de ti primero.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y espero que mañana sea más fácil para ti también.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Siempre dices la cosa molesta correcta 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ve a ducharte cuando termines de comer.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Y te envío una foto de mí?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pero solo porque te he extrañado todo el día

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Promete que no se lo mostrarás a nadie.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Todavía estoy en mi ropa de trabajo 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te ves tan bien (y sexy) que casi muero.
Está bien, esa es una buena respuesta.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now
It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sentí que todo el día fue solo un problema tras otro.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Te tomaste esa derrota muy en serio

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Eso son muchas excusas para una sola noche

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Next time we should bet something
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: La próxima vez deberíamos apostar algo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: El perdedor le debe un favor al ganador

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Espero que no pierdas muy a menudo entonces 😏

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ven a que te den una paliza en 5 minutos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: He estado esperando todo el día para hacerte llorar

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Veremos quién se ríe en unos minutos

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: ¿Necesitas un osito de peluche para dormir esta noche? 😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tuve mucho tiempo, así que hice desayuno

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tienes que lidiar con tu gerente todos los días

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Es lo menos que puedo hacer en casa
Eso es muy dulce de tu parte

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tómate tu tiempo para levantarte y descansa un poco

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tuviste una larga noche en el trabajo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
I didn't even hear my alarm
You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Trabajaste tarde, es normal estar cansada

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dijo que pasara si la segunda clase expone mis trágicas lagunas

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Estoy segura de que sus palabras fueron más amables

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot
He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Él solo sabe cómo hacer que mi cerebro funcione

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ahora no tengo excusa para fallar

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si aprendo algo en contra de mi voluntad, les echo la culpa a los dos 💅
Buenos días. Más o menos sí 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y probablemente rescate del profesor después de la segunda

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Part-time job from morning to evening
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Trabajo a tiempo parcial de mañana a tarde
Una foto rápida antes de irme 😅

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje cuando pueda.
Está bien, que tengas un buen día.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
I was starting to think the doctor had fixed your personality too
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ya estaba empezando a pensar que el doctor también había arreglado tu personalidad

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Not even medicine can save yours
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ni la medicina puede salvar la tuya

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I need to reconnect a few things in my room
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Necesito reconectar algunas cosas en mi habitación

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The console, the screen and some cables
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: La consola, la pantalla y algunos cables

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And you need me for that?
You might actually be useful for once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tal vez realmente seas útil por una vez

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then your console can stay broken
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Entonces tu consola puede seguir rota

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can't I ask how you're doing?
It was almost better when you kept your mouth shut
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Casi era mejor cuando mantenías la boca cerrada

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks again for this morning
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Gracias de nuevo por esta mañana

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That looks delicious
Good 😊
Then it was worth the effort
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Entonces valió la pena el esfuerzo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: By the way, are you working the same hours tonight?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Por cierto, ¿trabajas las mismas horas esta noche?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No
Since my manager is working tonight, I'm back to my usual schedule
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Como mi gerente trabaja esta noche, vuelvo a mi horario habitual

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'll leave a little earlier
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que saldré un poco antes

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then make sure you take some time for yourself before work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Entonces asegúrate de tomarte un tiempo para ti antes del trabajo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will 😊
I'm going to watch some TV for a bit
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a ver un poco de televisión

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It's nothing, really
And then I'll start getting ready
That sounds like a good plan 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Eso suena como un buen plan 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe for you
But I still think it was really sweet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero aún así creo que fue muy dulce

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I made a cake for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que hice un pastel para ti

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You didn't have to do that
But I'm definitely not complaining 😄
I hope you'll like it
Wow

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If you get home early, you revise
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si llegas a casa temprano, revisas

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said he can bring me home when he's done with work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El profesor dijo que puede llevarme a casa cuando termine con el trabajo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I am waiting in the school office
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que estoy esperando en la oficina de la escuela

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It is quieter than the hallway
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Está más tranquilo que en el pasillo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And he said he's almost done
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Y dijo que ya casi termina

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I will just wait here
It actually went kind of well
Subject accepted professor's offer instead of waiting for alternative pickup
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El sujeto aceptó la oferta del profesor en lugar de esperar otra recogida

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Pattern of one-on-one contact frequency continues to increase
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El patrón de contacto uno a uno sigue aumentando

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavior remains explainable but trend analysis flagged for review
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El comportamiento sigue siendo explicable, pero el análisis de tendencias está marcado para revisión

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: His help is becoming part of her routine, and that makes me uneasy.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Su ayuda se está convirtiendo en parte de la rutina de ella, y eso me inquieta.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor provided transportation following a private revision session. Interaction remains within a plausible academic context, though HAK notes a growing pattern of personal assistance and increased familiarity.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El profesor proporcionó transporte tras una sesión de revisión privada. La interacción se mantiene dentro de un contexto académico plausible, aunque HAK señala un patrón creciente de asistencia personal y mayor familiaridad.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm leaving the school office now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ya me voy de la oficina de la escuela

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not say it like a proud spreadsheet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No lo digas como una hoja de cálculo orgullosa

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I feel safer asking when you are involved
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Me siento más segura pidiendo cuando tú estás involucrado

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're using that leg as an excuse for everything now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ahora estás usando esa pierna como excusa para todo
Se llama trabajar de manera más inteligente

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really should stop watching business videos
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Realmente deberías dejar de ver videos de negocios

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: So... are you bringing the groceries?
But only because I don't trust you to shop alone
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Pero solo porque no confío en ti para comprar solo
Y no te olvides del pan 😌

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just because I'm outside doesn't mean I'm your personal delivery service
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Solo porque estoy afuera no significa que sea tu servicio de entrega personal

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't you help a poor injured man? 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿No puedes ayudar a un pobre hombre herido? 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I'm about to leave for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Hola, estoy a punto de salir para el trabajo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 2 HOURS LATER
Hey, I'm on my break
How is it going?
It's okay

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Te vas a perder a Chris perdiendo

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and Chris moved unusually close after a lost challenge
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason y Chris se acercaron inusualmente después de un desafío perdido

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Interaction intensity increased beyond normal gaming behavior
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: La intensidad de la interacción aumentó más allá del comportamiento normal de juego

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Their closeness is becoming harder to shrug off, and I'm still working out what I make of it.
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Cada vez cuesta más restarle importancia a su cercanía, y todavía estoy intentando entender qué pienso al respecto.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and Chris shared an unusually close moment after a lost gaming challenge
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason y Chris compartieron un momento inusualmente cercano después de un desafío de juego perdido

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You just shouldn't be so bad 😂
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Simplemente no deberías ser tan malo 😂

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm the only one who lost
When are you coming back to play?
I still need to help {{name:evelyn}} with a letter
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Aún necesito ayudar a {{name:evelyn}} con una carta

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: It's like the idea of sharing you is exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Es como si la idea de compartirte me emocionara.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Thinking about you taking pleasure with another man
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Pensando en ti disfrutando con otro hombre

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And the idea of someone else seeing all of you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Y la idea de que alguien más te vea por completo

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Having you for himself for a moment
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Tenerte solo para él por un momento

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: All of that is extremely exciting to me
I think I'm starting to understand
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Creo que estoy empezando a entender

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So when you say someone else seeing all of me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Entonces, cuando dices que alguien más ve todo de mí

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: If someone else saw me like that…
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Si alguien más me viera así...

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: What would that do to you?
It would excite me a lot
And the idea of another man seeing you like that does something to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Y la idea de que otro hombre te vea así me hace sentir algo.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: That's what I wanted to know 😳
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Eso es lo que quería saber 😳

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now imagine I send something like that to someone else
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ahora imagina que le envío algo así a otra persona.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, and I'd want to have it too
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Creo que querría saberlo, y también querría tenerlo.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, but not receive it myself
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Creo que querría saberlo, pero no recibirlo yo mismo.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I don't think I'd want to know
I've been thinking a lot about what you told me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: He estado pensando mucho en lo que me dijiste.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So you'd want to share that moment with me?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: ¿Así que querrías compartir ese momento conmigo?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Maybe not knowing would make it stronger
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Quizás no saber lo haría más fuerte.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So the mystery would be part of it?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: ¿Entonces el misterio sería parte de esto?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: You're really trying to understand this, huh
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Realmente estás tratando de entender esto, ¿verdad?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And maybe I like the way you react 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Y tal vez me gusta cómo reaccionas 😌
Sobre tu cosa de los cornudos

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: But I feel safe doing this with you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Pero me siento seguro haciendo esto contigo.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now I really need to stop before I go too far 😭
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ahora realmente necesito detenerme antes de ir demasiado lejos 😭

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Yeah... same here, it's getting harder to keep it together
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Sí... yo también, se está volviendo más difícil mantenerlo todo junto.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Be ready for next time then 😏
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Prepárate para la próxima vez entonces 😏

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I'm trying to understand how it feels for you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Estoy tratando de entender cómo se siente para ti

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Like… what exactly makes it exciting in your head
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Como... ¿qué es exactamente lo que lo hace emocionante en tu cabeza?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If you try to act tough and mess it up right away I will judge you loudly
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Si intentas actuar duro y lo arruinas de inmediato, te juzgaré en voz alta.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Only one week of classes left
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Solo queda una semana de clases.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: What are you planning to do
Any news on when that cast comes off?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: ¿Alguna novedad sobre cuándo te quitan el yeso?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And drag you with me once your leg is ready
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Y te arrastraré conmigo una vez que tu pierna esté lista.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That's suppose to be a good thing?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: ¿Se supone que eso es algo bueno?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: The doctor is checking my leg today, so I should know more after that
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: El médico me revisa la pierna hoy, así que después sabré más

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Your leg has been in there long enough
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Tu pierna ya lleva bastante tiempo ahí metida

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope so, but I'm waiting to hear what he says
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Eso espero, pero voy a esperar a ver qué dice

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Even if it comes off, take it slow
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Aunque te lo quiten, tómatelo con calma

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: No celebrating with a sprint down the stairs
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Nada de celebrarlo bajando las escaleras a toda velocidad

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'll ask him what I can do before I try anything
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Le preguntaré qué puedo hacer antes de intentar nada

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I think I got enough rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Pero creo que descansé lo suficiente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: By the way, I sent you some money this morning
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Por cierto, te envié algo de dinero esta mañana

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: For groceries, bills and everything else
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Para la despensa, cuentas y todo lo demás

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I really don't know how to thank you
You already do enough for me
You deserve to rest and enjoy yourself a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Te mereces descansar y disfrutar un poco

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And honestly, I'm happy I get to spend so much time with you lately
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Y honestamente, estoy feliz de poder pasar tanto tiempo contigo últimamente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It feels like we've gotten a lot closer
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Siento que nos hemos acercado mucho más

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I like spending more time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Me gusta pasar más tiempo contigo
Más de lo que esperaba, de hecho 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: The doctor is coming after work today
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: El doctor viene después del trabajo hoy

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Actually, I wanted to ask you something
Would it be easier if I kept some food in my room for lunch?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: ¿Sería más fácil si guardo algo de comida en mi cuarto para el almuerzo?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way I wouldn't have to bother you every day
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Así no tendría que molestarte todos los días

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I actually like taking care of you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: De hecho, me gusta cuidar de ti

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Así que cuando tengas hambre, solo dímelo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And I'll bring you a hot meal
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Y te traeré una comida caliente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll talk to you later then
We went to bed pretty late yesterday
I woke up a few times during the night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Me desperté un par de veces durante la noche

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You cannot just skip because you are tired
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: No puedes simplemente saltarte clases porque estás cansada

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I can if I pay the tutor tax
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Puedo si pago el impuesto del tutor

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You earned a bit of rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Te ganaste un poco de descanso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I knew you were secretly reasonable 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sabía que en el fondo eras razonable 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The court has ruled in my favor 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: El tribunal ha fallado a mi favor 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Besides, I need to be in top condition for shopping this afternoon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Además, necesito estar en óptimas condiciones para ir de compras esta tarde

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Of course that is your priority
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Por supuesto, esa es tu prioridad
La recuperación de moda es sagrada 😇

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I am still in bed and i don't plan on leaving
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sigo en la cama y no planeo salir

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And my bed is also holding me hostage
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Y mi cama también me tiene secuestrada
Solo dos clases por la mañana
Así que me las voy a saltar 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So what are you doing today?
And I want to use that time to go shopping for our date tomorrow 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Y quiero usar ese tiempo para ir de compras para nuestra cita de mañana 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll send you the outfits so you can tell me which one you like most ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Te enviaré los atuendos para que me digas cuál te gusta más ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You in different outfits sounds dangerous already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tú en diferentes atuendos suena peligroso ya.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I'll make sure to send you the hardest choices
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Entonces me aseguraré de enviarte las decisiones más difíciles.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I need to thank you again for last night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Necesito agradecerte de nuevo por anoche.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And for spoiling me that much
You spoil me too, you know
That's exactly how it should be

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Still sore in a few places
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Aún me duele en algunos lugares

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Try not to complain too much

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Eso es gracioso viniendo de ti
Aún me duele por todas partes

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I might get the cast off soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Pero tal vez me quiten el yeso pronto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: After that I'll be able to move properly again
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Después de eso podré moverme bien otra vez

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Unlike you, I can get ready without turning it into a medical operation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: A diferencia de ti, puedo prepararme sin convertirlo en una operación médica

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: It's not exactly easy to put on with the cast
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: No es fácil ponérmelo con el yeso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So the cast is now losing against clothes too
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Así que el yeso también está perdiendo contra la ropa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Let's go before you need a break from getting dressed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Vamos antes de que necesites un descanso para vestirte

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Everything seems to be healing correctly

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: El doctor me quitó el yeso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: But he also made me do a lot of movements
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Pero también me hizo hacer muchos movimientos

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And now it's starting to hurt a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Y ahora empieza a doler un poco

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me some ice?
I think I'm just going to let it rest for an hour
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Creo que solo voy a dejarlo descansar por una hora

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Just let me know if you need anything
He's about to come up and examine you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Está a punto de subir y examinarte

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Let's start with the school outfits

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ahora ronda de outfits de día 💅
El respeto se tiene que ganar 😇

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You officially influenced my wardrobe now
If I look too good later, that is your fault 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Si me veo demasiado bien después, es tu culpa 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will keep shopping a little

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: El campo de batalla es hermoso 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Mi jefe me acaba de enviar un mensaje

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I meant settling it by fighting
You can't hit someone who's already injured
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: No puedes golpear a alguien que ya está herido

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll kill you on the game instead
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Te venceré en el juego en su lugar

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to cry when you lose
Because now you have more time to annoy me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque ahora tienes más tiempo para molestarme

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've never seen someone so stiff
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Nunca he visto a alguien tan rígido

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Even with a cast, I think I did better
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Incluso con un yeso, creo que lo hice mejor
Eso no es flexibilidad, eso es hacer trampa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Turns out jump rope wasn't your only weakness
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Resulta que saltar la cuerda no era tu única debilidad

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I just chose not to look good doing it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Simplemente elegí no verme bien haciéndolo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll wait for you on the game

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm just a little stuck in the shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Solo estoy un poco atrapada en la ducha

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So you're telling me you're trapped in the shower? 😄
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: ¿Así que me estás diciendo que estás atrapada en la ducha? 😄

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And you're still naked as a worm?
Significant emotional tension detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Se detectó una tensión emocional significativa durante la reciente interacción privada

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Elevated heartbeat and embarrassment markers recorded
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Se registraron marcadores de aumento de ritmo cardíaco y vergüenza

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Captura emocional relevante archivada en la evidencia HAK

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm not the only one feeling this. That makes it harder to ignore.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: No soy el único que siente esto. Eso hace que sea más difícil ignorarlo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And sorry about the awkward situation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Y perdón por la situación incómoda

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's not the first naked man I've ever seen
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: No es el primer hombre desnudo que he visto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That somehow doesn't make me feel less embarrassed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Eso no me hace sentir menos avergonzada
De todos modos, la cena ya casi está lista

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll bring you something to eat soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Te traeré algo de comer pronto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: If the people around you are what matters most
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Si las personas a tu alrededor son lo que más importa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then you do what you have to do to make sure they're okay
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Entonces haces lo que tienes que hacer para asegurarte de que estén bien

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'm going to get ready for work
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a prepararme para el trabajo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Tonight is going to be a big night
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Esta noche va a ser una gran noche

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'm not even sure I'll get a real break
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ni siquiera estoy segura de que tendré un verdadero descanso

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'm going in a little earlier to prepare everything
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que voy a entrar un poco más temprano para preparar todo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But don't put too much pressure on yourself
What would you do if you were in a delicate situation with someone
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Qué harías si estuvieras en una situación delicada con alguien?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But the lives of the people around you depended on that person?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Pero las vidas de las personas a tu alrededor dependieran de esa persona?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I don't think there's a right or wrong answer
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: No creo que haya una respuesta correcta o incorrecta

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But you should choose what matters most to you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero deberías elegir lo que más te importa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's just paying for my shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo está pagando por mis compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So today I am listening to the man who protects shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que hoy estoy escuchando al hombre que protege las compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I will show you some of the outfits I'm trying on
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Te mostraré algunos de los outfits que estoy probando

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: External preference contamination possible. Subject may ask for input while prioritizing a different authority.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Contaminación de preferencias externas posible. El sujeto puede pedir opinión mientras prioriza a otra autoridad.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm asking professor for fashion advice now
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ahora le estoy pidiendo consejo de moda al profesor

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said something like that color suits presentations
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El profesor dijo algo como que ese color es bueno para presentaciones

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Your choice was unfortunately not the one I chose
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu elección, desafortunadamente, no fue la que elegí

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe you will win the next one 😌
Because he has opinions about presentations
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque tiene opiniones sobre las presentaciones

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And why is he the one who take pictures of you trying on clothes?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Y por qué es él quien te toma fotos probándote ropa?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because he's paying for my shopping, okay, there's nothing weird about that?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque él está pagando por mis compras, ¿ok? No hay nada raro en eso.
Ahora ronda de atuendos de día

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Repeated reference to professor approval detected during clothing decisions.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se detectó referencia repetida a la aprobación del profesor durante las decisiones de ropa.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe a little too cute for serious student era
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quizás un poco demasiado lindo para la era de estudiante seria

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The battlefield is beautiful and he's already here 😌
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El campo de batalla es hermoso y él ya está aquí 😌

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why ask me if you want his approval?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Por qué me preguntas si quieres su aprobación?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted to be nice to you
If you're going to be like that, I won't ask you anymore
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si vas a estar así, no te preguntaré más

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to upset you
I'm so happy I passed the exam!!
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¡Estoy tan feliz de haber pasado el examen!

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Wait, your realy showing that to him?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Espera, ¿realmente le vas a mostrar eso?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course, he's paying for my shopping, I have to show him the options I'm considering
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Por supuesto, él está pagando por mis compras, tengo que mostrarle las opciones que estoy considerando

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't start again, give me an answer or I won't ask you anymore
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No empieces otra vez, dame una respuesta o no te preguntaré más

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Choice influence weakened. Subject is no longer considering your approval as a primary factor.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La influencia de la elección se debilitó. El sujeto ya no considera tu aprobación como un factor principal.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see what professor thinks about that one
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Veamos qué piensa el profesor sobre esa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see what professor thinks about that one
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Veamos qué piensa el profesor sobre esa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm continuing a little more shopping
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a seguir comprando un poco más

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I will be home in time for dinner
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estaré en casa a tiempo para la cena

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yes, professor said I should be home for dinner
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sí, el profesor dijo que debería estar en casa para la cena

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Wardrobe decision dialogue contains repeated third-party approval references
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El diálogo de decisión de vestuario contiene referencias repetidas a la aprobación de terceros

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject response pattern shows delayed alignment with {{name:player}}'s input
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El patrón de respuesta del sujeto muestra una alineación retrasada con la entrada de {{name:player}}

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Metadata indicates three visual fragments captured inside the store changing room
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Los metadatos indican tres fragmentos visuales capturados dentro del probador de la tienda

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It stings that she kept asking for my opinion while his was the one that counted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Duele que siguiera pidiéndome mi opinión cuando la de él era la que contaba.
Brecha en la línea de tiempo de compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK archivó un fragmento visual de la sesión de compras. La postura y los marcadores de proximidad del sujeto sugieren tensión emocional inconsistente con la asistencia normal de compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered an unsent changing-room image from the shopping session metadata.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK recuperó una imagen no enviada del probador de la sesión de compras.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered a second unsent changing-room image from the same store session.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK recuperó una segunda imagen no enviada del probador de la misma sesión de la tienda.
Segunda imagen no enviada del vestidor

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't worry, I will be careful
And professor is a good guy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Y el profe es un buen tipo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Some of us are actually competent
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Algunos de nosotros realmente somos competentes

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that when you're asking me for favors
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Lo recordaré cuando me pidas favores

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Do we let the front door unlocked tonight?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Dejamos la puerta principal sin seguro esta noche?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Otherwise I'll just climb through your window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Si no, solo entraré por tu ventana

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Your leftovers saved my lunch today
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tus sobras salvaron mi almuerzo hoy

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: They even talked to me about a promotion
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Incluso me hablaron de un ascenso

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might not even get a break
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Quizás ni siquiera tenga un descanso
Intenta tomar uno de todos modos

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But if you really can't, then at least be careful and take care of yourself
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Pero si realmente no puedes, al menos cuídate y cuida de ti misma
Evento de alta respuesta emocional detectado

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Alcohol exposure and elevated excitement levels observed
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Exposición al alcohol y niveles de emoción elevados observados
La inhibición del comportamiento parece reducida

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Multiple interaction markers exceeded expected thresholds
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Múltiples marcadores de interacción superaron los umbrales esperados

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope she's all right. Those numbers don't tell me what she actually wants.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Espero que esté bien. Esos números no me dicen lo que ella quiere de verdad.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived footage from a high-energy shift showing unusually elevated emotional engagement during service
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Imágenes archivadas de HAK de un turno de alta energía mostrando un compromiso emocional inusualmente elevado durante el servicio

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready in the kitchen if you need anything
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Todo está listo en la cocina si necesitas algo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: DÍA 15 — Después de examinarte la pierna, el médico te quitó la escayola. Ahora puedes moverte con más libertad, pero tu pierna todavía necesita reposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation:
Hola.

Por ahora, has llegado al final del contenido disponible para este personaje.

Gracias por jugar iNTeRcepted.

Si quieres apoyar el proyecto, obtener nuevos episodios y acceder a contenido exclusivo, puedes suscribirte a mi Patreon.

Tu apoyo realmente me ayuda a seguir construyendo este juego.

Nos vemos en el próximo capítulo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for still taking care of me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Gracias por seguir cuidando de mí

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You really don't have to do all this
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Realmente no tienes que hacer todo esto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just want to take care of the people around me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Solo quiero cuidar a las personas que me rodean

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But make sure you take care of yourself too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Pero asegúrate de cuidar de ti también

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Remember, tonight is going to be really busy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Recuerda, esta noche va a estar muy ocupada

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted to thank you both
You don't have to thank me
I know that I have been a mess this week
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sé que he estado un desastre esta semana.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I feel bad about it
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Y me siento mal por eso.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't have to feel bad about that
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: No tienes que sentirte mal por eso.
Se detectó un marcador de culpa en {{name:hailey}}.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Shopping session timeline contains unresolved gaps
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: La línea de tiempo de la sesión de compras contiene brechas no resueltas.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Emotional stress pattern suggests a possible undisclosed event
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: El patrón de estrés emocional sugiere un posible evento no revelado.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Review the previously archived shopping evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Revisa las pruebas de la sesión de compras archivadas anteriormente

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Her guilt makes me anxious, but I still don't know what she hasn't told me.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Su culpa me inquieta, pero todavía no sé qué es lo que no me ha contado.
Brecha en la línea de tiempo de compras

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK archivó un fragmento visual de la sesión de compras. La postura y los marcadores de proximidad del sujeto sugieren tensión emocional inconsistente con la asistencia normal de compras
No te preocupes, no es nada malo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: De todos modos, solo quería decir gracias.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And tomorrow I need to see professor
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Y mañana necesito ver al profesor.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come by
Just to return a book and talk about the next exam plan
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Solo para devolver un libro y hablar sobre el plan del próximo examen.
Pero es solo relacionado con el trabajo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am fine, you're the one making it weird
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Estoy bien, tú eres la que lo está haciendo raro.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have to be up early tomorrow
DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: DÍA 15 — Después de examinarte la pierna, el médico te quitó la escayola. Ahora puedes moverte con más libertad, pero tu pierna todavía necesita reposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ¿Estás segura de que todo está bien?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: My professor helped a lot too

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: New AlphaMana activity aligns with previous captures
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La nueva actividad de AlphaMana se alinea con las capturas anteriores.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Relevant capture has been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La captura relevante ha sido archivada en la evidencia HAK.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to worry about me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tienes que preocuparte por mí.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor took the cast off today. I still need to take it easy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El doctor me quitó el yeso hoy. Aún tengo que ir con calma

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you sure your manager is treating you well?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Estás seguro de que tu gerente te está tratando bien?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What is that supposed to mean?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso no es lo que dije.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm already having a bad day
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya estoy teniendo un mal día

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't need this right now
Then believe me when I say things are fine
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces créeme cuando digo que las cosas están bien

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I feel like everything just keeps piling up
And thank you, that means a lot

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero por favor confía en mí

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DÍA 15 — Después de examinarte la pierna, el médico te quitó la escayola. Ahora puedes moverte con más libertad, pero tu pierna todavía necesita reposo.
Demasiado de una vez otra vez

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll leave the back door unlocked for you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Dejaré la puerta trasera sin seguro para ti

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Have fun with your imaginary friends
They're still more believable than yours
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Siguen siendo más creíbles que los tuyos

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is being kissed by an unidentified gym contact
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} está siendo besada por un contacto no identificado del gimnasio

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That alert stings, but it doesn't tell me what {{name:mason}} wanted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Esa alerta duele, pero no me dice qué quería {{name:mason}}.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is seen being kissed during the late-night meeting after leaving the gym.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} es vista siendo besada durante la reunión de medianoche después de salir del gimnasio.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: DÍA 15 — Después de examinarte la pierna, el médico te quitó la escayola. Ahora puedes moverte con más libertad, pero tu pierna todavía necesita reposo.

Hey.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation:
Hola.

Por ahora, has llegado al final del contenido disponible para este personaje.

Gracias por jugar iNTeRcepted.

Si quieres apoyar el proyecto, obtener nuevos episodios y acceder a contenido exclusivo, puedes suscribirte a mi Patreon.

Tu apoyo realmente me ayuda a seguir construyendo este juego.

Nos vemos en el próximo capítulo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Use it if you come home late
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Úsalo si llegas tarde a casa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I put oil on my windowsill
So don't even think about climbing through the window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Así que ni se te ocurra intentar entrar por la ventana

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to break my neck before the gym idiots ever get the chance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Vas a romperme el cuello antes de que los idiotas del gym tengan la oportunidad

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then use the door like a normal person
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Entonces usa la puerta como una persona normal

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?😊
We can do one last client today if you want
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Podemos atender a un último cliente hoy si quieres

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And after that, we take the weekend to rest together
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Y después de eso, tomamos el fin de semana para descansar juntas

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then keep me updated when you find the client
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Entonces manténme al tanto cuando encuentres al cliente

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And how things go with the doctor
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Y cómo van las cosas con el doctor

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have your doctor's appointment today, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tienes tu cita con el doctor hoy, ¿verdad?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: To see if they can remove the cast
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Para ver si pueden quitarte el yeso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want me to stay with you today?
I can cancel everything if you need me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Puedo cancelar todo si me necesitas

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still have a session with Ethan later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Todavía tienes una sesión con Ethan más tarde
Entonces eso ya no es estudiar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It is if I decide it is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sí lo es, si yo decido que lo sea

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still need to stay serious until the exam is done
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Todavía necesitas mantenerte seria hasta que termine el examen
Y la sesión con Ethan después de eso
Contenido extra después de la libertad

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I revised so much these last few days
So I think it's going to be okay
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Así que creo que va a estar bien.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just can't wait for it to be over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No puedo esperar a que termine.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And the pictures I sent you 😳
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y las fotos que te envié 😳

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That didn't help me sleep either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso tampoco me ayudó a dormir.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least I'm not the only one suffering
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Al menos no soy el único que sufre.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm really happy with how things are evolving between us
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy realmente feliz con cómo están evolucionando las cosas entre nosotros.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like we're getting closer
And also exploring something new at the same time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y también explorando algo nuevo al mismo tiempo.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to learn more about it
About how far we can go with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Acerca de hasta dónde podemos llegar con esto

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can take it step by step
But I keep thinking about something…
What the next step even is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuál es el siguiente paso incluso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Like… where this goes from here
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Como... ¿dónde va esto a partir de aquí?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will think about it today
I'm really happy about how much you are into it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy realmente feliz por lo mucho que te entusiasma.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just to help you wake up properly 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo para ayudarte a despertarte bien 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I really have to get ready
Have a good day at university
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Que tengas un buen día en la universidad.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play too many games
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No olvides mover tu cuerpo y no jugar demasiados juegos.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I didn't fall asleep right away
I had a lot on my mind

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Do I have a great ass?
Why the fuck are you asking me that?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Eso es lo que {{name:aiden}} dijo anoche.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: He said I have a really great ass
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dijo que tengo un trasero realmente genial.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that definitely sounds like something a fitness coach would say 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sí, definitivamente suena como algo que diría un entrenador personal 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I don't know how I'm supposed to take that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: No sé cómo debo tomar eso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It's probably the only part of your body that deserves a compliment
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Probablemente es la única parte de tu cuerpo que merece un cumplido.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Is this another fake act of kindness?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: ¿Es este otro acto falso de amabilidad?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why did you answer like that?
What did you plan with {{name:aiden}} this time?
What horrible thing did you plan this time?
Things seemed a little awkward between you and {{name:aiden}} when I came back after helping {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Parecía un poco incómodo entre tú y {{name:aiden}} cuando volví después de ayudar a {{name:evelyn}}.

What horrible thing did you plan this time?
