story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Parecía un poco incómodo entre tú y Chris cuando volví después de ayudar a {{name:evelyn}}.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Since she’s doing so well, I was thinking of giving her some extra time for the next session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Como está yendo tan bien, estaba pensando en darle un poco de tiempo extra para la próxima sesión

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: What do you mean by extra time?
I was thinking of letting her have a break during the session if she needs it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Estaba pensando en dejarla tomar un descanso durante la sesión si lo necesita

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: If it helps her stay focused, then it's a good idea
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Si le ayuda a mantenerse enfocada, entonces es una buena idea

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Just wanted to give you an update on {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Solo quería darte una actualización sobre {{name:hailey}}

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Her grades are getting noticeably better
She’s understanding the material much faster now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Ahora entiende el material mucho más rápido

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I think she's already ready for the exam of today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Creo que ya está lista para el examen de hoy

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I'm happy to see how much trust you have in this little demon 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Me alegra ver cuánto confías en esta pequeña demonio 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: She’s not a demon, she’s a hardworking student 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: No es un demonio, es una estudiante trabajadora 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Anyway, I wanted to ask you something
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: De todos modos, quería preguntarte algo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Do you already have a client for the afternoon?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Ya tienes un cliente para la tarde?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: The young guy from yesterday asked for you again
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: El chico joven de ayer te pidió de nuevo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He wants to spend the afternoon and evening with you if you are okay with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Quiere pasar la tarde y la noche contigo, si estás de acuerdo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He is offering $1500 to stay with him until tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Está ofreciendo $1500 para quedarse contigo hasta esta noche

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Same kind of thing as last time, acting like a couple while going to the aquarium and then to a restaurant tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo mismo que la última vez, actuando como pareja mientras vamos al acuario y luego a un restaurante esta noche
El doctor me quitó el yeso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I guess I should dress nicely then
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Supongo que debería vestirme bien entonces

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That would probably be better aha
The date is going really well

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Tarde en el acuario con Lucas

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: The aquarium was even better with you beside me. Thank you for staying close.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: El acuario fue aún mejor contigo a mi lado. Gracias por quedarte cerca.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It hurts a little, but it is much better now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Duele un poco, pero ya está mucho mejor
Contenido del acuario de Lucas desbloqueado.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am having a really good time 😊
Biometric activity increased during ongoing date
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: La actividad biométrica aumentó durante la cita en curso
Movimiento sostenido a corta distancia detectado

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Relevant capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Captura relevante archivada en la evidencia HAK

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: There is more between them now, and I need to be honest with myself about how that feels.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ahora hay algo más entre ellos, y necesito ser sincero conmigo mismo sobre lo que siento.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:evelyn}} sharing a consensual kiss with her returning client during the aquarium date
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Evidencia archivada en HAK de {{name:evelyn}} compartiendo un beso consensuado con su cliente recurrente durante la cita en el acuario

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I can walk more easily, I just need to rest
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Puedo caminar más fácil, solo necesito descansar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But are you really sure you want me to work today?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Pero estás realmente segura de que quieres que trabaje hoy?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am just going to rest anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: De todos modos, solo voy a descansar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: There were still some horrible questions😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero no me congelé del todo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't make me emotional in public 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No me hagas ponerme emocional en público 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Now I just want the results
I also can't wait to debrief with Ethan
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: También tengo ganas de hablar con Ethan

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe he'll even give you a reward if you did well
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quizás incluso te dé una recompensa si te fue bien

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm learning from your terrible system
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estoy aprendiendo de tu sistema terrible

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And I refuse to apologize for it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Y me niego a disculparme por ello

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have to eat and get ready before Ethan arrives
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tengo que comer y prepararme antes de que llegue Ethan

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I think it went pretty well
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Creo que me fue bastante bien

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I knew more than I expected
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sabía más de lo que esperaba

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A swimming pool? Seriously?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Una piscina? ¿En serio?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You and your best friend are never letting that go, are you?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tú y tu mejor amigo nunca dejarán eso, ¿verdad?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm going to kill you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Te voy a matar

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Good luck catching me from the deep end 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Buena suerte atrapándome desde el fondo 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Have fun
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Diviértete.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: A little water will do you good
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Un poco de agua te hará bien.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You do remember I can barely swim, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Recuerdas que apenas sé nadar, ¿verdad?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: No te preocupes

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:aiden}} is a really good swimmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:aiden}} es un muy buen nadador.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And what the fuck is this swimsuit you prepared for me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Y qué demonios es este traje de baño que preparaste para mí?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Unfortunately, that's the only one I could find
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Desafortunadamente, ese es el único que pude encontrar.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Te perseguiré para siempre por esto.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: No sé si eso lo hace mejor o peor
¿Eso es todo?
Todavía estás siendo cauteloso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sigo diciéndome que fue solo una decisión estúpida de medianoche

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Pero tampoco me arrepentí precisamente de haberla enviado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Esa es la parte que me molesta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Y todavía no sé si agradecerte o estar un poco molesta
¿Por qué te molesta?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Porque significa que quería que me vieras así

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Y no suelo hacer cosas así sin pensar en ello durante días
Simplemente... pasó
No me estoy quejando en absoluto
Lo sé

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Eso también es parte del problema

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Estás muy tranquilo con algo que aún me parece un poco peligroso
Yo tampoco estoy tan tranquila
¿Y peligroso cómo?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se ve mejor de lo que esperaba

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We’re living in the same house
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Estamos viviendo en la misma casa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si las cosas empiezan a cambiar, cambian rápido

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Y no estoy segura de estar lista para eso todavía

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: No tenemos que apresurarnos
Esa es una buena respuesta
Necesitaba escuchar eso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Está bien, voy a prepararme antes de seguir metiéndome en un lío
¿Hablamos después?
Claro
Me alegra que te guste
Deberías ponértelo hoy

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Te dije que tengo buen gusto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t sound so pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: No te sientas tan orgulloso de ti mismo
Es solo un outfit

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Puntos HAK suficientes acumulados

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: New skill available: Live Transcription
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nueva habilidad disponible: Transcripción en vivo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Captura conversaciones que ocurren en otros lugares monitoreando a personas de interés

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: HAK//HABILIDAD DISPONIBLE

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How does your leg feel this morning?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Cómo se siente tu pierna esta mañana?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Strange without the cast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Raro sin el yeso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sigo esperando sentir su peso cuando me muevo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Te duele?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un poco rígido. Estoy yendo despacio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're doing the short walk today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Entonces hoy haremos la caminata corta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hay un banco cerca de la entrada. Podemos parar allí cuando quieras

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Ya tienes un banco elegido?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. Very advanced date planning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sí. Muy avanzada la planificación de la cita

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Yo me encargo de la cena. Tú te encargas de los bancos

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nuestra cita hoy ☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A balanced relationship 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Una relación equilibrada 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Desayuno primero, aunque. No me voy con el estómago vacío

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Deja un poco de espacio para esta noche

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you making?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Qué estás preparando?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pasta, verduras asadas y postre

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You remembered dessert. Excellent start
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Recordaste el postre. Excelente comienzo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tendrás que esperar para descubrir qué es

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Está bien. Yo también tengo algo por lo que tendrás que esperar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿El atuendo?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Es raro que ya haya revisado el clima tres veces?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estoy usando el que elegiste ayer 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Y sí, compré tu otra opción también

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ahora me estás haciendo difícil concentrarme en la lista de compras

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Termina tu lista de compras. Quiero comer bien

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿Te encuentras conmigo en la entrada del parque a las tres?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Three it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A las tres entonces

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mándame un mensaje cuando salgas. Y no te apresures a llegar antes que yo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: No lo haré

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you this afternoon, love ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Nos vemos esta tarde, amor ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Depende. ¿Esperamos un huracán?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: No 😭

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Solo no quiero que nuestra cita en el parque se moje

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Encontraríamos un lugar para escondernos

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Usarías eso como excusa para estar muy cerca de mí

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Iba a hacer eso en buen clima también

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Entonces supongo que el pronóstico no importa ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: He estado aquí acostada repasando nuestra conversación de antes

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Sobre todo la parte en la que admití que quería que vieras esa foto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Todavía no puedo creer que lo dijera en voz alta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Fue bueno escucharlo, para ser honesta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Pero una vez que empecé a hablar, se sintió raro parar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Normalmente bromeo para salir de cualquier cosa que se sienta demasiado real

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Esta mañana no hice eso realmente

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Lo cual de alguna manera lo hizo peor

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
I was trying not to overdo it
I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Creo que lo manejaste mejor de lo que yo lo habría hecho

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly
Or were you just being polite?
You really didn’t have to say that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Realmente no tenías que decir eso
Pero me alegra que lo hicieras

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Al menos no soy la única

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Before I ask something even more dangerous
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Antes de que pregunte algo aún más peligroso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And… don’t overthink this too much either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Y... no pienses demasiado en esto tampoco

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: En el parque 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Así?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ahora tienes una foto de nuestra cita real en el parque

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mejor que la vista previa del domingo pasado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mucho mejor. Estás en esta conmigo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mi hombro apenas cuenta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Para mí cuenta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ahí. Ahora quiero ese hombro de vuelta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pasas un rato en el banco juntos. {{name:lena}} se apoya en ti mientras hablan, luego te acompaña en otro tramo corto del camino. Antes de irse, comparten un helado cerca de la entrada.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Listo para volver?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Estoy en la entrada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sí. Creo que mi pierna ha tenido suficiente caminata por hoy.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Entonces vamos directo a tu casa. Puedes descansar antes de la cena.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Y puedes hacerme compañía.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eso ya era parte del plan.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Salen del parque juntos y van directamente a tu casa. Una vez dentro, {{name:lena}} deja su bolso junto al sofá y te ayuda a acomodarte con la pierna sobre un cojín.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Mejor?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mucho. Me alegra que hayamos evitado el largo recorrido.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Me gustó nuestro banco. Especialmente antes de que ese perro intentara robar el siguiente.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Él sabía exactamente lo que quería.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Yo también.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Por cierto, la pequeña heladería está abierta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} se sienta a tu lado y apoya su mano sobre la tuya.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mi parte favorita fue que te negaste a soltar mi mano para comer.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Me las arreglé perfectamente.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tienes helado en mi pulgar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un pequeño problema técnico.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tenemos tiempo antes de que tenga que empezar a cocinar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien. Quédate aquí conmigo un rato.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: No voy a discutir eso.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pasas el resto de la tarde juntos en el sofá. {{name:lena}} se queda con la ropa que elegiste ayer, y dejas que tu pierna descanse antes de ir a la cocina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Encontraste eso antes de encontrarme?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Estoy recopilando información útil

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mira a tu izquierda

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oh ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} guarda su teléfono y se acerca a ti. Te besa y luego entrelaza su mano con la tuya. Toman el camino corto por el parque, deteniéndose en un banco cuando tu pierna empieza a cansarse.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: UN POCO DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Acércate. Quiero una foto de nosotros en este banco.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Temprano en la tarde, en tu casa. Después de descansar juntos, van a la cocina a preparar la cena.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Evidencia de que realmente cocinaste para mí

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y que robaste un pedazo antes de que lo sirviera

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Control de calidad

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Verdict?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Veredicto?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very good. I'm keeping the cook
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muy bien. Me quedo con la cocinera

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a relief
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eso es un alivio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ahora pruébalo antes de que se enfríe tu comida.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Después de la cena, traes el postre al sofá. {{name:lena}} pliega sus piernas a tu lado, evitando cuidadosamente tu pierna adolorida. Pones una película, pero sigues pausándola para hablar.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: LUEGO ESA NOCHE

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What can I do?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué puedo hacer?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here a second.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ven aquí un segundo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te inclinas más cerca y la besas. {{name:lena}} te atrae más, sonriendo contra tus labios.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss on the Sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un beso en el sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UN POCO DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more for today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Una más por hoy

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te ves muy satisfecho contigo mismo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tuve una cita en el parque, cena, postre y un muy buen lugar en tu sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Buen lugar?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eres mi invitado. Puedes sentarte ahí y juzgar mi cocina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Justo al lado de ti

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aunque creo que he estado apoyada en tu brazo durante veinte minutos

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vale la pena

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dime si tu pierna empieza a molestarte, ¿vale?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Está bien así

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'd like to stay a little longer
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entonces me gustaría quedarme un poco más

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd like that too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A mí también me gustaría eso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dejas tus teléfonos en la mesa y se acomodan juntos. El resto de la noche pasa en conversación y besos. Cuando {{name:lena}} finalmente se va, la acompañas a la puerta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: LUEGO

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: En casa ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu invitado puede picar una verdura. Dame una tabla.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Gracias por avisarme

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dejé mi bolso al lado de tu sofá

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo encontré

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Una razón extremadamente convincente para volver

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No necesitas una razón

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo sé. Aún quiero mi bolso 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿La cena cumplió con la promesa?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sí

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pero lo mejor fue estar ahí contigo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y besarte para despedirme sin querer ir a ningún lado

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Está bien. Las verduras son tuyas.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly asked you to stay
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Casi te pido que te quedes

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly went back inside
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Casi vuelvo a entrar

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Next time, ask me 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La próxima vez, pregúntame 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo haré

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ahora descansa. Has hecho más hoy de lo que has hecho en un tiempo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ya estoy en la cama

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buenas noches, amor. Gracias por hoy ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buenas noches. Me encantó tenerte aquí

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y tú puedes sentarte mientras yo las hago.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're taking over my kitchen already.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ya estás apoderándote de mi cocina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo el picado. Me prometiste la cena, así que la salsa sigue siendo tu problema.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} lava y pica las verduras mientras tú preparas la salsa. Te sientas entre tareas, y ella trae los platos a la mesa una vez que la cena está lista.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: CENA

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nueva habilidad disponible: Transcripción en Vivo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Captura conversaciones que ocurren en otros lugares monitoreando a personas de interés

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No quiero más estrés encima de todo lo demás

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y ya estoy feliz con el diploma que tengo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No necesito seguir acumulando presión solo porque puedo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se lo diré esta tarde cuando entregue el libro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Siento que es el momento adecuado para decirlo
Está bien... solo mantenme al tanto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Está bien. Mándame un mensaje cuando salgas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: He estado pensando en esto unos días ya

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m not taking the next exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No voy a presentar los próximos exámenes

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I thought about it properly this time

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No solo fue un pensamiento de pánico

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¡Buenos días ❤️! ¿Cómo va tu primera mañana sin el yeso?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces nada de celebrar intentando caminar por toda la ciudad hoy

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahí se va mi tarde

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sé que estás bromeando, pero te estoy vigilando 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Through the walls?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿A través de las paredes?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Normalmente te delatas eventualmente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dirás que fuiste a dar un pequeño paseo y luego mencionarás una tienda a tres calles

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a very specific accusation
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa es una acusación muy específica

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso es porque conozco a mi novio ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Para que conste, mi gran aventura hasta ahora fue llegar a la cocina

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you make it back alive?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Regresaste vivo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Todavía levanté la manta como si tuviera ese yeso enorme debajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Barely, the coffee was terrible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Apenas, el café estaba terrible

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu café siempre sabe como si tuvieras un rencor contra los granos

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It wakes me up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me despierta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: También lo haría una alarma de incendios, no bebes eso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eres muy hablador para alguien que no ha salido de la cama

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excuse you, I'm dressed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Disculpa, estoy vestida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Incluso he empacado mi bolso y encontrado ambos zapatos

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both? Big morning for us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ambos? Gran mañana para nosotros

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't ruin my achievements 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No arruines mis logros 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Desayunaste también o fue suficiente encontrar los zapatos?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu cerebro aún no se ha puesto al día 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast and a banana
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tostada y un plátano

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tostada estaba un poco más tostada de lo planeado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Burnt
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quemada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Crispy 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Crujiente 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Eso fue antes o después de que insultaste mi café?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do two things badly at once, thank you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedo hacer dos cosas mal al mismo tiempo, gracias

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now that sounds like the girl I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahora eso suena como la chica que conozco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La chica que conoces también está asegurándose de que realmente vayas a tomar descansos hoy

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Soy

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un poco de caminar por casa, luego los ejercicios que me mostraron ayer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, esperaba que el yeso se quedara para siempre

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No heroic expedition
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nada de expediciones heroicas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien ❤️ Prefiero esperar un poco más que verte lastimarte de nuevo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Es agradable no sentirme atrapado en el mismo lugar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I bet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Apuesto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuando te sientas más cómoda, podemos ir a algún lugar sin que tengas que planear cada paso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somewhere with decent coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿A algún lugar con buen café?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y sillas, no te llevaré a hacer senderismo 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really know how to spoil me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Realmente sabes cómo mimarme

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estaba pensando en café y un pastelito, pero sigue hablando y puedes tomar agua

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No digas eso, yo también estaba empezando a creerlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll behave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me comportaré

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There we go 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahí vamos 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's your day looking like?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo se ve tu día?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning, then work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Clases esta mañana, luego trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Necesito terminar de revisar una hoja de cálculo esta tarde antes de que alguien más la use mañana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds dangerously responsible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena peligrosamente responsable

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying not to think about it like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy tratando de no pensarlo así

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Principalmente estoy deseando no llevar mis apuntes de la universidad junto con mis cosas del trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not much longer now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No falta mucho ahora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know ❤️ I'm counting down
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sé ❤️ Estoy contando los días

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep better without it?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Dormiste mejor sin él?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, before I leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, antes de que me vaya

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De hecho, logré vestirme sin arrugar todo esta vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Disfrútalo mientras dure, mi bolso probablemente destruirá esa camisa en diez minutos 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te ves hermosa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You answered suspiciously fast
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Respondiste sospechosamente rápido

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't need much thinking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No necesitaba mucho pensar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien, esa fue una buena respuesta ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do I get the pastry back?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Me devuelves el pastelito?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never losing the pastry
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nunca ibas a perder el pastelito

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, until I got up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mucho mejor, hasta que me levanté

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was just going to make you ask nicely
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo iba a hacer que pidieras amablemente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Cruel woman
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mujer cruel

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu mujer cruel tiene que irse ahora o perderá su autobús 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dime cómo te va cuando te escriba a la hora del almuerzo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will, good luck with the morning
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo haré, buena suerte con la mañana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias guapo ❤️ Te amo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo también

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: My leg still feels like it belongs to somebody else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi pierna aún se siente como si perteneciera a otra persona

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Stiff?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Rigida?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, and a bit shaky when I first stand up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, y un poco temblorosa cuando me levanto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, how’s it going over there?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¡Hey! ¿Cómo va todo por allá?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s being really calm about the whole thing
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Está siendo muy tranquilo con todo esto.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It makes it harder to just drop the bomb and leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es más difícil simplemente soltar la bomba y largarme.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ve thought about it a lot… I don’t want to take the next exams.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: He pensado mucho en esto... No quiero hacer los próximos exámenes.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}}. If you skip them, you won’t get the diploma.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}. Si los saltas, no obtendrás el diploma.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Fuck, well That’s why I’m telling you now.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mierda, por eso te lo digo ahora.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: …Is there really no other way?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: …¿De verdad no hay otra opción?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What are you proposing, exactly?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Qué propones, exactamente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t know… maybe we can find something that works for both of us.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No sé... tal vez podamos encontrar algo que funcione para los dos.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re good at finding solutions, what do you suggest?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Eres buena encontrando soluciones, ¿qué sugieres?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Everything’s fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Todo bien

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Event intensity increased
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La intensidad del evento ha aumentado.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Communication patterns show increased emotional reliance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Los patrones de comunicación muestran una mayor dependencia emocional

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Workplace influence markers continue to rise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Los marcadores de influencia en el trabajo siguen en aumento.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Physical proximity exceeds standard academic baseline
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La proximidad física supera el estándar académico.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Additional evidence archived for review
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Evidencia adicional archivada para revisión.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to trust her, but this no longer feels like ordinary academic help.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quiero confiar en ella, pero esto ya no parece una simple ayuda académica.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a moment of reduced personal distance during the private discussion. The professor’s hand remained on {{name:hailey}}’s arm for an extended period while she spoke about her academic future.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK archivó un momento de menor distancia personal durante la conversación privada. La mano de la profesora permaneció sobre el brazo de {{name:hailey}} durante un tiempo prolongado mientras hablaba sobre su futuro académico.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Closer Contact
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo siento, pero no puedo ayudar con eso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll think about your proposal.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a pensar en tu propuesta.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But it's a dangerous and non ethical one.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero es algo peligroso y poco ético.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If your in i'm in, and it's a win win, i'm a catch you know.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si tú estás dentro, yo también, y es un ganar-ganar, soy un buen partido, ya sabes.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway,i’m going to head home now before it gets more awkward.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: De todos modos, me voy a casa ahora antes de que se ponga más incómodo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you for listening to me.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Gracias por escucharme.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry I went quiet for a second
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo siento, me quedé en silencio un momento.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He just asked me something and I had to answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Él solo me preguntó algo y tuve que responder.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We’re talking about the next exams right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estamos hablando de los próximos exámenes ahora mismo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Take your time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tómate tu tiempo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm done talking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: He terminado de hablar.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll text you when I’m home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Te mando un mensaje cuando llegue a casa.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: See you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Nos vemos

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s listening properly for once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Está escuchando bien por una vez.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you already tell him your decision?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Ya le dijiste tu decisión?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Not yet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aún no

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m getting there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy en camino.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s just… taking a bit longer than I thought
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo que... está tomando un poco más de tiempo de lo que pensé.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Estás bien?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over and I've got a little time before work, how's your first day of freedom going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hola 😊 Las clases han terminado y tengo un poco de tiempo antes del trabajo, ¿cómo va tu primer día de libertad?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And no spreadsheets
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y nada de hojas de cálculo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that now. If you bring one, I'm leaving you there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dices eso ahora. Si traes una, te dejo ahí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave whenever you like
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes irte cuando quieras

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, but I'd rather not spend my first evening out hearing about work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé, pero prefiero no pasar mi primera noche fuera escuchando sobre trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just wanted to make sure you still wanted to go
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo quería asegurarme de que aún quisieras ir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo lo hago

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves muy satisfecho contigo mismo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I not be?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿No debería estarlo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No dije eso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly awkward, I'm taking it slowly
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sobre todo incómodo, lo estoy tomando con calma

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll try not to overdo it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces intentaré no exagerar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not trying very hard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo estás intentando muy duro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The manager moves closer and initiates a kiss
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: El gerente se acerca y inicia un beso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He just kissed {{name:lena}}. My hands have gone cold, and for a second I can't even take in what I'm seeing.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acaba de besar a {{name:lena}}. Se me han quedado frías las manos, y por un segundo ni siquiera puedo asimilar lo que estoy viendo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Crossing the Line
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cruzando la Línea

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait... what are you doing?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera... ¿qué estás haciendo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I shouldn't have done that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo siento. No debí haber hecho eso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, you shouldn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, no deberías

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll step back
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me daré un paso atrás

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have a boyfriend
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo un novio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bueno ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you can't just kiss me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces no puedes simplemente besarme así

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tienes razón

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't expecting that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo esperaba

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My bad, your right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi error, tienes razón

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to get back to work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Necesito volver al trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you need to stop looking at me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y necesitas dejar de mirarme así

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will try
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo intentaré

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should try harder
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deberías esforzarte más

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How was your morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo estuvo tu mañana?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I cancel tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Debería cancelar mañana?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Estás seguro?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to go. I just... I need a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aún quiero ir. Solo... necesito un minuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Toma uno

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, preferably
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo, preferiblemente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll finish the last checks at my desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Terminaré las últimas revisiones en mi escritorio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can send it over when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes enviarlo cuando estés listo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Let me get my phone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Déjame buscar mi teléfono

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The professor spent ages explaining something that wasn't even on the right slide
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: El profesor se pasó horas explicando algo que ni siquiera estaba en la diapositiva correcta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her shift, at the bus stop...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Después de su turno, en la parada del autobús...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Sorry, I thought I'd be able to text sooner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy fuera ❤️ Lo siento, pensé que podría enviar un mensaje antes

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you sort out the spreadsheet?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Organizaste la hoja de cálculo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, al final

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We started with the wrong printout, so that was a great use of everyone's time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Empezamos con la impresión equivocada, así que fue un gran uso del tiempo de todos 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The expensive sandwich deserved a better afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: El sándwich caro merecía una mejor tarde

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I was hungry again an hour later, so it didn't even do its job
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y tenía hambre otra vez una hora después, así que ni siquiera cumplió su función

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Heading home now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Vas a casa ahora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Waiting for the bus, unless it decides not to exist again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esperando el autobús, a menos que decida no existir otra vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it late?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Es tarde?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone finally told him and he just went 'yes, that's for next week'
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alguien finalmente se lo dijo y él solo respondió 'sí, eso es para la próxima semana'

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It says four minutes. It also said four minutes when I got here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dice cuatro minutos. También decía cuatro minutos cuando llegué aquí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I found a seat
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos encontré un asiento

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Long afternoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Tarde larga?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Longer than I expected, yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más larga de lo que esperaba, sí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Todo bien?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, just a lot going round in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, solo hay mucho dando vueltas en mi cabeza

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need food and a bit of time not looking at numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Necesito comida y un poco de tiempo sin mirar números

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can talk about something incredibly unimportant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedo hablar de algo increíblemente poco importante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, hazlo 😭 ¿Cómo te fue en tu gran viaje por la casa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muy tranquilizador

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Descubrí que el sofá seguía donde lo dejé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A successful expedition then
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una expedición exitosa entonces

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y me detuve cuando mi pierna empezó a cansarse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mira, en realidad me estás escuchando ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't sound so surprised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No suenes tan sorprendido

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy disfrutando el momento, déjame tenerlo 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel like watching something together later?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te apetece ver algo juntos más tarde?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Juntos como en discutir sobre la misma película desde diferentes casas?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente eso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encontré una película de detectives que se ve terrible y no quiero sufrir solo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pasé diez minutos pensando que yo era el problema 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Haces una oferta tan convincente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Say yes, I've already saved it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di que sí, ya lo he guardado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, lo veremos cuando estés lista
