story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien ❤️ Mi autobús finalmente ha llegado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te escribiré cuando llegue a casa, luego organizaré la cena

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos en un rato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Lograste comer algo antes del trabajo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un sándwich del lugar cerca de la parada de autobús

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Costó lo suficiente como para que revisara la bolsa por un segundo sándwich

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: He pasado por dos habitaciones y me he puesto un zapato adecuado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Había uno?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, just a napkin and disappointment
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, solo una servilleta y decepción

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos he encontrado un lugar para sentarme un minuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No pareces tan decepcionado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aún no había abierto el sándwich 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te dejaré disfrutar de tu almuerzo tan caro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más te vale comer algo también

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ya lo hice

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, one less person to supervise 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, una persona menos para supervisar 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mira, subiendo en el mundo 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Ahora supervisas a gente en el trabajo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sobre todo una hoja de cálculo que se niega a sumar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi jefe quiere revisarlo conmigo cuando llegue

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos no estarás atrapado haciéndolo solo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exacto, y así puede dejar de ocupar espacio en mi cabeza

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo que irme, te escribiré cuando salga ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que tengas una buena tarde

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más tarde esa tarde, en la oficina del gerente...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversación de oficina detectada cerca de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una hoja de cálculo, eso fue lo que dijo. Quiero que sea una tarde normal de trabajo, pero no puedo dejar de mirar la pantalla.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPCIÓN EN VIVO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Es esa la versión que me enviaste esta mañana?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ponerse el zapato fue la parte difícil

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It should be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Debería serlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this total is different
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque este total es diferente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, no me digas que he impreso la antigua

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tú dime

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo cambié antes de clase. Revisa el archivo en tu pantalla

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Este?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, mira abajo. La figura está justo ahí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces la hoja de cálculo está bien y la impresión no

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exacto. Lo que significa que he pasado mi almuerzo preocupándome por un problema que ya solucioné

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y he estado escribiendo notas en la copia equivocada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Lo intentaste de pie?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bueno, la tuya va directo a la basura junto con la mía

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podrías haberlo revisado antes de imprimirlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podrías haberlo revisado antes de escribir en cada página

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, me alegra que hayamos acordado que esto es un desastre compartido

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ven aquí. Muéstrame qué cambiaste

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahí, esa línea se incluyó dos veces

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me perdí eso ayer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Me dijiste que revisara mi cálculo otra vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y lo hiciste

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una vez

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tres veces, porque pensé que debías saber algo que yo no

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deberías haberme dicho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acabo de hacerlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco antes te habría ahorrado tiempo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces la próxima vez podré decir 'te lo dije' mientras aún estás en la habitación

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Creo que te lo has ganado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a recordar que dijiste eso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dos sujetos de pie juntos al lado del escritorio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Están tan cerca. No dejo de repetirme que es trabajo, pero verlos juntos así me hace un nudo en el estómago.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demasiado cerca

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parece que te sientes más cómodo aquí ahora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sabía

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Con el trabajo? Un poco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso no era exactamente lo que quería decir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces tal vez deberías ser más específico

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Los primeros días te quedabas junto a la puerta cada vez que traías algo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque siempre parecías ocupado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y ahora?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora sé que la mitad del tiempo solo estás mirando los mismos números que yo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así que soy menos intimidante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No dije que fueras intimidante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo no querías acercarte más

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me senté antes de que pudieras notar algo raro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sabes, notas mucho para alguien con tanto trabajo por hacer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algunas cosas son difíciles de no notar

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo estás haciendo de nuevo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Haciendo qué?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mirándome en lugar de la pantalla

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Has terminado de explicar la hoja de cálculo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso no es una respuesta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No era la intención

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De verdad no lo haces fácil

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Hacer qué fácil?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demasiado tarde, lo sentí 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mantener la cara seria cuando se supone que debo estar trabajando

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco más tarde, después de que termine el papeleo...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Seguimos en pie para mañana?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿La bebida?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, la bebida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dije que vendría, ¿no?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También dijiste que podrías estar cansada después del trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Probablemente lo estaré. Aún puedo sentarme en algún lugar que no sea esta silla

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hay un lugar a un par de calles. ¿Alrededor de las siete?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Las siete está bien

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablando en serio, ¿te duele o solo es incómodo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Fue lo más inteligente que pude hacer.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if it means more work
He’s going to help me deeply this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Él me va a ayudar a fondo esta vez.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Gracias por preguntar por mí antes.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Al final, tengo que hacer los exámenes.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Él dejó claro que no obtendré el diploma de otra manera.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Está bien… pero dijiste que tal vez tenías una solución?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Voy a tener que pasar más tiempo con él para los exámenes.
Sesiones extra, ese tipo de cosas.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eso está bien, de hecho. Me alegra que hayas cambiado de opinión.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ Estoy en casa y tratando de hacer la cena antes de nuestra muy seria noche de películas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ni siquiera estuvo en la segunda mitad

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba trabajando con la información disponible en ese momento 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
I trusted the scarf too much
A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un error que cualquier gran detective podría cometer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deja de reírte, al menos la película fue tan mala como prometí

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fue más agradable verlo contigo, aunque

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El Tú Futuro siempre encuentra algo de qué quejarse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extrañaba esto, solo hablar de algo tonto contigo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deberíamos hacerlo de nuevo, pero tú eliges la próxima

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No puedes culparme por el final de tu carrera de detective esta noche

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso no fue lo que pasó

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa es la historia a la que me aferro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me voy a la cama antes de que me convenzas de ver una mejor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo cuando el Yo Presente deja los platos sucios 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tú también, guapo ❤️ Me alegra que hoy haya sido un poco más fácil para tu pierna

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
Love you
Love you too ❤️
Good night ❤️
Good night
How much have you created so far?
One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una sartén, un bol, una cuchara

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y una segunda cuchara porque puse la primera en un lugar tonto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te reirás menos cuando veas mi obra maestra

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí, comida de verdad y no hay fuego a la vista

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
Attempting doesn't sound promising
It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: También sabe bien, estoy casi sospechando 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
Moral support
I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo recordaré la próxima vez que cocine

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, he cenado y estoy acomodado en el sofá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien ❤️ Me pongo al día una vez que guarde el resto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te acostumbres, solo estoy haciendo esto porque salgo mañana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Casi pongo la sartén vacía y dejé la pasta en el armario

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Con el compañero de trabajo que mencionaste la otra noche?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
My manager, actually
Your manager?
Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, hablamos de ello otra vez hoy

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
I did
I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Debería haber sido más clara sobre a quién me refería

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
No, just us
So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que estamos teniendo un gran comienzo 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo es una bebida después del trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay un bar a un par de calles de la oficina

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alrededor de las siete, así que iré directo del trabajo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
Yeah, I do
I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He pasado la mayor parte de la semana yendo de clase al trabajo y a casa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustaría hacer algo que no sea una de esas tres cosas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
Maybe start with the water
Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salir solo con tu jefe es un poco diferente a lo que imaginé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Especialmente después de lo que dijiste sobre cómo te mira de manera diferente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probablemente no debería haberle dado tanta importancia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me lo dijiste porque te molestaba

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero no me siento incómoda a su alrededor

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
Yes, he knows
I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No quiero que esto se convierta en una discusión

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo agua, no estoy completamente perdida

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo no quiero descubrir que solo he estado escuchando la mitad de la historia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por eso te digo a dónde vamos y con quién

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje cuando llegue

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
Of course
All right
I do want to spend time with you too, you know
What's for dinner?
I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Echo de menos verte en lugar de solo esperar mensajes

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjame ver cuándo termino en los próximos días y organizamos algo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
Me too
And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y no quiero que nuestra noche se pierda mientras estoy al lado de una sartén

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a cambiarme y ponerme cómoda, luego soy toda tuya para esta película horrible

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
A little later...
Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, he guardado las sobras y me he cambiado

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pasta, salsa de tomate y lo que queda de queso de la semana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sin ropa de trabajo, sin platos frente a mí, sin números

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
It was in the bowl the entire time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba en el tazón todo el tiempo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course it was
I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Confío en ti con esa información, sé amable 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Incluso he reclamado el mejor lado del sofá

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí es donde quisiera estar ahora mismo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Has ocupado la mitad del sofá con esa manta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Compartiría la manta, no el buen cojín 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
You'd take it
Yeah, I would
Soon ❤️
Are you at the beginning of the film?
Paused at the first frame
Okay, three, two, one... play
After the film...
So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces, sobre el hombre de la bufanda roja

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy haciendo suficiente para mañana también, así que el Yo Futuro no puede quejarse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nueva habilidad disponible: Transcripción en Vivo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Captura conversaciones que ocurren en otros lugares monitoreando a personas de interés

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ya estoy lo suficientemente estresada sin tus comentarios.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ayer me estabas enviando ciertas fotos.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y hoy estás esperando tus notas como una estudiante responsable.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Te escribiré cuando tenga los resultados.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tener un tutor privado que conoce a la gente tiene sus ventajas 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¡Hey 😊! Primer mañana sin el yeso, ¿cómo se siente?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y me lo encontré de frente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias por hacer esto posible

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De nada, desafortunadamente 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero en serio, ¿estás cómodo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Más o menos. Aún se siente rígido cuando me levanto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No estoy exactamente listo para salir corriendo por la calle

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, porque no iba a perseguirte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ni un poquito?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te seguiría con una expresión muy decepcionada

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, esta es la cara que tendrías

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Raro, en realidad

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Terrorífica

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te funciona

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Realmente lo es.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me alegra que por fin te hayan quitado el yeso ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuando vi tu mensaje ayer, quise ir y abrazarte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Esa oferta sigue en pie?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obviamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aunque también quiero una tarde contigo en la que ninguno de los dos pase la mitad preguntando por tu pierna

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podríamos encontrar un pequeño café en algún lugar, cuando esté listo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me desperté y moví la manta como si aún tuviera que hacerle espacio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gustaría eso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Extraño sentarme frente a ti y robarte algo de tu plato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hermoso. Eso es lo que extrañas de mí

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entre otras cosas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero sobre todo tu terrible hábito de pedir algo más rico que lo mío

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Siempre dices que no tienes hambre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No tengo hambre hasta que llega tu comida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Situación completamente diferente 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hablando de comida, ¿has desayunado?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Café

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te encariñaste con él 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso es una bebida

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mira quién se ha vuelto de repente responsable

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aprendí de una mujer muy estricta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Suena encantadora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molesta. Aunque muy bonita

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso te salvó ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, te demostraré que estoy comiendo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tostada, café y una mujer que definitivamente va a llegar tarde si sigue enviándote mensajes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pasamos mucho tiempo juntos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te ves encantadora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se suponía que debías notar la tostada

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Noté ambas cosas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien, lo permitiré.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Clases todo el día?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esta mañana, y luego trabajo con mi grupo después del almuerzo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pasamos veinte minutos ayer decidiendo quién debía enviar un documento que todos ya tenían.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un comienzo prometedor.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exacto. Llevaré bocadillos y bajaré mis expectativas.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parece que eres el único preparado.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Debería ponerme celoso?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Emocionalmente, para nada.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y no he olvidado de lo que hablamos anoche.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quiero pensar bien en el primer paso, no mientras busco mi otro zapato.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No me gustaría competir con el zapato.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Actualmente está ganando.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo encontré. Ambos zapatos están puestos, así que ahora no tengo excusa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una última foto antes de irme, ya que no puedes estar aquí para distraerme en persona.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me estás haciendo muy difícil animarte a irte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Era una relación muy solidaria

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se supone que debes desearme suerte, no hacerme extrañarte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedo hacer ambas cosas.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sé que puedes ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mándame un mensaje cuando tengas un momento tranquilo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo haré ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y deja un poco de espacio en tu agenda para ese abrazo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voy a cancelar mi cita con el sofá

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dile que lo siento 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh Dios mío

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo has estado guardando desde ayer, ¿verdad?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Desde que el doctor lo quitó

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: También obtuviste algunas recompensas muy interesantes en el camino

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que técnicamente no necesito seguir estudiando tanto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aún deberías pasar los exámenes restantes para estar segura. Mantener a Ethan un poco más es un ganar-ganar.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Trabajaste lo suficiente. Quizás sea hora de hacer algo diferente a los libros por un tiempo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿O eres tú quien quiere que siga viendo a Ethan? 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo estoy pensando en tu diploma

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A veces puedo ser una buena persona

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero cuando lo soy, tengo razón

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a mantener a Ethan para los próximos exámenes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:aiden}} ha empezado a hacer sesiones de entrenamiento de nuevo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Has estado atrapado estudiando durante semanas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Moverte un poco no te mataría

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Especialmente si quieres mantener tu cuerpo en forma para el verano

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ten cuidado, puedo ser pequeña pero aún puedo patearte el trasero 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Siento que necesito moverme de nuevo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Hey! Finalmente tengo tiempo para comer sin que alguien me pregunte sobre nuestro proyecto grupal 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ciertamente tenía más información disponible

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Duro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preciso 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero me ayudó a aclarar algo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quiero poder hablar con alguien normalmente primero

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No quiero elegir a alguien solo porque estamos emocionados por probar algo nuevo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No quiero que tú hagas eso tampoco

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y quiero que él sepa que estoy en una relación

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No quiero llegar a la mitad de una conversación y sentir que he ocultado la parte importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De acuerdo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No estoy segura de cómo escribir eso sin que mi perfil suene como un anuncio muy serio.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Empieza con un hola. Probablemente deja fuera una introducción formal de tu novio.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Quieres decir que no has preparado uno?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podría incluir referencias.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡De ninguna manera 😭!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustaría que leyeras lo que escribo, aunque.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No para elegir a alguien por mí. Solo porque esto es nuevo y preferiría no sentirme sola haciéndolo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y cuando dije que alguien que no conocemos podría ser más simple, no quise decir que debas confiar en la primera persona que responda.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encontraste un lugar soleado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Menos incómoda con nuestros amigos no significa automáticamente que me sienta cómoda con él.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así que esta noche escribiré algo y elegiré una foto normal.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mañana puedo decidir si estoy feliz de publicarlo y empezar una conversación.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso suena como un plan de verdad.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un plan un poco nervioso, pero sí.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso está permitido.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También me reservo el derecho de quejarme contigo sobre perfiles terribles.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa parte nunca estuvo en duda.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, y mi almuerzo no ha hecho ni una sola pregunta sobre la presentación

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensé que la parte difícil sería admitir que tenía curiosidad.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora estoy pensando en cómo empezar una conversación sin sonar completamente diferente a mí misma.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No necesitas convertirte de repente en una persona increíblemente segura.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, porque todavía ensayo las llamadas telefónicas antes de pedir comida.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y luego me dices que llame en su lugar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque me amas 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Desafortunadamente para mi factura de teléfono

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quiero intentarlo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo quiero que el primer paso se sienta como algo que elegí, no como algo en lo que me apresuré porque tuvimos una buena conversación

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Excelente compañía

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces empezamos desde ahí

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Necesito volver. Han encontrado otra razón para discutir las diapositivas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mantente fuerte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me llevo el resto de mi almuerzo. Es lo único en lo que confío ahora mismo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás invitado la próxima vez. Siempre y cuando traigas tus propias papas fritas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: He estado pensando en ayer

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Principalmente sobre lo que realmente me sentiría cómoda haciendo primero

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y lograste avanzar en algo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Un poco más allá de solo estar sentada preguntándome qué te gustaría

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Lograste escapar?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: El hecho de que mencionaras a {{name:aiden}} ha hecho que cosas muy ordinarias se sientan menos ordinarias

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué cosas?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me preguntó si tenía las notas de nuestra última clase

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente solo las enviaría

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hoy estuve mirando el mensaje un tiempo tonto antes de recordar que literalmente estaba pidiendo las notas de clase

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, dime que no le enviaste una respuesta misteriosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Temporalmente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él recibió las notas. Muy emocionante, ¿verdad?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tranquila, te estás adelantando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cállate

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero esa es la cosa. Ya es parte de mi vida normal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si hablamos de esto y se siente raro después, aún lo veré por el campus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. No había pensado en el próximo almuerzo normal juntos

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo sí

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No creo que eso signifique que no debamos hablarle

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo no quiero tratarlo como si le estuviera pidiendo que se una a nosotros para un juego

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entiendo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dije que necesitaba almorzar y alguien preguntó si podíamos discutir las diapositivas mientras comía

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo te gustaría mencionarlo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sola, para empezar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prefiero tener una conversación un poco incómoda que intentar explicar algo personal con mis amigos escuchando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y probablemente ofreciendo consejos que nadie pidió

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él viene. Te enviaré un mensaje cuando tenga un momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENTO DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Hay alguien sentado aquí?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depende. ¿Estás aquí para robarme el almuerzo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Les lanzaste las diapositivas?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alguien se une a la mesa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversación en curso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un asiento inesperado

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Iba a preguntar sobre las notas, pero ahora que mencionaste el almuerzo...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tú tienes las notas. Ese es tu regalo de hoy

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Generoso como siempre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Estás bien? Te veías muy distante antes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Solo estaba pensando en algo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Algo en lo que pueda ayudar?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quizá. Prefiero hablarlo cuando haya más tranquilidad

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversación continúa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Atención dirigida hacia el otro hablante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo consideré

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algo que decir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh. Está bien

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No te veas tan preocupado, no es nada malo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No estaba preocupado hasta que dijiste eso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Genial, ahora lo he hecho sonar dramático

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me puedes decir cuando estés listo. Solo venía a agradecerte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Por las notas?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por salvarme de admitir que no había escrito nada de eso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahí está. Me preguntaba por qué estabas siendo tan amable

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedo ser amable sin querer algo a cambio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero encontré una mesa afuera, así que elijo el crecimiento personal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces quita tu mano de mis papas fritas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buen punto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Intercambio juguetón en la mesa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Risas compartidas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gusta saber que se ríe, aunque todavía me estoy acostumbrando a la idea de verlos juntos.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Negociaciones de almuerzo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien, tengo mi teléfono para mí otra vez

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Todo bien?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Solo tuvimos una conversación normal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Casi lo menciono, pero había gente sentada justo al lado nuestro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él sabe que quiero hablar de algo. No sabe qué es

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Orgulloso de ti

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo se sintió eso?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Menos aterrador de lo que esperaba

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aunque intentó robarme el almuerzo, así que no podía tomarlo demasiado en serio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso suena familiar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mañana encontraré un momento más tranquilo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quiero ver si realmente podemos hablar de eso antes de decidir cualquier otra cosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien. Cuéntame cómo te sientes esta noche

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gracias 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Descargué una app durante mi descanso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿De verdad?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo para ver cómo era. No he puesto un perfil ni le he escrito a nadie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, estoy tratando de recordar cómo volver a la pantalla de perfil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENTO DESPUÉS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Listo, lo encontré

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Era menos intimidante cuando dejé de tratar a cada hombre en la pantalla como si fuera una decisión de vida enorme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Algún descubrimiento interesante?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un hombre tenía seis fotos de él junto al mismo coche

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quizás el coche tiene una buena personalidad

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aquí está mi lugar de almuerzo muy exclusivo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Aunque sea familia, recibirá el mismo trato que todos los demás

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Necesita a alguien que la ponga en su lugar

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Y mientras hablamos de personas que necesitan ponerse serias…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Tu pierna no se va a arreglar sola si sigues siendo perezoso
{{name:hailey}} me acaba de enviar un mensaje 👀

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: El médico me quitó la escayola apenas ayer, ¿recuerdas?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
