story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay uno justo aquí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te has dado cuenta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He estado cargando pasta sobrante todo el día. Déjame mirar otra cosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Tu teléfono otra vez?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm checking the time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy mirando la hora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Tu novio esperando noticias de ti?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dije que le haría saber lo que estaba haciendo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dile que la comida está buena

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Por qué?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así sabe por qué te quedas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No he dicho que me quede aún

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Has estado mirando ese menú durante cinco minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quizás tengo hambre

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces quédate y come conmigo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, quiero escuchar un poco de música también

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero yo elijo la comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd say that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensé que dirías eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dame un minuto, le voy a avisar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso se ve bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vamos a conseguir algo de comer antes de irnos, hay una banda que empieza aquí 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Entonces te quedas un poco más?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, no me había dado cuenta de que tenían música en vivo esta noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Qué vas a pedir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un pan plano y papas fritas, nada muy sofisticado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mejor que cargar tu almuerzo todo el tiempo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ese recipiente está vacío ahora, puede dejar de juzgar mis decisiones 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensé que solo ibas a tomar algo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también, pero lo estamos pasando bien y no he comido desde el almuerzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y la silla no está tratando de destruir mi espalda, lo cual aprecio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te seguiré escribiendo cuando llegue a casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When the food arrives...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuando llegue la comida...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena, antes de que me coma todas las papas fritas 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se ve bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: También huele bien, voy a comer mientras esté caliente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Disfruta tu comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk in a bit ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hablamos en un rato ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Se pueden comer las papas fritas ahora?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you ordered?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Ya has pedido?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tomé una foto, sobrevivirás

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se veían mejor sin el teléfono entre nosotros

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes tener mi atención sin ser dramático

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces déjalo y prueba eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿El pan plano?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, the tablecloth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, el mantel

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sigue hablando y me comeré tu parte también

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pedí papas fritas extra por una razón

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tienes tus usos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuidado, eso es casi otro cumplido

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aún no, sigo mirando

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Unas cuantas canciones en el set...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you say?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Qué dijiste?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mueve tu silla aquí, no voy a gritar desde la mesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podrías haberme pedido que me sentara a tu lado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso hice

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In the most bossy way possible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De la manera más mandona posible

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y aún así estás moviendo la silla

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque no te escucho, no te pongas tan contento

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te estoy deteniendo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjame mover mi bolso antes de que metas el pie en él

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te dejaré que sigas con eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿El libro también va a tener su propia silla?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tiene mejores modales que tú, se lo merece

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} mueve su silla junto a su manager para oírlo sobre la música

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se inclina más cerca para responderle, su mano descansando brevemente en su antebrazo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es la mano en su brazo lo que me afecta. Un gesto tan pequeño, y aquí estoy preguntándome cuánto más se acercarán.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Little Closer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un Poco Más Cerca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know this one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Conoces esta?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, no me pidas que la cante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No iba a arriesgarme a arruinar la noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Disculpa, podría ser muy buena

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podrías. Estoy disfrutando demasiado esto como para averiguarlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eres horrible

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the cupboard survive you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sobrevivió el armario a ti?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te reíste

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso no te hace menos horrible

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eres diferente aquí afuera

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Menos cansada que a las seis?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De verdad mantienes mi mirada cuando me hablas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quizás miras demasiado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like looking at you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta mirarte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podrías intentar ser sutil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podría. No veo el sentido

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me di cuenta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está actualmente en varios montones por la cocina

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya es una mejora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después del set, con los platos limpios...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Debería revisar los horarios del autobús

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo pago la cuenta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo pagar mi comida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te invité

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso no significa que no pueda pagar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Significa que yo pago esta noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De verdad eres así en todas partes

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No has tenido una noche aburrida, ¿verdad?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, te lo concedo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que estás en el punto en que te arrepientes de haber empezado 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo acepto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay un autobús en unos veinte minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobra tiempo. Ponte tu chaqueta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Por favor?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ponte la chaqueta, por favor

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ves, puedes aprender

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Deeply
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Profundamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjame al menos una taza usable, ¿vale?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sin promesas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a dejar mi teléfono un rato, te escribiré cuando llegue a casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, hablamos luego

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En su mesa, un poco más tarde...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se detecta una conversación en el bar cerca de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dijo que era una copa después del trabajo. Quiero creer que puedo relajarme, pero no dejo de mirar la pantalla.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPCIÓN EN VIVO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te ves bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me viste en el trabajo hace una hora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: También hay comida, así que está ganando por mucho 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: También te veías bien entonces

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Es por eso que seguiste mirando?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Pensabas que estaba revisando si habías terminado el informe?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se supone que debes estar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The report got finished, didn't it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El informe se terminó, ¿no?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada de hablar de trabajo esta noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tú lo mencionaste

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya puedo decir que vas a ser agotador

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Así le hablas a tu jefe?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Debería recordarte lo que me hizo mi jefe?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Terminaste a tiempo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ..qué buen clima tenemos hoy

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah I thought so
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, pensé lo mismo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Has estado sonriendo desde que te sentaste. Me arriesgaré

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Siempre estás tan satisfecho contigo mismo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En una buena noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've barely started
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apenas hemos comenzado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exacto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, antes de que tu cabeza se haga más grande, ¿qué vas a pedir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pide el de jengibre, es bueno aquí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Das instrucciones en todos lados?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Casi, tuve que poner el recipiente del almuerzo de nuevo en mi bolsa con mucho cuidado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo cuando sé de lo que hablo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces, en tu opinión, en todas partes

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estás empezando a conocerme

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unfortunately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Desafortunadamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm having the orange one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a pedir el de naranja

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Solo para estar en desacuerdo conmigo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque me gusta. Sorprendente, lo sé

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, pero no pidas el mío cuando cambies de opinión

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te preocupes, no te daría esa satisfacción

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de que lleguen sus bebidas...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Todavía llevas el libro también?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, la mesa fue una buena elección

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: También lo fue el bar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes aceptar un cumplido sin tener que recoger el resto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Por qué detenerse en uno?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you come here a lot?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Vienes aquí a menudo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo suficiente como para saber qué mesa no está al lado del altavoz

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muy estratégico

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Traje a un amigo aquí para su cumpleaños el mes pasado. Había invitado a seis personas y no reservó nada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena muy organizado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él lo llamó ser espontáneo. Yo llamé al dueño

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, ha tenido un día laboral completo sin abrirse ni una vez

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces tu historia sobre salvar la noche es en realidad una historia sobre conocer a alguien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comimos, ¿no?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espero que te haya pagado la cena después de eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro. Si yo lo organizo y pago, podemos celebrar mi cumpleaños en su lugar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí está

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Qué?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La parte donde te conviertes en el evento principal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eres bienvenido a contar la próxima historia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No creo que pueda competir con tu heroica reserva de mesa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes intentarlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A useful contribution
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una contribución útil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, ayer mi profesor explicó la diapositiva equivocada durante diez minutos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Nadie dijo nada?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Todos estábamos escribiendo. Tenía media página antes de que alguien finalmente preguntara

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deberías haberlo interrumpido

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba ocupado asumiendo que él sabía más que yo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cometes ese error con todos los que están a cargo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cada vez menos últimamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso no fue un cumplido para ti

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No lo tomé como tal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Literatura de apoyo emocional 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes a change
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es un cambio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} se ríe con su gerente mientras toman algo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa sonrisa duele más de lo que esperaba. Antes la veía y sentía que era la persona con la que quería estar.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Away From the Office
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lejos de la oficina

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Qué haces cuando terminan las clases?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Durmiendo hasta que ya no odie mi alarma

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quiero un día en la playa con un libro y sin horarios

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No algo grande y organizado, solo suficiente tiempo para no tener que estar revisando mi teléfono

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Conozco un buen tramo lejos de la playa principal

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Claro que sí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's the place like?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo es el lugar?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Espero que tu profesor te dé un montón de ejercicios de castigo mañana.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eso no me molesta para nada.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Extra work with him is… fine
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: El trabajo extra con él es... bueno.
Acabo de darme cuenta de algo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: De todos modos, me voy a dormir antes de que empieces a interrogarme otra vez.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Fuimos de compras por mis pantalones y de alguna manera tú terminaste comprando más cosas que yo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eres una amenaza para la industria de las compras.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Un poco después de las nueve, afuera del bar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Suenas como yo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Alguien tiene que hacerlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien, lo haré en un minuto 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Cómo te fue esta tarde? ¿Terminaste el armario?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo terminé y luego, de alguna manera, empecé con el cajón de abajo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Así es como te atrapa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Encontré suficiente cubertería de comida para llevar como para abrir un restaurante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Por favor, dime que tiraste algo de eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La mayoría

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿La mayoría?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No me hagas arrepentirme de decirlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Puede que haya una emergencia repentina de tenedores

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo tendré en cuenta si el mío desaparece 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La verdad es que está bien tenerlo ordenado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ahora puedes encontrar las tazas sin que algo te caiga encima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te va a impresionar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Iba a preguntar sobre eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Mi colección de tenedores?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Voy para allá, idiota ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Revisé los horarios de mañana antes de irme hoy. Termino a las cinco

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Puedo pasar después del trabajo? ¿Alrededor de las seis?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Demasiado tarde, me quedo con eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, claro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿No tienes otro lugar al que ir?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, me gustaría pasar la tarde contigo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: A mí también me gustaría eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Podemos hacer algo de comer, y tú eliges una película que no nos ofenda a los dos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Estás seguro de que puedes sobrevivir sin resolver un crimen?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Investigaré el armario de la cocina en su lugar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Una misión mucho más peligrosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Llevaré equipo de protección 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te extrañé aquí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Obviamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Yo también lo extrañé

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Y quiero un abrazo de verdad, no otro mensaje sobre uno

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eso se puede arreglar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bien ❤️ Te escribiré cuando salga del trabajo mañana

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Estaré aquí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Más te vale estar, no voy a aguantar todo un día solo para encontrarme que has salido 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Haré espacio en el sofá

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No te lleves el buen cojín

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sigues haciendo demandas desde tu propia casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Siempre ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tu parada está aquí abajo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien, me voy a la cama antes de quedarme dormida con la luz encendida

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Sacaste la caja del almuerzo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, está en el fregadero. Puedes dejar de supervisarme ahora 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo consideraré

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buenas noches guapo, te quiero ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te quiero también, nos vemos mañana

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Nos vemos mañana ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sé dónde está

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La música estaba buena. Me habría quedado más tiempo si no tuviera cosas que hacer mañana

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo sabremos para la próxima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Ya estás decidiendo que habrá una próxima vez?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Digo que te llevaría a salir otra vez

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Podrías dejar un poco de espacio para la incertidumbre

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La conversación continúa mientras los dos sujetos caminan hacia la parada del autobús

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Se están marchando juntos. Debería alegrarme de que la noche esté terminando, pero no puedo quitarme la sensación de estar esperando algo peor.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPCIÓN EN VIVO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Por qué? Sé lo que quiero

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eso debe ser agradable

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tampoco estabas corriendo hacia la puerta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, no lo estaba

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Se detienen en una esquina más tranquila, con la parada de autobús visible más adelante en la calle...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: He querido besarte de nuevo toda la noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Realmente no te guardas nada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No te adelantes

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Entonces deja de mirar mi boca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No me di cuenta de lo ruidoso que estaba allí hasta que salimos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No lo hago

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tengo un novio. Eso no ha cambiado desde ayer

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo sé. No estoy fingiendo que solo te invité a hablar de trabajo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, lo has dejado muy claro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Por una vez, puedes dejar de lucir tan engreído?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo estás haciendo difícil

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}} lo acerca más con su chaqueta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: El gerente se inclina y la besa; ella devuelve el beso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Esta vez es ella quien lo acerca. Ya no puedo decirme que esto es solo algo que él le hizo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Antes del autobús

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No lo digas

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Decir qué?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lograbas hacerte escuchar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Cualquier cosa engreída que estés a punto de decir

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Iba a decir que tuve una buena noche

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: De alguna manera, aún así sonó engreído

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te acostumbrarás a eso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No tentés a la suerte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vale la pena intentarlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Necesito irme ahora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tu autobús aún no ha llegado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo sé, pero voy a esperar en la parada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien. Nos vemos mañana

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Solo porque me hacías inclinarme para responder

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: En el trabajo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ahí es donde estaré

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buenas noches

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night, {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buenas noches, {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Un poco más tarde, en el autobús a casa...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Estoy en el autobús ❤️ llegaré a casa pronto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Conseguiste un asiento?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, y mi bolso finalmente ha sido quitado de mi hombro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: El libro estará aliviado

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ha tenido un día mucho más emocionante de lo que merecía 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No parecías importarte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Fue una larga caminata hasta la parada?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, caminó conmigo hasta la esquina, luego fui a esperar el autobús

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Te escribiré cuando esté adentro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Once she is home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Una vez que esté en casa...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¡Hola ❤️ estoy en casa, ¿lograste quedarte despierto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, todavía estoy aquí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Perdón, nos quedamos más tarde de lo que esperaba

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Te divertiste?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eres muy rápido para decidir lo que me importa y lo que no

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, lo hice

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La comida estuvo buena y la banda terminó tocando un set completo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Qué tipo de música?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Principalmente versiones, un par que conocía y varios que pretendí conocer 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Haces eso?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Un asentimiento muy convincente te lleva sorprendentemente lejos

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo recordaré la próxima vez que me veas tocar algo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eso es completamente diferente, siempre entiendo tus decisiones de juego tan complicadas 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Claro que sí

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: El bar estaba bien. No había estado allí antes

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Entonces dime. ¿Tuviste una buena noche?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Tu gerente lo eligió?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, y pasó buena parte de la noche asegurándose de que apreciara su excelente gusto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Parece que es igual fuera del trabajo entonces

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Definitivamente le gusta salirse con la suya

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: ¿Y tú?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Le hice agregar 'por favor' cuando me dijo que fuera por mi chaqueta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gran logro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm choosing to count it 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Elijo contarlo 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Parece que te divertiste

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, fue agradable salir un rato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sí, la tuve

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm glad you're home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Me alegra que estés en casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Yo también ❤️.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dame un minuto para cambiarme, no quiero quedarme en estas ropas más tiempo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A few minutes later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Unos minutos después...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ahí, sin zapatos y nada más que cargar

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Eso se ve más cómodo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Mucho. La bolsa puede esperar hasta mañana

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Al menos saca la caja del almuerzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There we go
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ahí vamos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Entonces, ¿cómo se siente el futuro graduado hoy?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No puedo esperar a tener mi diploma en mis manos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Es fácil olvidarlo cuando siempre está en ropa deportiva

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Principalmente quiero mi cuerpo de verano

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ese comentario de ayer realmente te afectó, ¿eh?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quiero verme bien en bikini este verano

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
We have a session planned today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tenemos una sesión planeada para hoy

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No estoy completamente seguro sobre el diploma todavía

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y aún así fuiste tú quien sugirió que lo mantuviera

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pero seguiré empujando hasta el final

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No pensé que estudiar con Ethan te daría tanta motivación

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La zanahoria al final del palo es muy motivadora 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
You can come down whenever you want

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¡Buenos días ❤️! He perdido un pendiente y de alguna manera decidí que es tu culpa, ¿cómo va tu mañana?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso te ha salido sospechosamente bien para acabar de despertarte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: He estado despierto un rato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿No pudiste dormir?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me desperté temprano y no pude volver a estar cómodo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nada dramático, solo una pelea con las almohadas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podrías haberme enviado un mensaje

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Habrías respondido y luego me habrías culpado por estar cansado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso es completamente diferente a culparte por las joyas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera, lo encontré

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa es una acusación impresionante antes del desayuno

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estuvo atrapado en mi manga todo el tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gustaría esa disculpa por escrito

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Querido guapo, lamento que la evidencia no respaldara mi acusación tan razonable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aceptado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Excelente, ahora ayúdame a decidir si se ven bien juntos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ambos aretes, ambos zapatos, notas de clase reales en la bolsa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muy convincente la impresión de una mujer que tiene su vida en orden

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias, tomó varios intentos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estaba leyendo tus mensajes mientras me los ponía

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y sí, se ven bien juntos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, porque no voy a cambiarme de nuevo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nunca ibas a escucharme, ¿verdad?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No si estabas equivocado 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes hoy?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le envié un mensaje a {{name:aiden}} antes de empezar a prepararme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Luego me reí, se me cayó uno, y ahora tengo una oreja muy elegante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le pregunté si tenía unos minutos después de clase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Qué dijo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, y luego preguntó si debía traer las notas que tomó prestadas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Al menos se acuerda

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Todavía no tiene idea de qué quiero hablar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo que me hace querer explicarlo todo por mensaje solo para quitarme la primera frase de encima

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Eso realmente lo haría más fácil?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por unos diez segundos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Luego pasaría toda la mañana preguntándome si se estaba riendo de su teléfono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien empezar con algo incómodo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Déjame ver el daño

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sé, pero esperaba saltar directamente a ser encantadora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo lograste conmigo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fuiste una audiencia inusualmente comprensiva ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me tuviste con el primer insulto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces quizás debería empezar diciéndole que es molesto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puede que no se dé cuenta de que esta es una conversación especial

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactamente mi preocupación

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hablaré con él en serio después de clase, antes de darme otra excusa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te oyes demasiado contenta con esto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Publiqué el perfil

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ya?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Antes de que pudiera reescribir la introducción por sexta vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La foto de anoche, lo de estar en una relación y mi muy atractivo problema de pasta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una introducción fuerte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agregué que me refiero a un café de verdad en un café de verdad, no a alguien que se invita a mi casa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena como tú

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puse el teléfono boca abajo después, como si pudiera empezar a darme instrucciones

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sabes que no tienes que responder nada durante la clase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, y lo dejaré en paz hasta mi descanso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Principalmente porque no quiero que mi primera respuesta contenga una frase de la clase de hoy

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Depende de la clase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ningún hombre merece mis notas sobre métodos de investigación como introducción

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podrías encontrar a alguien con intereses muy específicos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ya tengo uno de esos 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Justo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se siente raro que ahora realmente esté ahí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero estoy feliz de haber presionado el botón en lugar de pasar otro día ajustando comas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Veo el problema

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿A qué hora terminas?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alrededor de la hora del almuerzo, a menos que alguien descubra una pregunta justo cuando estamos saliendo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y tengo un libro que devolver antes de que la biblioteca empiece a enviarme correos electrónicos amenazadoramente educados

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
