story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un día ajetreado enfrentando a tus enemigos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tú, la universidad, la biblioteca

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Estoy en la lista?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me hiciste extrañarte mientras intentaba vestirme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De nada

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso no fue un gracias

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por cierto, puse tu pasta en un recipiente aparte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finalmente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Así que ahora tengo una razón muy práctica para ir a verte pronto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ya tienes varias razones muy poco prácticas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esas son mis favoritas ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bueno, me voy ahora antes de empezar otra conversación contigo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buena suerte hoy

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias, guapo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y come algo de desayuno que no venga de un paquete al lado de la consola

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Has reducido mis opciones considerablemente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sigues viéndote hermosa, lo que debilita tu caso contra mí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estoy lista, vamos antes de que digas algo peor

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}
You're not going to a party
I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo sé... pero aún quiero verme bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero con ese outfit solo va a estar mirando tu trasero todo el tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Aún no puedo creer que sigas después del examen principal

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O más bien… muy buenas recompensas y castigos 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero aún tienes que estudiar de verdad

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es difícil concentrarse cuando haces eso…
Integridad de la sesión de estudio comprometida

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Así que esta vez la recompensa llegó antes que el trabajo, y lo que siento al respecto es más difícil de disimular con bromas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK archivó evidencia de recompensa física durante la sesión de estudio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Haré lo posible para que saques la mejor nota posible entonces

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
Why doesn't he just come to the house?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Por qué no simplemente viene a la casa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estamos más cómodos en su lugar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Hola 😊! Las clases han terminado, devolví el libro de la biblioteca y he robado un lugar soleado en los escalones

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque si vamos a intentar algo así, prefiero que sea con alguien en quien confiamos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Los dos?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Él confía en ti, y yo también

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sé que puedes bromear sobre absolutamente cualquier cosa, pero también sé que puedo decirte cuando algo importa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Esa fue la parte que finalmente te hizo callar?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por un segundo, sí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso realmente significa mucho. No esperaba esa parte tampoco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No te veas tan sorprendido. De vez en cuando digo cosas bonitas sobre ti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No suele ser sin llamarme idiota inmediatamente después

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo te fue esta mañana?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Todavía puedo hacer eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahí está

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me siento conmovido. Lo estoy. Pero también es muy extraño saber que mi amigo está bien con que lleve a su novia a una cita

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes sentirte conmovido y encontrarlo extraño. Yo estoy manejando curiosidad y vergüenza al mismo tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Noté la parte de la vergüenza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto que lo hiciste

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Has pasado cinco minutos evitando mis ojos después de venir aquí a invitarme a salir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esperaba que no lo mencionaras

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No me elegiste por mi capacidad de quedarme callado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claramente eso fue un descuido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, una vez que realmente empecé a escuchar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Pero realmente quieres esto? ¿No solo porque le gusta la idea?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No habría venido aquí solo para hacerlo feliz

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gusta estar cerca de ti. Tengo curiosidad por saber cómo sería si dejáramos de fingir que todo el coqueteo es solo una broma

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces te has dado cuenta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No eres tan sutil como crees

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaba tratando de ser encantador

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A veces funciona. No me hagas arrepentirme de admitirlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estás haciendo muy difícil actuar casual sobre esto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No has estado casual desde que dije la primera frase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Justo. Y sí, me gustaría invitarte a un café

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aunque escribí la fecha en el lugar equivocado tres veces antes de darme cuenta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Estás seguro?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sorprendido, no desinteresado. Hay una diferencia

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, porque por un momento parecías estar buscando la salida

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaba tratando de pensar en algo menos embarazoso que pedirte que repitieras todo una tercera vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aprecio el esfuerzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustas. Una conversación incómoda no ha hecho que sea difícil admitirlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algunos de nosotros necesitamos un poco más de tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me di cuenta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y antes de que empieces a sentirte demasiado satisfecho contigo mismo, estoy preguntando sobre una primera cita. Nada más allá de eso está decidido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Un café, y luego vemos cómo se siente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Un estudiante distraído? No suena para nada como tú

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Incluso si se siente raro?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces se siente raro. Aún me quejaré del café y te robaré tus papas fritas la próxima semana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Idealmente sin contarle a toda la mesa por qué salimos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claro. Te estoy bromeando, no se lo estoy anunciando a todos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O hacer que se arrepienta de ser honesto conmigo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Puede que necesite un segundo para no sonreír la próxima vez que lo vea, pero no lo haré sentir mal por eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿De verdad no lo harás?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él confía en mí. Tú también me lo acabas de decir. No voy a ser un idiota al respecto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Solo sobre todo lo demás?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No esperemos milagros

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Elijo ignorar eso 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gracias. En serio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De nada

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Café mañana? Hay un lugar cerca del campus con las sillas desparejadas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿El que te quejaste de que las tazas eran muy pequeñas?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eran muy pequeñas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esto ya suena como nuestras conversaciones normales

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy tratando de introducirte poco a poco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mañana podría funcionar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Quieres decidir la hora después? Necesito revisar cuándo termina mi última clase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, message me when you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, mándame un mensaje cuando sepas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I might be a little awkward at first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y puede que esté un poco torpe al principio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll give you something to complain about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces te daré algo de qué quejarte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You do that without trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haces sin esfuerzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See? We have a system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Ves? Tenemos un sistema

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nos vemos mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hasta mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 25 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos, y dijo que le gustaría tomar un café conmigo mañana 😊

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Como si hubiera estado encogiendo los hombros desde el desayuno y recién me doy cuenta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can put them down now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes relajarlos ahora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy intentando

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él sabe que hablamos de él juntos, y que esto no es algo que te esté ocultando

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo hemos acordado un café, nada más

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did talking to him feel all right?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y hablar con él se sintió bien?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dejé mi teléfono en mi bolso hasta que terminamos, como dijimos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él entiende que tú sabes, y acordamos un café sin hacer promesas sobre nada más

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me alegra que pudieras concentrarte en la conversación

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo también, ya tenía suficiente pasando en mi cabeza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estoy guardando los pequeños detalles, como dijimos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero la parte importante está bien, y él entiende que tú sabes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo un café mañana, nada más que hayamos decidido.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces dime cómo te sientes en lugar de darme toda la conversación.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aliviada y un poco satisfecha conmigo misma.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensé que me sentiría como si estuviera tomando prestada la confianza de alguien más.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero una vez que dije la parte incómoda, seguía siendo yo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's the person he knows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa es la persona que él conoce.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, creo que necesitaba recordarlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y hubo un momento en que me di cuenta de que realmente quería que dijera que sí.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo se sintió eso?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más personal que cuando solo hablábamos de la idea.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No está mal, solo lo suficiente para hacerme perder la siguiente frase.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}} está junto a la puerta del patio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did the library forgive you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te perdonó la biblioteca?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Tú, sin palabras? Estoy tratando muy duro de no parecer demasiado complacida con eso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Para nada! Habrías puesto una cara y yo habría comenzado a reír.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aquí, esta es la versión que se ha recuperado un poco.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very good smile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa es una sonrisa muy buena.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I can't quite get rid of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé, no puedo deshacerme de ella.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que hacerlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me do it again ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estás haciendo hacerlo de nuevo ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él me dirá su horario más tarde, luego elegiremos un momento.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight when you're settled
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dime esta noche cuando estés tranquilo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him I'd be there in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le dije que estaría allí en un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will, I need to go get something to eat first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré, primero necesito ir a comer algo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've had a few messages on the app
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: He recibido algunos mensajes en la app

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anything you feel like answering?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Hay algo que quieras responder?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One or two, yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uno o dos, sí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a sentarme en algún sitio con una bebida y leerlos de verdad, en vez de ir abriéndolos mientras voy de un lado a otro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Probablemente más cómodo que estar de pie en la salida de la biblioteca

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También es mucho menos probable que me saquen educadamente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te escribiré una vez que haya tenido la oportunidad de hablar bien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you still happy to talk to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Sigues contenta de hablar con él?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 50 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 50 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: He terminado mi bebida y de alguna manera encontré a alguien con quien quería seguir hablando.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds promising
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso suena prometedor.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No era el hombre que preguntó si realmente estaba soltera.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le señalé la primera frase de mi perfil y dejé esa conversación ahí.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An efficient reading comprehension test
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una prueba de comprensión lectora muy eficiente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very efficient
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Muy eficiente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the other conversation was nice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero la otra conversación fue agradable.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él realmente leyó lo que había escrito, incluida la parte sobre ti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, solo necesito dejar de intentar decidir cómo irá toda la conversación antes de que empiece

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did that make it awkward?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Eso lo hizo incómodo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preguntó si esto era algo en lo que habíamos acordado, dije que sí, y no siguió intentando convertirlo en un secreto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces pudimos tener una conversación normal, que era la parte que quería.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué te hizo responderle?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una de sus fotos era una pizza muy quemada con una disculpa debajo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces lo elegiste por su cocina.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo elegí porque me hizo reír, lo cual parecía un buen punto de partida.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Su primer mensaje preguntó si las personas imaginarias para las que cocino alguna vez ayudaron a lavar los platos.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mejor que preguntar si estás soltera.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una frase a la vez

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una mejora significativa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le dije que eran unos pésimos invitados y él dijo que su único invitado a cenar una vez trajo un extintor como broma.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Por la pizza?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aparentemente hubo varios intentos antes de la pizza en la foto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No sé si la persistencia es admirable.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que dejar que te cocine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo mencioné y él inmediatamente sugirió un lugar con personal de verdad 😭.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso suena sensato de su parte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tiene veintiséis años, trabaja al otro lado de la ciudad y no forma parte de nuestro círculo universitario.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo conozco aún, obviamente, pero me gustó que pudiera hablar sin intentar impresionarme en cada frase.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es molesto pero sensato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te sientes cómoda hablando con él?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hasta ahora, sí, y me hizo reír sin esforzarse demasiado.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estoy guardando algunos detalles para mí, pero es alguien nuevo, no alguien de nuestros amigos.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es suficiente por ahora, entonces.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También me gustó que podía tomarme unos minutos para responder sin que él preguntara a dónde había desaparecido.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No hacer que tu teléfono se sienta como tarea es un buen comienzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a guardar mi teléfono ahora, si no seguiré hablando contigo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cuando paramos, ya estábamos hablando de ir a tomar un café mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Ya elegiste un lugar?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sugerí el café cerca de la calle principal de compras, el que tiene grandes ventanas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un lugar que conozco, por la tarde, y solo una bebida para ver si nos llevamos bien en persona

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te parece algo que quieras hacer?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me sorprendí escribiendo la sugerencia antes de que él preguntara, de hecho

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo cual me sorprendió más que recibir mensajes en primer lugar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Suenas feliz por eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Soy

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Adelante. Estaré aquí más tarde ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No fui a buscar a alguien para marcar una casilla, tuve una conversación que disfruté y quería otra

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso suena más a ti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También se sintió como yo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y ayudó no intentar mantenerte al tanto al mismo tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora realmente puedo hablar contigo en lugar de saltar entre dos conversaciones

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prefiero eso a recibir medio mensaje de cada uno

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Gracias!

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De todos modos, esta es tu novia después de enviar un mensaje normal sin reescribirlo veinte veces

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves satisfecho contigo mismo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo estoy, y me estoy permitiendo cinco minutos de eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes tener más de cinco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peligroso, podría volverme insoportable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a arriesgarme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esta foto es para ti, por cierto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No le voy a dar a nadie más la versión de mí celebrando una victoria muy pequeña 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a atesorar lo exclusivo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Confirmaré la hora más tarde cuando sepa si la reunión de grupo de mañana sigue siendo por la mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dime esta noche

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No olvides que tienes un novio que también disfruta de conversaciones que no son de la universidad

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No te he olvidado ni un segundo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero cuéntame una cosa ordinaria de tu día antes de que me vaya

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abrí un juego para hacer una cosa y pasé media hora cambiando los controles

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es dolorosamente creíble

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaba empezando a pensar que te habías escapado por otra salida

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La mujer en el mostrador ni siquiera me miró

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Luego los cambié de nuevo porque prefería los antiguos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gracias, eso me ha hecho sentir mucho más productivo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Feliz de ayudar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mándame un mensaje más tarde, quiero saber si alguna vez lo juegas ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Casi lo hice, pero tengo una reputación de ser confiable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Desde cuándo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás causando una excelente primera impresión

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Primera impresión? Pensé que ya había pasado de eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vamos, caminemos un poco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dos sujetos entran al patio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversación continúa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedo darle espacio para elegir sin fingir que no siento nada.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lejos de la multitud

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien, ahora realmente me estás poniendo curiosa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Recuerdas lo que dije ayer? Sobre querer hablar en un lugar más tranquilo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, y he sido muy maduro al no preguntarte doce veces

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preparé una disculpa para una máquina que solo pitó

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aprecio el esfuerzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Es este un buen lugar?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, sentémonos un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás haciendo eso con la correa de tu mochila

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué cosa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Enroscándola en tus dedos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No me había dado cuenta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que hacer que esto suene perfecto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es una cantidad peligrosa de amabilidad de tu parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estoy guardando los chistes hasta que sepa de qué estamos hablando

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un intercambio muy conmovedor

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} y yo hemos estado hablando de que yo tenga una cita con otra persona

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, ¿qué demonios?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco más bajo, por favor

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perdona, pero... ¿{{name:player}} quiere que tengas una cita con otro chico?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Hemos estado hablando de esto por un tiempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Por qué? ¿Pasó algo entre ustedes dos?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, estamos felices juntos. No se trata de romper o encontrar a alguien que lo reemplace.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces definitivamente me estoy perdiendo de algo, porque me preguntaría por qué mi novia querría salir con alguien más.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él fue quien lo mencionó. Le gusta la idea de que esté con alguien más, de que decidamos juntos.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Creo que ambos crecimos como personas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Él lo mencionó?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Y después de hablarlo, me di cuenta de que yo también tenía curiosidad.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Hablas en serio? ¿No están ustedes dos tratando de ver qué diré?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Acaso parezco que me estoy divirtiendo explicando esto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo siento. No me estoy riendo de ti, simplemente no estaba lista para eso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo tampoco lo estaba cuando él me lo dijo por primera vez.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien, pero ¿por qué me lo estás diciendo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque quería preguntarte cómo te sentirías al ser esa persona.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Yo? Espera, ¿quieres decir que quieres salir conmigo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, el hombre que está detrás de ti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De todos modos, aquí es donde me estoy escondiendo por cinco minutos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No hagas eso, todavía estoy tratando de ponerme al día.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, tú. Por eso te pedí que te encontraras conmigo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Santo cielo. ¿Y él sabe que soy yo? ¿No solo un tipo que no conoce?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos de ti específicamente, así que esto no es algo que estoy sacando a sus espaldas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Así que él sabe que estás aquí ahora mismo, preguntándome esto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Sabía que iba a hablar contigo después de clase.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensé que querías consejo sobre algo. No esperaba ser parte de ello.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora entiendes por qué pasé toda la mañana pensando en cómo decirlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaba esperando que me dijera que dejara de coquetear contigo. Esta es una conversación muy diferente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podrías al menos fingir que no estás tan orgulloso de ti mismo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Todavía no he llegado a sentirme orgulloso. Sigo intentando creerte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} se ha estado guardando unas cuantas sorpresas, ¿no?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aparentemente. Tenía exactamente la misma expresión en mi cara cuando hablamos de esto por primera vez.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pobre chico. Finalmente te dice lo que piensa y ahora estamos aquí comparando nuestras reacciones.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eres tú quien me mira como si te hubiera pedido que me ayudaras a robar un banco.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hubiera entendido el banco más rápido.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso no me sorprende.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablando en serio, nunca pensé que escucharía este tipo de propuesta de ustedes dos.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Nos gusta descubrir cosas nuevas juntos, pero esta requirió un poco más de charla.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso espero.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parece que estás disfrutando del silencio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al principio no estaba segura de lo que pensaba. Luego hablamos más y me di cuenta de que quería ver cómo se sentiría.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y ahí es donde entré yo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eventualmente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿De quién fue esa idea?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos de ti. No estás recibiendo toda la conversación.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo estoy preguntando si debería agradecerte a ti o a él.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ninguno hasta que realmente hayas respondido a mi pregunta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora te estás divirtiendo viéndome luchar.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco. He estado nerviosa por esto toda la mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien. ¿Por qué yo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por una vez, nadie puede preguntar si la siguiente diapositiva es importante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Realmente no esperaba que apareciera así 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Siempre ha tenido un crush contigo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Bro, fue realmente difícil concentrarse en los ejercicios 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Cada quien puede hacer lo que quiera

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Espero con ansias las próximas sesiones 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: And you, take it easy on the leg
The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: El médico te quitó la escayola hace apenas dos días.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Primera sesión real sin el yeso y ya manejaste la mayoría de los ejercicios

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Fue realmente difícil concentrarse durante la sesión 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ Acabo de poner la cena en la mesa, ¿has comido o todavía estás negociando con ese juego?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta hablar contigo así

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Incluso cuando haces preguntas que no puedo responder con una broma?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobre todo entonces

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aunque estoy segura de que harás otro intento en un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy esperando una oportunidad

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hombre predecible

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De todos modos, quería probarme algo antes de que me sienta demasiado cómoda para moverme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Para mañana?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, iba a ponerme lo primero que sacara

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego me di cuenta de que en realidad quería elegir algo que me gustara

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muéstrame

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dame un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Este, con la chaqueta si hace frío

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Respondiste muy rápido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Preferirías un cumplido más lento?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferiría uno en el que crea

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pareces lista para disfrutar de tu tarde, no para preocuparte por tu ropa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso se ve bien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es exactamente lo que quería

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y tú te ves hermosa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa parte también ayuda 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo caminar con estos zapatos sin pensar en cada paso, así que se quedan

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una decisión de moda muy práctica

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Soy un mar de posibilidades

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces me quedo con el outfit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿La cena o yo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y si decido enviarle una foto, tú también la recibirás, como dijimos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta es solo para ti, no la he enviado a ningún otro lado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta recibir un adelanto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces, aprecialo, hubo una lucha muy indigna con la chaqueta antes de que la tomara

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qué pena que me perdí esa parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me preguntaste sobre la cena.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta es solo entre nosotros, por cierto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No voy a convertir mañana en una colección de cosas que tienes que mirar

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aún me habría decepcionado perderme el vestido

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tus fotos de novia normales no se van a descontinuar 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta foto es solo para ti, no un informe de algo que le he enviado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes disfrutar del vestido y aún así dejarme guardar algunas cositas para mí mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo vivir con eso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, porque estoy disfrutando no planear cada frase con anticipación

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tienes permiso para mostrar iniciativa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta foto es solo para ti, no se la he enviado

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y mañana puedo dejar mi teléfono a un lado mientras hablamos, y luego contarte sobre ello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso todavía me suena bien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también, no quiero pasar nuestro primer café mirando la pantalla.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pasó algo más mientras me lo probaba.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Qué?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena se ve bien, y desearía estar sentado frente a ti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me encontré pensando si a él le gustaría.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y luego, de inmediato, quería ver tu cara cuando lo vieras.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta que quisieras las dos cosas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A mí también, de hecho.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensé que esos sentimientos podrían interponerse entre nosotros.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En cambio, solo estaba aquí queriendo mostrarte el vestido.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que lo hicieras.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es mejor ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y nuestra tarde de películas sigue en pie.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puse el recipiente de pasta al frente de la nevera para no olvidarlo cuando venga.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te dejaría entrar sin eso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé, pero es importante que entiendas lo generoso que soy como visitante.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generoso con la comida, implacable con el control remoto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tú aceptaste que yo pudiera elegir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo recuerdo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, he encontrado algo donde realmente puedes ver a los actores.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nunca dejarás eso, ¿verdad?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No hasta que descubra quién estaba parado en esa puerta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aunque tendrías que dejar de hacerme reír mientras intento comer.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nadie sabe, eso es parte de la película

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sistema terrible

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, me estoy cambiando antes de quedarme dormida con el atuendo de mañana

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mucho mejor, me quedo con esta ropa para absolutamente nadie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Ni siquiera yo?
