story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Todo terminado?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Suficiente por hoy, dejé el resto donde pertenece

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿En el trabajo?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo va tu tarde?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donde puede molestar a alguien más por una hora 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parando por la tarta, luego voy para allá

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tómate tu tiempo, la comida aún no está lista

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Después de una rápida parada en la panadería...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tenían dos rebanadas restantes. Considero que eso es una excelente planificación

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tuviste suerte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, no arruines mi imagen de novia muy organizada 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mantén la caja en posición vertical, eso es todo lo que pido

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está consiguiendo un mejor asiento en el autobús que yo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Casi termino con la última tanda de papeleo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nos vemos alrededor de las seis ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hasta pronto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sigo saliendo a las cinco, no dejaré que una carpeta robe nuestra noche

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No he empezado a cocinar aún, tienes tiempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé, solo quiero salir a tiempo por una vez

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ¿Qué planeas hacer una vez que terminen los exámenes?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: No he pensado tan lejos aún

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pero lo primero será dormir hasta que mi cuerpo me obligue a levantarme

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: He pasado tanto tiempo estresada que casi olvido cómo se siente el tiempo libre

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Lo recordarás rápido una vez que termine

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tengo ganas de ser completamente inútil por un tiempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ven a comer antes de que me empiece a mirar así

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ven a comer antes de que me empiece a mirar así

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Estamos sentados a cenar con {{name:evelyn}}. ¿Te unes a nosotros?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ya he cenado con {{name:lena}}. Ella se ha ido a casa, así que voy a pasar a saludarte.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Estás de muy buen humor esta noche

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just wanted to annoy you a little

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ estoy abajo, y tu postre sobrevivió al autobús

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Su teléfono vuelve a su bolso. Cuando le pones la manta sobre los pies, se gira hacia ti en lugar de mirar la pantalla. "¿Qué?" preguntas. "Nada. Ven aquí." Apoya su cabeza en ti y te agarra la mano debajo de la manta. Te necesita un empujoncito antes de darse cuenta de que la película ya ha comenzado.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Pasas la película cerca de ella, discutiendo de vez en cuando sobre si el actor principal se supone que es gracioso. Cuando aparecen los créditos, se queda unos minutos más antes de recoger sus cosas. En la puerta, te da un abrazo más largo, promete enviarte un mensaje cuando llegue a casa y se dirige a la parada de autobús.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — {{name:lena}} ESTÁ EN CASA

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya estoy en casa ❤️ Gracias por esta noche

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Volviste bien?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, conseguí un asiento y casi me quedo dormida antes de mi parada 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dejaste tu coleta en el sofá

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quédatela, necesitaré una excusa para robar ese cojín otra vez

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No necesitas una excusa

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tú?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te quedaste callado un par de veces esta noche

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo siento, tenía mucho en la cabeza

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Hice algo?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, no hiciste nada mal, eres perfecto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba muy feliz de estar allí contigo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que vinieras

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también, extrañaba estar a tu lado en lugar de ver desde el otro lado de la pantalla

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mucho más fácil para ti robar la manta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso también 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Condición menos impresionante, pero aún comestible

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y me gustó tu película, aunque todavía no creo que ese hombre se supone que sea gracioso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te reíste más que yo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobre todo por verte reírte de él

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo acepto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena también estuvo muy buena ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Incluso sin todo mi pollo en tu plato?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No empieces, solo tomé un trozo 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ve a dormir, te veías listo para quedarte dormido sobre mí

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Casi lo hice. Fue agradable no tener que ir a ningún lado por un rato

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo haremos de nuevo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DISPONIBLE 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustaría eso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buenas noches guapo, te quiero ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te quiero también, que duermas bien

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy abriendo la puerta antes de que lo empeores

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, hazlo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alrededor de las seis, abres la puerta. {{name:lena}} deja la bolsa de pasteles y te envuelve con ambos brazos antes de que termines de decir hola. Te besa en la mejilla y se queda contra ti un momento más, luego entra.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Durante la cena, sirves la limonada que compraste para ella. Ella mira la botella, luego a ti. "Incluso la pusiste en la nevera," dice. "Pensé que la limonada tibia podría recibir una mala crítica." Sonríe, pero se queda en silencio un momento antes de extender la mano a través de la mesa para tomar la tuya.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La conversación se relaja durante la cena. Ella te cuenta sobre su mañana y roba un trozo de pollo de tu plato mientras tú respondes. Cuando te das cuenta, insiste en que el tuyo tenía el borde crujiente que le prometieron. Cuando sacas las dos porciones de tarta, se ríe de tu intento de decidir cuál es más grande.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Después de ayudarte a recoger los platos, deja sus zapatos al lado del sofá y se queda con el buen cojín. Se quita la coleta mientras se acomoda a tu lado. Antes de que empiece la película, se apoya en tu hombro y toma una foto de los dos. Te envía una copia para que la guardes.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tengo que ir a comprar unos libros de repaso con {{name:ethan}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eso solo es un código para ir a su casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No, en realidad necesito los libros

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Es gracioso cómo solo empiezas a trabajar duro al final del año

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eso pasa cuando tienes un profesor que sabe motivar 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Probablemente solo me quedaré en la cama
Voy a ponerme en modo bomba total

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}} ni siquiera querrá pasar el rato contigo después de esto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Invité a {{name:aiden}} a pasar el rato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Todo adolorido, con el pelo desordenado, pareciendo medio muerto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hola 😊 me desperté antes de mi alarma y ahora las tres y media se siente como si estuviera a una semana de distancia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sobre todo, quiero que dejes de tratar tus propios sentimientos como si fueran la parte menos importante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy intentando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gusta que quieras que haga esto como yo, no como alguna versión de mí que tengo que inventar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa es la chica de la que estoy enamorado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso fue injustamente dulce ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahora he olvidado qué estaba buscando antes de que me hicieras sonreír en la mesa de la cocina.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Las llaves?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, en realidad.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mírame, útil y encantador.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No lo arruinemos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te mandaré un mensaje cuando me esté preparando más tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Que tengas un buen día. Y come antes de que la reunión se trague tu descanso para el almuerzo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hoy realmente me estás robando el trabajo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso se ve mucho mejor que lo que hice yo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podrías intentar poner algo en el plato en lugar de comer sobre el fregadero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No estabas aquí. No puedes probar nada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te conozco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tengo la reunión del grupo esta mañana, luego volveré a casa y me cambiaré

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Aún llevas el vestido de ayer?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. Me niego a empezar esa decisión de nuevo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quiero preguntarte algo antes de irme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Qué es?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedes volver a dormir. Te despertaré en junio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sobre hoy. Sobre límites, supongo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hemos hablado sobre lo que quieres saber después, pero no exactamente sobre esto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuando dijimos café, ¿significaba café y nada más?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No. Elegimos un lugar para que te encuentres, no una regla sobre dónde tiene que parar la tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces, si va bien y quiero quedarme más tiempo, ¿no se supone que debo volver a casa solo porque eso es todo lo que mencionamos?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que no

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quiero que hagas lo que te apetezca, no que estés revisando si estaba en una lista que hicimos esta mañana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Y si quiero besarlo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces bésalo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo dices muy fácil

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muy útil

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porque lo digo en serio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Y si quiero ir más allá?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No te voy a poner un límite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sin límites de mi parte. Quiero que decidas lo que quieres, no lo que crees que quiero que hagas

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿De verdad?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De verdad. No tienes que pedirme permiso en cada paso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aún no sé cómo me sentiré

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No necesitas saberlo ya

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quizás tomas un café y te vas. Quizás quieras pasar el resto de la tarde juntos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No quiero que te detengas solo para seguir un plan, o que te fuerces a hacer la historia más interesante para mí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estuve bien anoche. Ahora estoy mirando la hora mientras hierve la tetera

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso era lo que me preocupaba

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Regresar a casa y sentir que había hecho demasiado o que te decepcioné por no hacer lo suficiente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No hay nada que debas hacer para que hoy sea un éxito

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Así que decido lo que realmente quiero y veo qué quiere él también

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y aún puedo cambiar de opinión en medio de todo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Obviamente. Esto no es una promesa para ninguno de los dos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa es una respuesta mucho más grande de lo que esperaba

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ya desayuné, antes de que preguntes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anoche dijiste que de repente se sentía mucho más real. ¿Eso ha cambiado?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No del todo. Aún lo noto cuando pienso en ti realmente ahí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero sentirme nervioso no significa que quiera tomar tus decisiones por ti.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No conviertas el estar relajada en otra cosa que tengas que hacer para mí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No lo haré. Te diré si algo se siente diferente.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Quiero la respuesta real de ti, incluso si toma un minuto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te acordaste ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Sigues sonriendo como lo hacías anoche?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. Un poco distraído también, pero tengo ganas de saber cómo te sientes.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo no decidas cómo va a ser toda mi tarde antes de que haya salido de casa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy tratando de concentrarme en la chica que sigue enviándome mensajes en su lugar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Suena encantadora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ella es ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Casi podía escuchar la clase de mañana antes de irme a la cama

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Incluso con {{name:aiden}}? ¿Sabiendo que aún lo veremos después?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. No he olvidado de quién estamos hablando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Confío en ti. No te pido que pases toda la cita protegiéndome de encontrarlo extraño.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Él podría ser el que necesite un minuto hoy.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Aún tratando de entender ayer?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probablemente. No estoy segura de que las palabras "mi novio sabe" se hayan asentado completamente aún.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Déjale pedir algo antes de que lo sorprendas de nuevo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No voy a dar una segunda presentación. Él puede manejarlo 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso se llama ser una buena influencia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y aún estoy conociendo a alguien que en realidad no conozco todavía.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exacto. Ser libre para elegir no significa que de repente tengas que confiar en él con todo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Todavía quiero ver cómo es él primero con un café. Eso no ha cambiado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces ahí es donde empiezas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gustaron sus mensajes. No quiero pasar la cita preguntándome si estoy a la altura de la versión que imaginé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puede que encuentres a la persona real más interesante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mientras él deje la cocina al café, tenemos una oportunidad.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Has comido o solo estás supervisando a los demás?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y cuando dijiste que podía guardar algunas cosas para mí, solo habíamos hablado de una primera cita.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quería decir esta parte en voz alta antes de tratar esa respuesta como si significara algo más.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me alegra que lo hicieras. Ahora sabes que quiero que elijas por ti mismo, en lugar de detenerte en el café por mí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien. Algunas cosas pueden seguir siendo mías sin que nos malinterpretemos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. Y cualquier cosa que preocupe a cualquiera de los dos sigue siendo algo de lo que hablamos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pensé que me ibas a dar una respuesta muy cuidadosa sobre lo que estaba permitido.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tengo comida aquí, gracias

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Comprar los libros tomó más tiempo de lo esperado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS – SALA DE ESTAR

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} le da un beso en la mejilla a {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ese saludo parece menos casual cada vez, y ahora estoy notando mi propia reacción.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK archivó evidencia de {{name:hailey}} iniciando un beso en la mejilla al llegar {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?
He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se merece un pequeño premio por cuidarme tan bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} camina deliberadamente despacio frente al sofá

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El sujeto caminó deliberadamente frente a ambos hombres usando ropa reveladora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No sé muy bien cómo jugar… 😇
{{name:hailey}} se sienta en el regazo de {{name:aiden}}
El sujeto se sentó en el regazo de Aiden

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Veo que cada vez están más cerca, pero aún necesito entender hasta qué punto me siento a gusto con eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK registró a {{name:hailey}} sentándose en el regazo de {{name:aiden}} bajo el pretexto de aprender a jugar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Qué? Necesito una buena vista de la pantalla 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No te atrevas a bajar vestida así

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Claro que no, eres tan mala como ella

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tengo una sesión de entrenamiento más tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Fue divertido pasar el rato con ustedes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si es un reto, lo haré aún más 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Te advertí que pagarías por esto esta mañana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Hola 😊 ya estoy en casa y preparándome, y el vestido ha sobrevivido a ser reconsiderado tres veces!

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aparentemente. Siento que me he perdido un capítulo entero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A mí también me costó un tiempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Hablaste de nuevo antes de venir aquí?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esta mañana, sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y? ¿Puedo preguntar cómo fue eso, o es privado?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parte de eso es privado. Pero pregunté si el café era el límite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Le preguntaste eso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué dijo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que no quiere ponerme un límite. Quiere que yo decida qué es lo que realmente quiero hacer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves hermosa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿En serio? ¿Así de fácil?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos más tiempo que eso. Te estoy dando la parte útil

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy tratando de imaginar tener esa conversación y mantener la cara seria

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ayer ni siquiera lograste decir la primera frase

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buen punto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Todavía me parece extraño. No malo, pero extraño

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puede ser extraño sin que pasemos toda la cita explicándolo de nuevo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tienes razón

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y no significa que haya llegado con una promesa sobre cómo termina hoy

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Significa que debería preguntarte, no intentar adivinar a qué accedió

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me siento bien con él

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien. Entonces, primera pregunta para ti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continúa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Realmente quieres el asiento de la ventana, o tomaste el otro porque ya estaba sentado aquí?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quería el asiento de la ventana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces, cámbiate conmigo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿De verdad?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. También puedes elegir la silla.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vas a ser muy molesto con esto ahora, ¿verdad?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo hasta que dejes de fingir que no tienes preferencias.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaba a punto de preguntar si pensabas que era demasiado, luego me di cuenta de que en realidad me gustaba

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Los sujetos cambian de asiento.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La mirada observada se queda más abajo de lo previsto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sabía que había curiosidad, pero notar su atención todavía me toma por sorpresa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Atrapado mirando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE LLEGA SU CAFÉ.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Está bueno?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, mucho. Puedes disfrutar el tuyo aunque sea pequeño.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bueno. Molestamente bueno.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por eso sigues volviendo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso, y que está tranquilo si evitas la hora punta del almuerzo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No creo haber estado aquí sin estar pendiente del tiempo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente tienes otro lugar al que ir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces mantén esa respuesta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Clases, trabajo, algo que he olvidado terminar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hoy casi traigo mis notas en mi mochila por costumbre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedes dejarlas ahí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo hice. Eso es lo que estoy tratando de decirte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo siento. Estoy disfrutando el hecho de que elegiste estar aquí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa es una respuesta muy inconvenientemente agradable.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A veces tengo esos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Solo que no siempre los escucho sin tres chistes después.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hoy estoy tratando de no esconderme tanto detrás de eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que dejar de ser gracioso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, porque ser guapo y callado suena agotador.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahí está.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué harías con una tarde libre? No lo que deberías hacer. Lo que realmente harías.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Saldría a caminar sin contar cuánto tiempo me tomaría.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quizás encontrar un lugar para sentarme, escuchar algo, no responder al grupo de clase por un rato.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hay un jardín a un par de calles.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conozco el que dices. Siempre paso por la entrada.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podríamos entrar esta vez.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Me gustaría eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: LUEGO, FUERA DEL CAFÉ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes de otra manera?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿A la izquierda aquí, verdad?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. A menos que planees seguir dando vueltas por la misma cuadra.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podría fingir que te estoy dando un tour.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Del lugar donde voy a la universidad?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Necesita trabajo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás siendo sospechosamente callado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te preocupaba que hiciera una broma

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No te pedí que dejaras de hablar por completo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me lo estoy pasando bien. No quiero arruinar cada momento tranquilo llenándolo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nerviosa, pero sin desear haber cancelado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es nuevo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gusta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN POCO DESPUÉS, EN EL JARDÍN

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esto es más bonito que el camino de afuera

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aquí puedes escuchar tus propios pensamientos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esperaba hacer menos de eso hoy

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo va todo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mejor una vez que salimos del café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Fui tan malo durante el café?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más como los diez minutos antes de tener que hacer algo y tu cerebro se queda sin cosas útiles que decir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No. Dejé de imaginar lo que se suponía que debía hacer después

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y ahora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora me gustaría que te detuvieras un segundo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Aquí?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pareces que estás a punto de decir algo peligroso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo estaba

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces tal vez me impacienté

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: El sujeto inicia un beso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Contacto recíproco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un beso hace esto real de una forma que hablar nunca podría, y necesito un momento para asimilarlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que llenar los diez minutos pensando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Para callarlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hola

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No dije que pudieras hacer eso primero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te detuviste y me miraste así. Tomé un riesgo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso no fue correr un riesgo. Fue adelantarte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así que tenía razón sobre a dónde iba esto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás muy satisfecho contigo mismo ahora mismo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De todos modos, ibas a besarme.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sigue hablando y ve qué pasa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una sugerencia radical

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensé que no ibas a empezar a decidir eso de nuevo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué, me vas a detener otra vez?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Chist

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así que dime honestamente, ¿quién besa mejor? ¿Yo o él?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué? Es una pregunta válida.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conviertes todo en una competencia. En los juegos, en clase, en la vida.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y ahora aparentemente también en besar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si realmente quieres saberlo, por ahora estás muy atrás.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wow. Eso es frío.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tú preguntaste.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, me gusta. Ahora suena como un desafío.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No se suponía que fuera así

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demasiado tarde. Ya me lo estoy tomando personalmente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eres imposible

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y aun así, me besaste para callarme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso debería decirte lo efectivas que son las palabras conmigo en este momento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Quieres sentarte un rato?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Allí, a la sombra

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mira eso. Una preferencia de asiento sin interrogatorio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estás a un comentario de sentarte solo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: MÁS TARDE ESA TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te acompaño de regreso a la parada?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustaría eso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Quieres hacer planes para otro día ahora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No en este momento. Quiero un poco de tiempo para asimilar lo de hoy

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa no es una forma educada de decir que no

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo tomé así

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien. Me alegra que hayamos hecho esto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo también

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Me envías un mensaje cuando llegues a casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE DICEN ADIÓS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy de camino a casa ❤️ Fue una buena tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me alegra. ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Feliz, y un poco más tranquila de lo que esperaba.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensé que querría escribir todo de una vez. Principalmente solo quiero sentarme con esto un momento.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tómate tu tiempo. No tienes que convertir el camino a casa en un informe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Aún quería enviarte esto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa es una sonrisa encantadora.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Siento que he tenido una tarde libre de verdad.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No solo un hueco entre dos cosas que necesitaba hacer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me alegra que hayas entendido eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Podemos hablar bien cuando esté en casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y cuéntame algo de tu día también. No quiero que el mío ocupe todo el espacio.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le acabo de enviar una foto rápida para decirle que estoy en camino

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tomé esto antes de entrar. Me gusta cuánta luz hay allí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy en el café cerca de la calle de compras. Encontré una mesa junto a las grandes ventanas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Llegué temprano, así que naturalmente estoy fingiendo que elegir una bebida es una tarea muy complicada.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos habrás decidido para cuando él llegue.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así lo pensarías.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera, está afuera. Lo reconozco de las fotos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a guardar mi teléfono ahora. Hablamos luego ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Este, no el del espejo que te envié

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pedimos, y le pregunté si se sentiría cómodo tomando una foto juntos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dijo que sí. Le dije que me gustaría enviártela también.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ya te ves más relajada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablar con alguien es más fácil que intentar imaginar la primera frase

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Disfruta tu café. Luego me cuentas cómo te va

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo haré 😊

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: MÁS TARDE ESA TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más allá del café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN POCO MÁS TARDE

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una despedida inesperada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DESPUÉS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy de camino a casa 😊 Todo salió bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien. Mejor que cuando estudiaba el menú de bebidas como si fuera a haber un examen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fue agradable no tener que llevar toda la conversación yo solo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gusta esa sonrisa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Era como esperabas?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un poco más callado al principio, de hecho. Lo que me hizo sentir menos tonta por estar nerviosa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Luego dijo que se había prometido no pasar los primeros diez minutos explicando la foto de la pizza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Y lo logró?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Durante unos cuatro minutos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pregunté porque quería escuchar la historia, no porque se le hubieran acabado las cosas de qué hablar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esa es una mejor razón

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al final terminamos paseando. Incluso volví a casa con un libro de segunda mano que no planeaba comprar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una tarde productiva

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tomé dos. En la primera parecía que intentaba recordar si había cerrado la puerta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una compra completamente innecesaria, pero me gusta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
