story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te gustó estar allí, una vez que se calmaron los nervios?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí. Dejé de intentar decidir si iba bien y simplemente disfruté.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me guardo los pequeños detalles para mí, pero quería que supieras esa parte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me alegra que fuiste.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo también ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tomé esto después de que nos dijimos adiós.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Lo habías hecho?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo voy a cambiar. Solo lo estoy mirando con una intensidad innecesaria

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves feliz.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo estoy. Y de alguna manera tengo hambre otra vez.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustaría llegar a casa y comer antes de que hablemos bien, si está bien.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto. No voy a ninguna parte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También quiero escuchar sobre tu día.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tiene que competir con el mío para ser interesante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hice la colada sin causar un incidente internacional con la máquina.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Todavía estaba adentro. Así que no 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es un progreso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puede que se haya perdido un calcetín en el proceso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Recordaremos su sacrificio.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te habrías quejado si no lo hubiera hecho.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No me quejo. Estoy decidiendo cuánto elogio te mereces

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos un poco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces bien hecho, guapo. Te daré la versión larga esta noche ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le envié una foto rápida para decirle que estoy en camino, por cierto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo yo en la puerta, nada elaborado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que enviarlo dos veces

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. De todos modos, ya tuviste mi inspección completa del espejo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me voy ahora antes de encontrar otra razón para quedarme en el pasillo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Completamente diferente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Diviértete. Hablaremos cuando estés libre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gracias por esta mañana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No tienes que pasar la cita pensando en lo que querría después

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Me llevo esa parte conmigo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tomé esto antes de cruzar la calle. Se ve mucho mejor sin la multitud del almuerzo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy afuera del café. {{name:aiden}} ya está aquí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se ve demasiado contento por ser el que llegó primero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No dejes que saque toda una conversación de cinco minutos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demasiado tarde, está señalando su muñeca

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voy a guardar mi teléfono antes de que él empiece a saludar también.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cinco minutos enteros de anticipación. Estaba a punto de preocuparme.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not wearing a watch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No llevas reloj.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know what time it is without one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sé qué hora es sin uno.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La reunión grupal terminó a tiempo, así que incluso logré un almuerzo decente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces sabes que yo también llegué temprano.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Solo quería disfrutar de ser el primero.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Así va a ser toda la cita?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustaría pensar que tengo un poco más que ofrecer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ya veremos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look really nice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves muy bien.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Gracias!

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es todo. No tienes que preparar una respuesta para eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No lo estaba.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estabas un poco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien. No pasarás toda la cita mirando la vitrina de pasteles

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me estás haciendo considerar una ahora.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vamos. Encontré dos sillas que no cojean.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es inusualmente considerado de tu parte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Espera a que veas las tazas. No han hecho nada con las tazas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Te importaría tomar una foto conmigo antes de que lleguen las bebidas?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Tomándola o apareciendo en ella?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Being in it. I can hold the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estar en ello. Puedo sostener el teléfono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a separate issue
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ese es un tema aparte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For {{name:player}}?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Para {{name:player}}?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like one too. But yes, I'd like to send it to him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Yo también quiero una. Pero sí, me gustaría enviársela

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. You can send it to me as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien. También me lo puedes enviar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces acércate un poco más o solo veré tu hombro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have just asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Podrías haberlo preguntado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did just ask. Look at the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Acabo de preguntar. Mira el teléfono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We found a table 😊 I asked for a photo before he could complain about the coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encontramos una mesa 😊 Pedí una foto antes de que pudiera quejarse del café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ustedes dos parecen a punto de pelearse por el menú

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We already did. This is the peaceful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ya lo hicimos. Esta es la parte pacífica

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted to show you before I leave
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quería mostrártelo antes de irme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Disfrútalo. Hablamos luego ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So, how did this morning go?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces, ¿cómo te fue esta mañana?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De hecho, terminamos el trabajo. No tuve que fingir que mi laptop estaba a punto de morir para salir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es decepcionante. Quería pensar que te habías escapado por mí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tienes la tarde. No empieces a pedir una historia dramática

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sigo pensando en ayer, ¿sabes?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The look on your face is going to stay with me for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La expresión en tu cara se quedará conmigo un tiempo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pasé años esperando que se molestara cuando coqueteaba contigo. No esperaba que esto fuera a donde llegó

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Él tiene algunas cosas que no son solo discutir contigo sobre un juego

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Did you tell him you’d be back later?
Then we can continue the lesson
This has moved well past a study session, and it's harder to laugh off now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Esto ya va mucho más allá de una sesión de estudio, y ahora me cuesta más tomármelo a broma.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived the first kiss of the evening session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK archivó el primer beso de la sesión de la tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I also have ways to give punishments and rewards… without being the teacher 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: También tengo formas de dar castigos y recompensas... sin ser la profesora 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject initiated a handjob during the private session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: El sujeto inició una mano durante la sesión privada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On this subject… you don’t seem to need any lessons
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sobre este tema... no pareces necesitar lecciones

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’ll probably go revise directly at his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Probablemente iré a revisar directamente a su casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject increased the intensity of the act
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: El sujeto aumentó la intensidad del acto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: They finish with a kiss while she makes him cum
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Terminan con un beso mientras ella lo hace venir
La sesión terminó con una eyaculación

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we still need to revise now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pero aún tenemos que repasar ahora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But it’s going to be hard to focus after that 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pero va a ser difícil concentrarse después de eso 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’ll drop me off a bit later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Él me dejará un poco más tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know… but we have to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Lo sé… pero tenemos que hacerlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m not the one who’s going to get eaten
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: No soy yo quien va a ser devorado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On the contrary… I’m the one who’s going to eat him 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Al contrario... soy yo quien lo va a comer 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I know you like it 😌
I know you liked the show 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sé que te gustó el show 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little reward just for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Una pequeña recompensa solo para ti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Since when do you act like that?
I’m done living only for revisions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ya no quiero vivir solo para las revisiones

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Quiero disfrutar un poco de mi vida

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I’ve always had a crush on him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Y siempre he tenido un crush en él

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It seems like it’s mutual… so I’m taking advantage 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Parece que es mutuo... así que estoy aprovechando 😇

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ¿No te da vergüenza hacer todo eso frente a mí?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¡Hola ❤️! Me he duchado y he comido algo. ¿Tienes tiempo para una buena conversación?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así es como eliges las películas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él dijo algo muy similar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fue agradable dejar que la conversación se desvíe así. Dejé de pensar en que era una primera cita.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Había algo diferente de cómo lo habías imaginado?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Escuchó más tiempo antes de responder de lo que esperaba por los mensajes.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al principio pensé que había dicho algo incómodo. Luego me di cuenta de que en realidad estaba pensando en lo que le había preguntado.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No siempre es lo peor.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Me gustó una vez que dejé de intentar llenar cada pausa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se aseguró de que supieras que nos estábamos viendo, pero no seguía mencionándote como si necesitara defender mi presencia allí.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y si no estaba seguro de algo, me preguntó.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Finalmente me he sentado bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena como una buena manera de conocerte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se sintió así.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nos tomamos de la mano durante parte del paseo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y fuera de la librería le pregunté si podía besarlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Querías hacerlo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estábamos a punto de despedirnos, y me di cuenta de que estaba buscando otra razón para quedarme.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que dije lo que realmente quería.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y él también quería eso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, lo quería.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fue un poco incómodo encontrar las palabras. El beso no lo fue.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después, me sentí contenta de haber preguntado en lugar de pasar todo el camino a casa preguntándome.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que te sintieras cómodo haciéndolo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también. No sabía esta mañana si siquiera querría quedarme para un segundo trago.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No voy a pretender que lo conozco bien después de una tarde, pero disfruté la tarde que tuvimos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tienes que decidir nada más grande esta noche.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Le dije que había disfrutado conocerlo, y hablaremos de nuevo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No voy a describir cada momento, como dijimos.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te ves cómodo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tienes que hacerlo. Cuéntame cómo te va.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Feliz. Un poco pensativa, pero no molesta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me quedé porque quería estar allí y me fui cuando me apeteció volver a casa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No estaba tratando de hacer que la tarde durara un tiempo determinado o convertirla en algo más grande.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Te sentiste cómodo diciendo lo que querías?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Más cómoda una vez que dejé de ensayar todo en mi cabeza.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay algunas cosas que prefiero mantener para mí por ahora, pero no hay nada que me preocupe y que esté evitando decirte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que realmente importa para mí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta poder decirte que lo disfruté sin tener que explicar cada pequeño motivo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo estar feliz por ti sin saber cada detalle

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extremadamente. Esos zapatos fueron una buena decisión, pero aún quería quitármelos al entrar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Porque estoy feliz ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tú? ¿Cómo fue realmente hoy para ti?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Miré la hora más de lo habitual cuando supe que te ibas a reunir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego dejé el teléfono y continué con mi tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Te preocupabas?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que no eligieras los que solo puedes usar para dar cinco pasos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Principalmente notando que era real, como hablamos anoche

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero no estaba aquí deseando haberte dicho que cancelaras

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que digas eso en lugar de pretender que no sentiste nada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y escuchar que te divertiste ayuda. Me gusta que suenes como tú mismo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sigo siendo yo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Estoy deseando verte mañana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tú? ¿Fue hoy lo que esperabas?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No sabía exactamente qué esperar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A veces aprendo de mis errores

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba contento de que te fueras, luego me di cuenta de que esperaba tu mensaje más que el juego que estaba jugando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es un gran logro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uno enorme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Principalmente me gustó cómo sonabas cuando regresaste. No solo me decías cosas que pensabas que quería escuchar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Quería hablar contigo porque tuve una buena tarde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que me hizo feliz

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me estás haciendo querer ir a abrazarte de nuevo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Antes de decirte algo más, lo que dijiste esta mañana realmente me ayudó

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Te gustó la foto que tomamos juntos en el café?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, me gustó. Fue lindo que quisieras incluirme en ese momento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le pregunté primero, por cierto. Sobre tomarla y enviártela

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé, me lo dijiste

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y luego guardé el teléfono. No quería pasar toda la cita tratando de enviar lo siguiente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No era necesario. Me gustó recibir algo que realmente querías compartir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sobre elegir por ti misma?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra haber podido contártelo con mis propias palabras después

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que quería. No tenías que pasar la cita recolectando cosas para mí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y aún tienes una foto de tu novia de camino a casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustó especialmente esa parte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tus muy ordinarios privilegios siguen intactos 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dejar mi teléfono a un lado hasta que dijimos adiós ayudó

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No porque no quisiera hablar contigo. Simplemente no quería estar en dos conversaciones a la vez

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prefiero poder hablar bien ahora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también. Quería tu atención cuando realmente tenía tiempo para disfrutarlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta que guardar algunos momentos para mí no significa que tenga que estar distante contigo esta noche

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No quería distancia. Quería que tuvieras espacio para ser tú mismo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se siente diferente ahora que realmente lo he tenido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al principio todavía me sorprendía pensando en lo que pensarías de lo que hiciera después

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, ¿llegaste a casa bien?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Estás libre después del almuerzo mañana?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Para una mujer con una película y una cantidad absurda de pasta? Sí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Quiero verte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Llevaré el recipiente, y no puedes hacer como que no recuerdas haber aceptado mi elección de película

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo recuerdo. Incluso hice espacio en el sofá

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Para mí o para la pasta?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podemos discutir prioridades cuando llegues

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Respuesta incorrecta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Para ti. La pasta puede tener una silla

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mucho mejor

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego recordé que no estabas en casa esperando a que siguiera instrucciones

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extrañé sentarme a tu lado hoy

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes tener tanto de eso como quieras mañana

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo la intención de hacerlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Estás cansada ahora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un poco. No del tipo miserable, solo lista para dejar de mirar una pantalla

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjame meterme en la cama antes de que termine durmiendo aquí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7 MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo logré. Incluso recordé enchufar el teléfono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una mujer organizada

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Brevemente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No lo estaba

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Este es solo para ti antes de dejarlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ojalá estuviera allí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mañana. Y entonces podrás escuchar mi excelente comentario sobre la película en persona

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Eso está incluido en la visita?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No puedes apagarlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No iba a hacerlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buenas noches, guapo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buenas noches, chica bonita. Me alegra que hayas tenido un buen día

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también. Estoy deseando verte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustó poder desear algo sin convertirlo de inmediato en una pregunta para ti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que quería que tuvieras

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y no estaba tratando de ir más allá solo porque dijiste que podía

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso también hizo la diferencia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. No poner límites no debería convertirse en un objetivo que tuvieras que alcanzar

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No lo hizo. Por una vez no estaba tratando de obtener la respuesta correcta 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Dejé mis cosas y pasé cinco minutos buscando el teléfono que acababa de meterme en el bolsillo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después del café, fuimos al pequeño jardín a un par de calles de distancia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo fue él una vez que realmente estabas en la cita?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siguió siendo él mismo. Se quejó de las tazas antes de que incluso hubiéramos pedido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero fue más honesto de lo habitual cuando no estaba seguro de qué decir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Admitió que había pasado tanto tiempo esperando que estuvieras molesto con él que todavía estaba tratando de acostumbrarse a esto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo imaginar.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No le di toda nuestra conversación. Solo le dije que no estaba siguiendo una lista de cosas que tú habías permitido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Distractada?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo se lo tomó?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se sorprendió de nuevo. Luego entendió que debería preguntarme qué quería

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dejamos de hablar sobre la situación después de eso y realmente tuvimos una cita

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que pudieras dejar atrás las explicaciones

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también. Recordó muchas cosas pequeñas sobre mí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y pude escucharlo decir algo bonito sin convertirlo de inmediato en una broma

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso ya vale un segundo café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No le digas eso. Comenzará a anunciar cada cumplido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces nos detuvimos en el jardín, y {{name:aiden}} me besó.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Él te besó primero?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un poco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Antes de que pudiera decidir qué iba a decir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo empujé un poco hacia atrás.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Estabas bien?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, me sorprendió un poco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quería un segundo. Se detuvo, y luego empezó a verse demasiado satisfecho consigo mismo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena como él.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, él había decidido que yo lo iba a besar de todos modos, así que solo se estaba adelantando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que encontró la manera de tener razón.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exactamente 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siguió burlándose de mí por eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Apareció la calceta que faltaba?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que lo besé yo misma para callarlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y porque tú querías?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Molestamente, esas dos cosas pasaron al mismo tiempo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Funcionó eso de callarlo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Durante el beso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego preguntó quién besa mejor, ¿él o tú?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿De verdad te preguntó eso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Aparentemente era una pregunta muy importante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le dije que convierte todo en una competencia. Juegos, clases, aparentemente esto también.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y eso lo detuvo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dentro de una manga. Nadie entiende cómo llegó ahí

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que no

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que le dije que por ahora todavía estaba muy atrás.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Por ahora?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, no empieces.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He pasado la tarde con un idiota competitivo. No necesito otro esta noche.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo estoy disfrutando de mi ventaja.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y demostrando mi punto 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo lo tomó?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se rió y decidió que le había lanzado un desafío.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dije que no era para eso. Aparentemente, eso no importó.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu lavadora tiene un sentido del humor muy limitado

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena correcto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sabía que reconocerías ese comportamiento.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sabes que no tienes que hacerlo sonar peor para que yo me sienta mejor.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No lo estoy. Me gustó besarlo, incluso si fue imposible después.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que puedas decirme eso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y la segunda vez, no estaba sorprendida ni tratando de averiguar qué debería hacer. Solo quería.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Fue extraño después?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo por un momento. Luego volvió a hablar demasiado y dejé de pensar tanto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nos sentamos a la sombra un rato. Amenacé con hacerlo sentar solo si seguía comentando sobre todo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El romance está vivo y bien.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensé que apreciarías la actualización

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amas a la misma mujer. Sabes a lo que te estás metiendo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él preguntó sobre hacer planes de nuevo, pero no quería organizar la próxima cita mientras aún estaba en esta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso tiene sentido

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No era una forma de desanimarlo. Solo quería llegar a casa y dejar que hoy se asiente un poco.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te dije que fuimos a dar un paseo después del café.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Había una librería en la que quería mirar, así que terminamos hojeando las estanterías de segunda mano.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿De ahí vino el libro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Lo elegí porque la descripción sonaba ridícula y quería saber si la historia podría ser aún peor.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo hago. También me interesan tus aventuras tan poco emocionantes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: No soy ese tipo de persona

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tienes permiso para volver a elogiarme, por cierto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Y no me voy a levantar pronto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: A menos que alguien venga a molestarme
Solo me aseguro de que recuerdes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Estaba un poco preocupada de que te despertaras y pretendieras que nunca pasó

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hoy estoy presentando y de repente mi introducción se ve desconocida 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Preferiría tener solo a ti en la audiencia otra vez

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Puede que esté sesgado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Eres muy sesgada. Me gusta ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aún escuché bien

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lo hiciste. Por eso te estoy escribiendo en lugar de reescribir todo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Listo. Notas revisadas, laptop cargada, sin bolsas en tu lugar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Entonces ya estás un paso adelante de ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Por favor, no me recuerdes la situación de la bolsa 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Te ves bien. Ahora ve y muéstrales que conoces tu tema

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: ¿La misma que pasaste sin tus notas anoche?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Te diré cómo me va después

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Estaré esperando. Buena suerte, amor ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Gracias. Te quiero

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sí. Mi cerebro ha elegido un momento muy inconveniente para dudarlo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lo explicaste claramente ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Y respondiste a mis preguntas sin tener que buscar en las diapositivas

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lo sé. Simplemente es diferente con todos mirándome

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tómate un segundo antes de empezar. No tienes que apresurarte a la primera frase

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Me apresuro cuando estoy nerviosa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Entonces ten en mente el ejemplo del café. Sabías exactamente cómo explicarlo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Está bien. Relájate y empieza con el ejemplo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Entonces pasaré más tarde esta noche
No. Vendré más tarde esta noche

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Está bien. ¿Puedo pasar más tarde esta noche?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ahora preguntas después de ya haber decidido

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: La puerta estará desbloqueada cuando vengas esta noche

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mándame un mensaje cuando estés listo para venir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pensando en ir a tu habitación

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Solo para que sepas en qué estás entrando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ¿Qué pasó con la versión tranquila de ti?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Solo decidió disfrutar de la vida también

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Está hecho. Y salió bien 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Muy familiar 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Casi me río porque habíamos hablado exactamente de eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Podía responder sin mirar mis notas

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eso es genial. Ya lo sabías, solo necesitabas practicar decirlo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aparentemente sí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: No fue perfecto, sin embargo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Qué pasó?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hice clic en la siguiente diapositiva mientras aún estaba explicando la primera

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Luego hice clic hacia atrás demasiado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un tour sorpresa de la presentación

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ahí está. ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Exactamente. Todos pudieron admirar el título dos veces 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Encontraste la diapositiva correcta de nuevo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sí. Dije que la laptop era más impaciente que yo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Algunas personas se rieron. Luego continué

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Esa es una buena recuperación

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Yo también lo pensé

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aún no tengo la calificación, pero el profesor dijo que los ejemplos eran claros

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Deberías estar contento con eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lo estoy ❤️ Y me alegra que me ayudaste ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Me alegra que ayudara. Hiciste la presentación tú mismo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aliviada. Creo que estaba conteniendo la respiración antes de empezar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ahora puedo dejar de ensayar frases cada vez que tengo un minuto tranquilo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Disfruta el minuto tranquilo, entonces

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Con almuerzo esta vez. Uno de verdad

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un excelente seguimiento a tu éxito académico

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Hablamos esta noche? Quiero escuchar sobre tu día también

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Por supuesto. Disfruta tu almuerzo, amor

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lo haré ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: ¿Te volvió la introducción?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sí. Reduje la velocidad como dijiste

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Luego, una vez que entré en el ejemplo del café, se sintió mucho más fácil

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien. ¿Y las preguntas?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Te va a gustar esto

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: El profesor preguntó qué haría que alguien eligiera entre dos lugares con productos y precios similares

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Eso suena familiar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}} baja su teléfono y te mira
No estaba 100% segura de que lo harías.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK archivó evidencia de proximidad íntima en habitación privada

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Eres tú quien está presionando contra mí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si sigues mirándome así, te voy a besar otra vez

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK archivó evidencia de un beso íntimo en un entorno privado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ese fue incluso mejor que ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If we keep going I won’t want to stop
And if I don’t want to stop either?
Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Vuelve a tu habitación antes de que cambie de opinión

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si hablo en voz alta ahora mismo, me voy a poner rara.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Solo... déjame enviar mensajes un rato.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Estás ahí parado como si no supieras qué hacer.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estoy en casa, y voy a guardar esas diapositivas para esta noche

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Te gustaría venir y quedarte a pasar la noche conmigo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cenar, pasar tiempo juntos y sin tener que irse al final

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sí ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SíSíSíSíSíSíSí❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me encantaría eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pensé en preguntar ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Deberías haberlo hecho. Me habría tentado

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pero mañana es mejor. Puedo traer lo que necesito en lugar de improvisar

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Cuándo puedes venir?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi tarde está libre después de la universidad

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien merecido. ¿Cómo fue el resto de tu día?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Puedo ir a casa, recoger mis cosas y llegar alrededor de las cinco

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cinco suena bien
