story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y esta vez, me quedo cuando me pides que me acerque 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eso es lo que espero con ansias

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Yo también

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Estoy recogiendo mi bolso ahora, antes de que olvide algo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cepillo de dientes, ropa limpia para el jueves, cargador

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Muy organizada

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estoy intentando. ¿Puedo pedir prestada una camiseta para dormir?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Mucho más fácil una vez que no estaba pensando en presentar más

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Claro. Te has visto bien con la mía antes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entonces te dejaré elegir una para mí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Consideralo listo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espero que sepas que podría encariñarme con eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Asumiré el riesgo

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ahí. Casi empacada

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te ves muy contenta con eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo estoy. Esta bolsa en realidad debería quedarse en tu casa mañana

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Junto con su dueña

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué hiciste?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Especialmente su dueña ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: De hecho, antes de terminar de empacar...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué estás haciendo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dándote un pequeño adelanto 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué piensas?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te ves preciosa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Y esa sonrisa me dice que sabías exactamente lo que hacías

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quería distraerte un poco 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Algunas diligencias, un paseo corto, luego algunas cosas por la casa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionó. Ahora desearía que estuvieras aquí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué harías si yo estuviera?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te acercaría y te besaría antes de que hayas desempacado esa bolsa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entonces dejaré el desempacar para más tarde ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Espera. Una más antes de que cambie

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UN MINUTO DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ahí. Tu último adelanto para esta noche

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me haces sentir que mañana será muy peligroso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tengo muchas ganas de ver tu cara cuando realmente esté frente a ti

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Cómo estuvo el paseo?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Acércate lo suficiente y no tendrás que adivinar cuánto me gusta

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tengo la intención de 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mantén esas fotos solo para ti

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Por supuesto. Se quedan entre nosotros

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Mañana puedes dejar el teléfono y prestarme atención en persona

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tendrás toda mi atención

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eso es lo que quería escuchar ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Debería preocuparme de que te lleves todo el edredón?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo si planeas dormir muy lejos de mí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No estaba planeando eso

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Aún yendo despacio, pero se sintió bien salir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entonces estaremos bien 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aunque no puedo prometer que no pondré mis pies fríos contra ti

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eso no estaba en la invitación

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Viene con la novia. Deberías haber leído los detalles

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sobreviviré

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Quiero que estés ahí cuando me despierte también

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tendrás mi presencia allí

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Esa es la parte en la que sigo pensando

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sentirme cómoda contigo y no tener que mirar la hora para irme a casa

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me gustó tenerte a mi lado ayer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me alegra ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mañana podemos quedarnos así

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Haces que la espera se sienta más larga 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo hasta mañana por la tarde

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Terminaré de empacar y trataré de dejar de mirar la hora

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dime si quieres que traiga algo para la cena

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo tú y tu bolsa. Yo me encargo de la comida

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ambos llegarán juntos esta vez 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buenas noches, amor. Tengo muchas ganas de mañana

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Yo también. Buenas noches ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quería preguntarte algo sobre mañana

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ¿Qué tienes en mente?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buenos días ❤️ ¿Está mi coleta a salvo, o se la ha quedado tu sofá?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, no tengo tiempo para explicar otro 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Primero clase, luego trabajo. Solo me estoy preparando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A menos que tu guardia también esté entregando la liga para el cabello
Está al lado de mis llaves

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lavandería, luego quiero terminar ese juego que empecé

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuelga la ropa antes de empezar a jugar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prefiero escuchar sobre tu juego que sobre una máquina llena de ropa húmeda 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Debería terminar a las cinco otra vez, luego directo a casa

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tú también. Preferiría seguir en tu sofá, pero el autobús no me esperará

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y mi liga para el cabello 😌 Te quiero

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias, se merece un trato adecuado

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, mejor que la noche anterior

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podría haberme quedado bajo esa manta otra hora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Estoy empezando a disfrutar de estas lecciones privadas.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Por qué todavía tengo que revisar si ya tenemos... un acuerdo?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo tomó más tiempo de lo esperado.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Porque aún necesito demostrar que estás trabajando conmigo.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Así que es solo por el papeleo?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hola 😊 He encontrado un banco para almorzar en lugar de comer al lado de la impresora hoy

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo está, antes de que pidas pruebas

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Excelente, estoy orgullosa de ti ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos luego

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Más tarde esa tarde, mientras revisan el horario del día siguiente en la oficina del gerente...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversación de oficina detectada cerca de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ayer todo parecía tan fácil cuando estábamos juntos. Ahora estoy mirando esa oficina otra vez, temiendo que una buena noche no haya cambiado nada.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPCIÓN EN VIVO

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te ves bien con el pelo suelto

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Es esa tu contribución al trabajo de esta tarde?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puedo admirarte y leer un horario

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces intenta hacer el segundo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una gran mejora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mucho menos interesante

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tomará aún más tiempo si sigues mirándome en lugar de eso

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Casi no fuiste sutil

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No estaba tratando de serlo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Claramente

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ven mañana. Yo haré la cena

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿A tu casa?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahí es donde está mi cocina

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sabes por qué pregunto

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y sabes que no te invito para hablar de tu trabajo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: También hace un ruido de fondo mucho mejor

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hablamos de esto ayer

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tenías planes ayer. Estoy preguntando sobre mañana

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me refería al resto de esa conversación

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tuve una noche realmente buena con él

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy segura de que sí

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces deja de actuar como si faltara algo que vas a arreglar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No estoy ofreciendo arreglar nada. Quiero otra noche contigo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Haces que todo suene tan simple

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La cena es simple. Estás pensando en todo lo que viene después

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estoy pensando si debería estar allí en absoluto

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Qué tienes?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Disfrutaste la otra noche

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y me sentí horrible después. Sigues omitiendo esa parte

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me gustó tenerte solo para mí una noche. Me gustaría hacerlo de nuevo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No te daré una respuesta ahora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces piénsalo. A las siete, si decides venir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} vuelve a mirar el horario abierto en el escritorio

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Su gerente la observa desde el otro lado, recostado en su silla

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sabes por qué estoy dudando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé. Estoy preguntando si tú también quieres uno

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Otro beso, y ella le corresponde. La noche que pasamos juntos todavía significa mucho para mí, pero ahora mismo parece dolorosamente lejana.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Después de salir del trabajo, en camino a la parada del autobús...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ya salí ❤️ Voy a casa ahora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Todo terminado?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, el horario de mañana finalmente está listo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Algo de lo que no tendrás que preocuparte esta noche entonces

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, una cosa menos

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te escribiré cuando esté adentro

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien, hablamos en un rato

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo es. Estoy disfrutando no ser preguntada dónde está algo durante diez minutos

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Tu supervisor de lavado está fuera de servicio entonces?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo si realmente está colgado

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Pareces realmente feliz con estas lecciones privadas últimamente.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Incluso estoy emocionada de verlo ahora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Solías quejarte de cada sesión extra

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: O tal vez solo encontré una mejor manera de estudiar

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ahora deja de interrogarme y ve a dormir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Estás de buen humor y sonriendo cuando llegas a casa.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Alguien suena celoso de mi profesor 😏

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Es solo que es muy bueno en lo que hace

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ Estoy en casa. ¿Lograste terminar tu juego?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
You look comfortable
I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy ❤️ Aunque tu sofá tenía mejor compañía

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guardé esa foto que tomaste anoche

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Realmente lo fue. Lo había extrañado

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La próxima vez encontraré algo mejor para ver

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me molesta tanto la película

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De todos modos, verte reírte en las partes equivocadas fue la mitad del entretenimiento

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Casi, he estado atascado en la misma parte durante una hora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente ese es mi papel ahora

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un poco más tarde, su manager envía un mensaje...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De vuelta a tu conversación, unos minutos después...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, puede que llegue a casa un poco más tarde mañana

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Algunas personas del trabajo están cenando

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
Yeah, a few of us
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien, solo avísame cuando regreses

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No hace falta que estés revisando tu teléfono toda la noche

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me olvidaré de enviarte un mensaje

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé, solo quería decirlo de nuevo

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a guardar mi plato y meterme en la cama

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
Including blaming the controller?
That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya cambié. Estoy haciendo algo rápido, luego no me moveré mucho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Está bien, voy a arrastrarte de la cama

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} arrastró a {{name:hailey}} de la cama después de múltiples mensajes ignorados

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y aún así eres la que sigue en la cama

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Y ponte un poco más de ropa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t make me come up there

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hola 😊 No hay alarma hoy, y he decidido que vestirme puede esperar hasta después del desayuno ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: He estado cuidándolo toda la mañana.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ANTES DE QUE SALGA DE CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vale, tengo la comida, la película y la tapa que realmente encaja esta vez.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Has empacado para una pequeña expedición.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo porque no se puede confiar en que tengas suficientes servilletas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tráete a ti mismo. Lo demás es negociable.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso fue lo suficientemente agradable como para que dejara de quejarme.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Disfrutaré del silencio mientras dure.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No por mucho tiempo. Estoy en camino ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Durante los próximos veinte minutos, absolutamente 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Después de eso, voy al mercadillo cerca de la panadería

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Por algo que necesitas?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Necesito salir de casa sin tomar la misma ruta por una vez.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y necesito algo rico para comer contigo después ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Yo pensé que la pasta era algo rico.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo es. Pero la pasta no cuenta como postre, por mucho que la elogies.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahí se va mi plan de la tarde.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: También vas a ver la película que elegí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo recuerdo. No he planeado un corte de luz misterioso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena sospechosamente como un día libre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Más te vale que no. Finalmente encontré una que no me has contado el final.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso pasó una vez.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dijiste que el hermano se veía sospechoso antes de que hablara.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estaba usando guantes dentro de casa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estaba lavando los platos 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un disfraz convincente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedes guardar tu trabajo de detective para ti hoy.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí 😌 Sin turno, sin prisas esta mañana

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y estoy deseando ver tu cara en lugar de preguntarme qué significa la pausa entre mensajes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La pausa fue principalmente porque intentaba encontrar las palabras adecuadas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Hoy puedes hablar con la boca llena como una persona normal.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso puedo manejarlo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Quiero una tarde agradable contigo, no otra reunión seria.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sonabas tan contento anoche que casi voy solo para ver la expresión que lo acompañaba.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedes revisarlo esta tarde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: He abierto la ventana y estoy tomando mi café mientras aún está caliente ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tengo intención de hacerlo. Desde bien cerca

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intentaré no verme demasiado satisfecho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso sería un lindo cambio 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Te quedas en casa después de eso?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aún no he decidido qué hacer toda la noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso es parte de lo que me gusta de hoy

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una experiencia desconocida

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} me envió una foto de un cartel de arcade antes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ha descubierto otro lugar para quejarse de perder?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aparentemente solo estaba haciendo una sugerencia útil para mi día libre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Así es como te atrapa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le dije que ya tenía planes contigo esta tarde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dijo que te preguntara si la mesa de hockey de aire cuenta como terreno neutral

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo hasta que pierda. Entonces la mesa está involucrada en una conspiración

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quizás vaya más tarde. Disfrutaría verlo intentar explicar eso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No aceptes jugar al mejor de tres si ya has ganado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. Podría volverme difícil de tratar si me acostumbro a esto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo estoy anotando 😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: El chico de ayer me envió un mensaje sobre ese libro que vimos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿El de la tienda?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. Aparentemente, la primera página valía la pena llegar a casa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo he leído la contraportada, así que le dije que no se pusiera tan engreído todavía

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un comienzo prometedor para un club de lectura

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Principalmente somos nosotros buscando nuevas formas de evitar decir que queremos seguir hablando

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entonces, te has dado cuenta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Podría?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puede que deje de ser sutil más tarde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por ahora le dije que pasaré la tarde contigo. Hablaremos esta noche 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Odiaría compartir mis excelentes comentarios sobre películas con un teléfono

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo dejaré en mi bolsa. Para los comentarios, no para ti

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cierto, debería ponerme ropa de verdad antes de que la panadería venda todo lo que quiero 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ni siquiera has decidido qué quieres

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por eso necesito opciones

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esperaré la investigación

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No te comas todos tus bocadillos antes de que llegue

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuidado, todavía estoy decidiendo qué traerte

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: LUEGO ESE MAÑANA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pequeña actualización: la mujer de la panadería se acordó de mí

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena bien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Recordó que siempre digo que solo voy a comprar pan

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Menos bonito para tu defensa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ella ya había alcanzado una bolsa más grande

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso definitivamente no es solo pan

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hay pan ahí. En algún lugar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Conseguí dos pasteles de manzana para nosotros, y suficientes otras cosas para que el camino a casa valga la pena 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te ves feliz.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estoy. Pasé diez minutos mirando flores sin calcular a dónde tenía que ir después.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No compré ninguna. Solo disfruté estar allí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Deberíamos tener más días así.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, deberíamos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voy a casa a recoger el recipiente, luego vendré después del almuerzo como dijimos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿La una y media sigue bien?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Perfecto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pondré las bebidas en la nevera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y deja mi lado del sofá libre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pareces que ya has hecho las paces con no hacer nada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Viste el culo que tengo con esto puesto? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Al gimnasio o a tu cita con tu entrenador?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No estés buscando otro atuendo indecente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voy a pasar la tarde con unos amigos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ apenas estoy bajando la calle y ya he pensado en otra razón por la que tu teoría sobre la película no tiene sentido 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y ahora qué?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cabina de fotos es tentadora 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Para preservar la evidencia de mi derrota?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, porque quiero ver si puedes hacer cuatro fotos sin poner una cara rara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poco probable. Ese es un reto muy injusto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS, EN LA CABINA DE FOTOS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te das cuenta de que voy a arruinar al menos una de estas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Al menos una? Eso es optimista

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Acércate, entonces. Necesito todas las ventajas posibles

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así no funcionan las cabinas de fotos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tú trajiste la mayor parte contigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Demasiado tarde. La cuenta regresiva ha comenzado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Los sujetos entran en la cabina de fotos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Serie de fotografías personales capturadas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quiero que disfrute de la noche, y puedo admitir que me da curiosidad lo cerca que se están volviendo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tira de Fotomatón I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tira de Fotomatón II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hiciste una cara rara en la primera

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y tú sonreíste en todas, así que sigo pensando que gané

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Así no es como se gana

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces explica la última foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me besaste antes de que saliera el flash 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y ahora está preservado para siempre. De nada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me refería a la parte en la que dejamos de hablar y solo nos sentamos juntos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eres imposible 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sigues eligiendo pinball después de esto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Y aún no voy a pasar toda la noche llevando la cuenta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Literalmente hay una puntuación en ese también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes quedarte con la tuya

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: LUEGO, AFUERA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Había olvidado lo ruidosa que puede sonar la calle en silencio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mis oídos todavía están adentro jugando al juego de carreras

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu dignidad también está por ahí dentro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me divertí mucho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me di cuenta de cuánto te había extrañado hasta que estuve allí contigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿A pesar de que gané?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿A pesar de que nunca vas a dejarlo ir?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también la pasé bien

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Te acompaño un rato?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Estaba pensando en hacer té cuando regrese

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena sensato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso fue casi una invitación

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Casi?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Te gustaría venir a tomar una taza de té? Aún tenemos el pastelito que te negaste a comer antes de tu gran actuación

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustaría eso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A mí también me gustó. Incluso cuando tu codo encontró mis costillas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y nada de preguntar dónde guardo un segundo control

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ni siquiera lo voy a mencionar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a casa y reclamaré el sofá para mí un rato 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Ya extrañas los comentarios de la película?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sobreviviré. Tengo un libro y alguien que aparentemente ha leído más que yo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Tu nuevo contacto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Hemos estado intercambiando mensajitos desde que dejé tu casa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Recordó que te estaba viendo y esperó hasta que dije que estaba libre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estabas ocupando demasiado del cojín

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Iba a objetar que interrumpiera la importante disputa sobre los cojines

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nadie lo habría entendido sin varias fotografías

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qué pena que no haya un documental

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me animes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DE VUELTA EN CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Encontré mi lugar en el libro. Aún estaba el marcador que pusieron en la tienda 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No es mucho progreso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He avanzado más en la conversación que en la lectura

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a responderle bien en lugar de pretender que puedo hacer las dos cosas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hablamos luego, entonces

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí ❤️ Esta foto era para ti, por cierto. No se ha ganado la historia del marcador vergonzoso 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa misma noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una respuesta en imágenes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo dos fotos que te pueden gustar. Dijo que estaba bien mostrarte la suya también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Han estado intercambiando fotos?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Esta es la sonrisa que pidió

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sé amable. Te dejé sobras de verdad esta vez

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y esta es la foto que tomó en su cocina. La estoy reenviando, no reclamando el trabajo de la cámara 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿El delantal era para establecer sus credenciales?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente, la cena no pudo sonreír para la cámara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa es una respuesta que te gustaría

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Me reí antes de poder fingir lo contrario

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu foto es preciosa, por cierto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sabía que notarías esa primero ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y tu cuchara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuídala. Espero una reunión dramática

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tuviste dos horas para decírmelo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a encontrarme con {{name:aiden}} después de dejar el recipiente en casa 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿El arcade?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Dijo que sería una pena dejar que tu consejo experto se desperdiciara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No sabe ni la mitad

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya me advirtió que una de las máquinas se traga las monedas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Útil. Una excusa lista antes de que llegues

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le voy a permitir exactamente una

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba ocupado tratando de verlo mientras tú acusabas a todos de algo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generoso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quería verlo de nuevo, y hacer algo suena mejor que otra conversación cuidadosa sobre café

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ve y diviértete. No necesitas otra charla de mi parte

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Ya he tenido suficientes instrucciones del detective en el sofá 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PRIMERA NOCHE, FUERA DEL ARCADA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¡Llegué 🎮! Se puede escuchar este lugar desde la acera

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No dejes que elija todos los juegos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él acaba de llegar y señaló una máquina de carreras

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que sí

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tenía razón sobre una persona

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a guardar mi teléfono. Deséame suerte 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No lo necesitarás

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DENTRO DEL ARCADA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viniste preparado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Para qué?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Zapatos sensatos. Eso es alguien que espera ganar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es alguien que caminó por un mercado esta mañana

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te traje algo, de hecho

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Ya un premio de consolación?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un pastelito. Aún puedo comerlo yo misma

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de acusar a los siete

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, aceptaré la disculpa por adelantado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me lo pones muy difícil para ser considerada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias. Eso fue muy amable de tu parte

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí. ¿Ves cuánto esfuerzo te costó?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Vas a supervisar cada frase esta noche?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo las que son molestas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa es la mayor parte de mi material

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tendrás que improvisar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE SU PRIMER JUEGO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ese primer punto no cuenta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un trabajo de detective muy completo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La máquina no está de acuerdo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo golpeaste antes de que estuviera lista

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estabas explicando lo fácil que iba a ser esto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba siendo acogedor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dijiste que serías fácil conmigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y claramente eso fue un error

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Así que admites que gané?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Admito que hay espacio para un segundo juego

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Tú elegiste la primera máquina. Yo elijo la siguiente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Juego terminado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} gana la primera ronda

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y aún así no te diste cuenta de que robé el último bocado de tu pastel

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un perdedor muy amargado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}} te ha metido esta idea en la cabeza

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
