story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me advirtió que pedirías otra ronda si perdías

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a hablar con él

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sobre conocerte demasiado bien?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sobre entrenar a la oposición?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Logré golpear un disco sin que ninguno de ustedes me ayudara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo hiciste. Ese último tiro fue bueno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo siento, ¿puedes repetir eso? La máquina estaba haciendo ruido

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te pases

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo noté. Te lo dejé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puede que necesite un momento para apreciarlo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te daré cinco segundos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Realmente cuentas todo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Puedo tomarme una foto contigo? Me gustaría enviarle una

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto. ¿Va a estar el marcador en la foto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No estaba. Excelente sugerencia

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al menos dame un segundo para parecer menos derrotado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que elijo creer

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Demasiado tarde. Esa es la cara que quiero

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN MOMENTO DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aceptó hacerse una foto. La expresión es totalmente obra suya

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Reconozco esa cara

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te está echando la culpa por avisarme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dile que estoy disfrutando mi retiro de escuchar sus excusas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por ahora le voy a perdonar esa 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE GUARDÓ SU TELÉFONO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias por esta tarde ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sé que no le harás daño

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: De hecho, hace las cosas más fáciles
No hay necesidad de esconder nada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: No pude evitar tomarle una foto 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ella quiere cardio más que nada 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Estoy muy feliz con cómo salió 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Se va a llevar su dinero a casa 😂

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Algo pasó en el vestuario cuando nos íbamos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ella quería seguir un poco más

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Nunca pensé que tendría esta conversación contigo sobre {{name:hailey}} 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Pero aunque sea raro… es un poco genial

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Voy a pasar mañana para una tarde de juegos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sé que ustedes dos tienen un crush el uno con el otro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¡Hola 😊! Te debo una tapa de recipiente. De alguna manera, también la he traído a casa 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso es considerablemente menos ruido que el arcade

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No tienes idea. Casi he recuperado mi audición. Otras partes de mí están menos tranquilas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Te ves feliz.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí ❤️ Vamos a dejar los teléfonos a un lado un rato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hablamos luego

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE GUARDÓ SU TELÉFONO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esa noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Si sigo así mucho más, voy a olvidar que quería irme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso no es un accidente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu camisa se ha subido

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo noté. Puedes dejar tu mano ahí

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me lo pones muy difícil para ser el primero en levantarme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Entonces bésame una vez más y luego levántate. No te llevaré a la cama esta noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No iba a preguntar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estabas pensando en eso. Yo también. Por eso lo digo ahora

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un último beso profundo en el sofá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Su mano en su cintura, la de ella bajo el dobladillo de su camisa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esto avanza rápido, y quiero que sigamos hablando con sinceridad de lo que nos parece bien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me gustó esta noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿También la parte más tranquila?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN POCO DESPUÉS, EN CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Especialmente esa parte. Tu boca. Tus manos. Todo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puedes irte sin intentar hacer un comentario ingenioso de despedida, ¿sabes?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Iba a decir que me gustaría verte de nuevo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puedes quedarte con esa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mándame un mensaje mañana. Arreglaremos algo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo haré

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y lleva la caja de pasteles. Si la dejas aquí, terminaré comiendo el resto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una responsabilidad muy difícil

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: De alguna manera, creo que lo manejarás

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE SE VAYA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿{{name:player}}?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se ha ido a casa. Terminamos quedándonos en el sofá mucho más tiempo del que habíamos planeado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Entonces, el té fue una idea exitosa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí, mucho. Hablamos, nos sentamos cerca, y luego lo atraje hacia mí

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sus manos estaban debajo de mi blusa. Las mías estaban debajo de su camisa. Nos besamos hasta que tuve que decirle que no íbamos a ir más lejos esta noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Finalmente dejó de preguntar si lo estaba haciendo mejor que tú

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso es un gran avance

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No conviertas el no competir en una competencia 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estoy aprendiendo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se sintió diferente esta noche. Menos como si estuviéramos tratando de averiguar qué se suponía que debía pasar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí. Accidentalmente traje a casa su tapa de recipiente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Quería que sus manos estuvieran sobre mí, así que las puse allí. No necesitaba otro discurso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se te nota a gusto con eso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo estoy. Un poco sonrojada. Y me alegra haber pasado esta tarde contigo también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estoy sola de nuevo. Fue una noche encantadora

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se te oye contenta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo estoy. Es un cansancio agradable, todavía tengo algo de calor y me alegra mucho no haber pasado todo el día pendiente del reloj

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mantén los detalles que quieras mantener. Me alegra que te hayas divertido

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Gracias. Aún quiero unos minutos contigo antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ustedes dos van a necesitar un inventario

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esa noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una razón para sonreír

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Finalmente dejé la app 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Lograste leer algo del libro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Algo. Muy poco después de que comenzamos a hablar de ayer. Luego incluso menos después de las fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Él me dijo que estaba buscando una excusa para no dejar la librería. Y que quería tenerme bien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y tú estabas tratando de pensar en una razón para quedarte.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Él tiene mi cuchara. Estamos negociando

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Exacto. Parece que hemos aclarado ese malentendido 😌❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Los mensajes fueron mucho menos cautelosos esta noche.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿No tenías que seguir fingiendo que solo hablaban del libro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No. Le dije que quería volver a verlo. Y no solo hablar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y nos enviamos un par de fotos más. Luego un par que eran menos inocentes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Él aceptó que te mostrara estas dos. Las otras quedan entre él y yo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Podría mediar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esa es la sonrisa que normalmente significa que estás fingiendo que no has hecho nada.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Él también lo notó. Muy incómodo para mí. La tira no ayudaba a mi situación.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y esta es la que él tomó y me devolvió.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ustedes dos parecen estar disfrutando la conversación.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo estábamos. Ninguno de los dos leyó mucho después de eso. Guardé las últimas fotos para mí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: El pobre libro.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se recuperará. No estoy segura de que yo lo haga antes de mañana.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Era más fácil hablar por mensajes?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Disputaste una puntuación mostrada en números. No creo que estés calificado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: En algunos aspectos. Podía pensar un segundo sin preocuparme de que el silencio se viera raro.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Pero también me sorprendí deseando escuchar cómo diría algo, no solo leerlo. Y deseando sus manos en lugar de otra foto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso suena como una razón para otra cita.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo es. Hablaremos mañana y elegiremos un horario.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Para esta noche, ya no quiero cambiar entre conversaciones.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me gustaría un poco de tiempo contigo antes de dormir ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: He terminado de enviar mensajes por esta noche. Tuve una noche realmente agradable.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿El libro recibió mucha atención?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Quieres azúcar?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No es suficiente para pretender que me he convertido en una lectora seria

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Reservaré mi juicio hasta que llegues al siguiente capítulo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Gracias. Esta noche me guardo el resto de los detalles

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Está bien. ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Feliz. Hace un poco de calor para dormir de inmediato. Y lista para hablar contigo un minuto ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uno, por favor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Es esa tu forma de organizar otra visita?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Cómo estuvo tu noche después de que me fui?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tranquila. Terminé de ordenar y luego jugué un rato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Te quedaste pensando de nuevo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un poco, pero esta tarde ayudó más que quedarme aquí tratando de predecirlo todo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Todavía discutimos sobre la película, todavía me robaste la comida. Nada se sintió forzado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo fue. Estaba exactamente donde quería estar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sé. Casi te quedas dormida en mí

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso fue un cumplido para el sofá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Obviamente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Ves? Una preferencia. Muy impresionante

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Pareces haber tenido un día muy bueno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí. Más tranquilo, pero me gustó pasar la tarde contigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí. Más tranquilo, pero me gustó pasar la tarde contigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sigo recordando cómo intentabas mover mi brazo sin admitir que querías apoyarte en él

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu codo estaba ocupando una cantidad completamente irrazonable de espacio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: La próxima vez lo organizaré de manera más conveniente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Please do. I'm a demanding guest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Por favor, hazlo. Soy una invitada exigente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me alegra que hoy no haya sido solo ayer con ropa diferente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You saved that one all the way from yesterday
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Guardaste esa desde ayer

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Deberíamos poner eso en el calendario. Hacer algo diferente de vez en cuando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Podrías dejarme elegir la próxima película sin necesidad de pedirlo formalmente.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Let's not get carried away
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No nos emocionemos demasiado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you, you know ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Te amo, lo sabes ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Yo también te amo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Now I'm going to get into bed before I start typing with my eyes closed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ahora me voy a meter en la cama antes de que empiece a escribir con los ojos cerrados.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UNOS MINUTOS DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Made it 😊 This one is just for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ya estoy en la cama 😊 Esta foto es solo para ti.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's my favorite end to the day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esa es mi forma favorita de terminar el día.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I've been waiting for the right moment
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: He estado esperando el momento adecuado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing me finally stop talking?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Verme finalmente dejar de hablar?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing you look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Verte feliz.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Oh. Now I have to be nice instead of making another joke
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oh. Ahora tengo que ser amable en lugar de hacer otra broma.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can manage one message
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puedes manejar un mensaje.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night, handsome ❤️ Thank you for today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Buenas noches, guapo ❤️ Gracias por hoy.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night. I'll keep your side of the sofa ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Buenas noches. Tendré tu lado del sofá listo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And my spoon 😌 Don't forget my spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y mi cuchara 😌 No olvides mi cuchara.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER THEY SIT DOWN WITH THEIR TEA
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE SE SIENTAN CON SU TÉ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is much nicer than shouting over a machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esto es mucho mejor que gritar sobre una máquina

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were the one doing most of the shouting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tú eras el que más gritaba

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I got involved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Me involucré

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You explained your strategy to a puck
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le explicaste tu estrategia a un disco

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And it refused to listen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y se negó a escuchar

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I had a nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tuve una noche agradable

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No 😌 I was going to do that without stealing your kitchen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No 😌 iba a hacer eso sin robarte la cocina

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: So did I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Yo también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not only saying that because I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo digo solo porque gané

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You get easier to talk to when you stop trying to win the conversation as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Te vuelves más fácil de hablar cuando dejas de intentar ganar la conversación también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't aware there were points for that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No sabía que había puntos por eso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You'd find some
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Encontrarías algunos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: All right. No points tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Está bien. Sin puntos esta noche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't say it like you're doing me a favor
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo digas como si me estuvieras haciendo un favor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not. I'm enjoying sitting here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo estoy. Estoy disfrutando estar aquí sentado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Me too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Yo también

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You already left a spoon here. We could call it an exchange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ya dejaste una cuchara aquí. Podríamos llamarlo un intercambio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Cold?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Frío?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Only my hands
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Solo mis manos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: There's a blanket beside you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hay una manta a tu lado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. Your arm is in the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sé. Tu brazo está en el camino.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Should I move it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Debería moverlo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not that way. Here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No así. Aquí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:lena}} moves onto his lap side of the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:lena}} se sienta en su regazo en el sofá.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand settles at her waist under the blanket
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Su mano se posa en su cintura bajo la manta.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: They're getting closer, and I need to notice my own limits as well as respect hers.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se están acercando, y necesito reconocer mis propios límites además de respetar los suyos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Quieter Evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una Noche Más Tranquila

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Better?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Mejor?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Stay there. Your hand can stay too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí. Quédate ahí. Tu mano también puede quedarse.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very domestic hostage situation 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una situación de rehenes muy doméstica 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I can do that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puedo hacer eso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're tracing the edge of my top like you're asking permission
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estás tocando el borde de mi blusa como si pidieras permiso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am asking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Estoy pidiendo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You already have it. Come here
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ya lo tienes. Ven aquí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Here?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Aquí?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You know what I mean
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sabes a qué me refiero.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:lena}} pulls him into a longer kiss
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:lena}} lo atrae hacia un beso más largo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand slides under her top along her back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Su mano se desliza bajo su blusa a lo largo de su espalda.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No Score to Keep
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sin llevar la cuenta de los puntos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't stop just because I made a noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No te detengas solo porque hice un ruido.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That wasn't a complaint
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Eso no fue una queja.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll keep it safe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo mantendré a salvo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. Higher. No — there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo era. Más alto. No — ahí.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your tea is going to go cold
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu té se va a enfriar.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Put the cup down. Carefully. Then come back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Baja la taza. Con cuidado. Luego vuelve.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Cups set aside
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tazas a un lado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Kissing continues on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Los besos siguen en el sofá

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His mouth at her neck, her fingers in his hair
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Su boca en su cuello, sus dedos en su cabello

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tell me if that's too much
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dime si es demasiado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It's not. I wanted your hands on me since the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No lo es. Quería tus manos sobre mí desde la cabina de fotos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You kept looking at my mouth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo noté. No dejabas de mirar mi boca.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you kept finding excuses to stand closer
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y seguías buscando excusas para acercarte más.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Guilty
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Culpable.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good. Keep doing that. Under the blanket is fine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Bien. Sigue así. Bajo la manta está bien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you ❤️ I'll text you properly before I go to sleep 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Gracias ❤️ Te escribiré bien antes de dormir 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His palm slides over her ribs, then higher under the fabric
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Su palma se desliza sobre sus costillas, luego más alto bajo la tela.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: She shifts to straddle one of his thighs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ella se mueve para montar uno de sus muslos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're going to make it very difficult to be polite
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vas a hacer que sea muy difícil ser educado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I didn't invite you in for polite
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No te invité para ser educado.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then I'm going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Entonces te voy a besar de nuevo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: About time you stopped announcing it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ya era hora de que dejaras de anunciarlo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Another longer kiss
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Otro beso más largo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Clothes stay on, hands do not stay still
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: La ropa se queda puesta, las manos no se quedan quietas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Breathing gets less careful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: La respiración se vuelve menos cuidadosa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And for once, no question afterward
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Y por una vez, no hay preguntas después.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to ask where to put my cup
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Iba a preguntar dónde poner mi taza

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Oh
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oh.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Already on the table. Your other hand can stay where it is
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ya está en la mesa. Tu otra mano puede quedarse donde está

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: What question were you expecting?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Qué pregunta esperabas?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You know exactly which one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sabes exactamente cuál

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm not asking for a score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No estoy pidiendo una puntuación

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Bueno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was enjoying that without one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo estaba disfrutando sin eso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a much better answer
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esa es una respuesta mucho mejor

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll try not to ruin it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Intentaré no arruinarlo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could just sit here with me for a while. Hands included
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Podrías quedarte aquí conmigo un rato. Manos incluidas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Gladly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Con gusto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One quick picture before I put the phone away again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Una foto rápida antes de que guarde el teléfono otra vez?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: With me in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: ¿Conmigo en la foto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I'd like to send it to him, like the one earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sí. Me gustaría enviársela, como la de antes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's okay. No scoreboard this time?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Está bien. ¿Esta vez sin el marcador?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No scoreboard. Just us looking like we weren't only drinking tea
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sin marcador. Solo nosotros, con cara de haber hecho algo más que beber té

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Move a little closer or you're only going to be an ear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Acércate un poco más o solo serás una oreja

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN MOMENTO DESPUÉS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We brought the pastry back to mine and made tea. He said I could send you this one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Llevamos el pastel a mi casa e hicimos té. Dijo que también podía enviarte esta foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And you didn't save me anything? Rude 😒
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: ¿Y no me has guardado nada? Qué borde 😒

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Apparently you had a good session
He didn’t show you the photo, did he?
I hope you got a good look 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Espero que hayas tenido una buena vista 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow {{name:aiden}} is coming over to play

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Él sugirió que te unieras a nosotros
Ya me arrepiento de haber preguntado

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} didn’t tell you everything, did he?
Of course we tell each other everything
From what I saw, it’s more you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Por lo que vi, eres más tú

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You better not fail on purpose just to get punished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Más te vale no fallar a propósito solo para que te castiguen

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I’ll just succeed… and still ask for the punishment 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Solo tendré éxito… y aún así pediré el castigo 😌
Solo que no con las revisiones
Estoy a punto de publicar algo
Más te vale que te guste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow I have revision with {{name:ethan}} in the afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Mañana tengo revisión con {{name:ethan}} por la tarde

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s making me take a practice test to see if I improved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Me está haciendo hacer un examen de práctica para ver si mejoré

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: The photo you sent yesterday to cheer me up helped me
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: La foto que me enviaste ayer para animarme me ayudó.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: It actually made me feel better
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: De hecho, me hizo sentir mejor.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I wasn’t sure if it would
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: No estaba seguro de si lo haría.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I’m just happy I have you as my girlfriend
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Solo estoy feliz de tenerte como mi novia.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: You’re going to make me blush 🙈
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Vas a hacer que me sonroje 🙈

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Going to try to take a shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Voy a intentar tomar una ducha.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Don’t get hurt more than you already are 😅
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: No te lastimes más de lo que ya estás 😅
No te preocupes, no lo haré.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Okay I really have to go now
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Está bien, realmente tengo que irme ahora.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Otherwise I’m going to be late ⏳
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: De lo contrario, voy a llegar tarde ⏳

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me when you’re on your break
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mándame un mensaje cuando estés en tu descanso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Try to have a good morning and enjoy your shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Intenta tener una buena mañana y disfruta de tu ducha.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I will try love you good luck

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: It’s about the financial support situation
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Se trata de la situación de apoyo financiero.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: You don’t have to handle everything alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: No tienes que manejarlo todo solo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: We’ll talk about it properly tonight
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Hablaremos de ello correctamente esta noche.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: For now just focus on your day
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Por ahora, solo concéntrate en tu día.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Except for my whole body no
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Excepto por todo mi cuerpo no

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Be patient, a few more days and it should start improving
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Sé paciente, unos días más y debería empezar a mejorar.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: I know, thank you for caring so much
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Lo sé, gracias por preocuparte tanto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: By the way I might have some concerning news
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Por cierto, podría tener algunas noticias preocupantes.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I might have way too much time to do nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Podría tener demasiado tiempo para no hacer nada.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Don’t worry as soon as I finish work and study I’ll keep you company maybe so much that you’ll want to be left alone 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: No te preocupes, tan pronto como termine el trabajo y los estudios, te haré compañía, tal vez tanto que querrás que te dejen solo 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Impossible for me to get tired of you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Imposible para mí cansarme de ti

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Of course of course my lady
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Por supuesto, por supuesto, mi señora.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: No more pics for you you will learn to respect your wife 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: No más fotos para ti, aprenderás a respetar a tu esposa 😌
Sobreviví a la prisa de la mañana.
Está bien, está bien, lo siento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I’m just having fun with you and it makes me really happy
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Solo me estoy divirtiendo contigo y me hace muy feliz.
Está bien, casi se acaba el descanso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: And I’m really happy to see you having fun, even if it’s by teasing me 🙂
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Y estoy realmente feliz de verte divertirte, incluso si es burlándote de mí 🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: See you when you finish work, love you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Te veo cuando termines el trabajo, te quiero.
Este es mi glamuroso lugar de descanso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: But at least I can sit 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Empiezo de nuevo el próximo lunes.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s in two days, it’s quite soon
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Eso es en dos días, es bastante pronto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I wanted more time to stay with you during recovery
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Quería más tiempo para estar contigo durante la recuperación.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve already done more than enough
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Ya has hecho más que suficiente

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s not how I see it
I’ll organize things differently so you won’t be alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Organizaré las cosas de manera diferente para que no estés solo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I don’t want you exhausting yourself because of me
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: No quiero que te agotes por mi culpa.
La vida a veces se ajusta.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: Thanks a lot, again, and I’m sorry I can’t help you right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Muchas gracias, de nuevo, y lamento no poder ayudarte en este momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve done more than enough before
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Has hecho más que suficiente antes.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: My turn to take care of things here
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Es mi turno de encargarme de las cosas aquí.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: And {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} are here too, they will help
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Y {{name:hailey}} y {{name:mason}} también están aquí, ellos ayudarán
Es cierto, pero no te sobrecargues.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: It means I’ll have to go back to work sooner than planned
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Significa que tendré que volver al trabajo antes de lo planeado.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I guess they take anyone now
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Supongo que ahora aceptan a cualquiera.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Tell me I don’t look terrifying
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Dime que no me veo aterrador.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I dropped a girl at training and she cried a little 😭
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Dejé a una chica en el entrenamiento y ella lloró un poco 😭
No es mi culpa, sin embargo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: If you’re making food later I’m stealing some 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Si vas a cocinar más tarde, voy a robar un poco 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Or I’m pulling up and screaming outside your door 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: O si no, voy a aparecer y gritar afuera de tu puerta 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I need you to convince {{name:mason}} to pick me up and drive me to rugby
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Necesito que convenzas a {{name:mason}} para que me recoja y me lleve al rugby

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Coach cleared me for full contact again
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: El entrenador me dio el visto bueno para el contacto completo de nuevo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: ¿Puedes llevar a {{name:hailey}} al rugby en una hora?

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: She asked me to convince you, and you know i can't
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: Ella me pidió que te convenciera, y sabes que no puedo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Fuck it, i will try with {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Pues claro que {{mason:he|él|ella}} te está ignorando.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Text {{mason:her}} I’ll be there in forty
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Dile a {{mason:her}} que estaré allí en cuarenta.
Cualquier cosa por ti, mi amor ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Now I need to warn {{name:hailey}} to hurry up and get ready.
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Ahora necesito advertir a {{name:hailey}} que se apure y se prepare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: ¿Puedes llevar {{name:hailey}} al rugby en una hora?

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Let me throw something on and I’m coming
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Déjame ponerme algo y ya voy.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: You’re lucky, I literally just woke up 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Tienes suerte, literalmente acabo de despertarme 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: I need to do my makeup
You have a ride in forty
You think I’m showing up looking tragic
Just when i was asking a friend to pick me up
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Justo cuando le estaba pidiendo a un amigo que me recogiera.

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: How did you even do that

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You’ll have to bring {{name:hailey}} back too
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: También tendrás que traer {{name:hailey}} de vuelta.

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: I’m gonna see some friends while she trains
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Voy a ver a unos amigos mientras ella entrena.

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You want us to grab something from the store on the way back ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: ¿Quieres que recojamos algo de la tienda de camino de regreso?
Más tarde, y gracias de nuevo

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: {{name:hailey}} almost killed us in the car 😂
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: {{name:hailey}} casi nos mata en el coche 😂
Ella ni siquiera era la conductora 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: A él le gusta jugar a ser héroe.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: It’s not my job to be on standby
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: No es mi trabajo estar en espera.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Why are you always like this
Because I’m tired of seeing you like this lately
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Porque estoy cansado de verte así últimamente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: And I’ve got my own stuff going on too
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Y también tengo mis propias cosas en marcha.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: I can’t be there twenty four seven
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: No puedo estar allí veinticuatro siete.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: But you don’t have to be this cold all the time
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Pero no tienes que ser así de frío todo el tiempo.
Matando el tiempo con los chicos 😂

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: That’s because you’re a pain in the ass
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Eso es porque eres un dolor en el culo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Didn’t have my phone on me

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I go back in two days
They’re really short staffed right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Están realmente escasos de personal en este momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Some of the colleagues I get along with are struggling
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Algunos de los colegas con los que me llevo bien están teniendo dificultades.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: So they asked me to come back earlier
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Así que me pidieron que volviera más temprano.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: The one you had issues with ?
I don’t know if he’s back yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: No sé si ya ha vuelto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But either way I don’t really have a choice
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Pero de cualquier manera, realmente no tengo una opción.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You just need to focus on getting better

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Esa es tu tarea ahora mismo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You’re not the first one to tell me that
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: No eres el primero en decírmelo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little
Then maybe you should start listening
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Entonces tal vez deberías empezar a escuchar.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Especially when it comes from someone who cares ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Especialmente cuando viene de alguien que se preocupa ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I’ll bring your plate in a few minutes
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Te traeré tu plato en unos minutos.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move
But don’t push yourself too much

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them
Not a bad idea, at least someone will enjoy it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: No es una mala idea, al menos alguien lo disfrutará.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Es mejor que desperdiciarlos y pretender que no pasó.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Está bien, entonces pensemos en ello con calma mañana y veamos qué opciones tenemos en realidad.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Viajaremos juntos cuando puedas caminar sin quejarte todo el tiempo 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Oh, ¿entonces ahora soy yo el que se queja cuando caminamos?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Si no recuerdo mal, la última vez alguien me pidió que la llevara durante diez minutos porque le dolían los pies.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¿De verdad? Probablemente una de las otras esposas que tienes 🤷‍♀️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ahora ve a dormir antes de que tu maravillosa novia te dé una bofetada para que duermas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sí, mi señora, no te quedes despierta demasiado tarde tampoco.
No te quedes despierto desplazándote para siempre.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Te amo también, nos vemos mañana ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Este día fue una basura… lesión, {{name:evelyn}} de vuelta al trabajo…, planes arruinados… ¿qué sigue?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
She really is the best cook
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ella realmente es la mejor cocinera.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
I’m going out with Sasha during the day
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Voy a salir con Sasha durante el día

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Probably the park and some shopping
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Probablemente el parque y algunas compras

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Y hablando con la mejor chica del mundo 😌
Dado que te gustan mis fotos

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Y tú eliges lo que voy a usar mañana 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m putting them on the bed
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Los estoy poniendo en la cama.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Which outfit should she try first
How did the presentation and studying go?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¿Cómo fueron la presentación y el estudio?
Probando el atuendo de la izquierda ahora 😌
Probando el atuendo del medio ahora 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: The presentation went really well! Studying afterward was long and hard (no jokes, silly)
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¡La presentación salió genial! Luego estudiar se me hizo largo y duro (sin bromitas, tonto)

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sabía que lo harías genial. Estoy orgulloso de ti ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Eres la chica más hermosa de este pueblo.
Honestamente, tal vez todo el país.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Gracias ❤️ ¿Y tú qué has hecho hoy?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You don’t have to be jealous
I don’t care about anyone else
I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Solo quiero lucir bien para ti ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} sale de tu habitación para limpiar. Guardas las cosas.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} sale de tu habitación para limpiar. Guardas las cosas antes de que llegue {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: En tu puerta ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Llevas su bolso al dormitorio juntos. {{name:lena}} coloca sus cosas al lado de la silla, pone su cepillo de dientes en el baño y vuelve a encontrar la camiseta que le dejaste.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¿Esta?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Pensé que te gustaría.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Lo hago. Lo dejo aquí para más tarde.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Siéntete como en casa.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Puede que te arrepientas de decírmelo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Te acomodas en la sala con bebidas y un snack. Después de un rato, {{name:lena}} nota los controles y agarra uno.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¿Podemos intentar otra carrera?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¡Claro! ¿Misma pista que el domingo?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sí. Quiero que veas las curvas en las que he estado pensando.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: A LAS CINCO — {{name:lena}} llega a tu puerta con su bolsa de noche. La dejas entrar y luego la acercas suavemente antes de que pueda empezar a desempacar.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ahora también puedo verte inclinarte de lado con el control.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sin comentarios del instructor, por favor.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Se sientan uno al lado del otro durante unas carreras. {{name:lena}} todavía termina detrás de ti, pero maneja las curvas difíciles con más confianza. Le señalas las vueltas limpias y la ayudas a ajustar su tiempo entre rondas.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Esa curva estuvo bien. Disminuiste la velocidad antes de girar esta vez.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Lo recordé. Prácticamente podía oírte diciéndome que frenara.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ahora eres mucho más rápida en esa sección.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Disfruto más esto cuando no estás a toda una pista de distancia.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¿En el juego o en el sofá?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ambos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}} pone el control en la mesa de café y se vuelve hacia ti. Te besa, luego se acomoda cerca de tu lado, con su mano descansando en tu brazo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¿Puedo dejar esto primero?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVISO

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Una pausa entre carreras

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ¿Otra ronda?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: En un momento. Quédate aquí conmigo primero.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Con gusto.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Dejas tu control al lado del de ella y se quedan juntos en el sofá. Más tarde, {{name:lena}} te ayuda a poner la mesa mientras terminas de preparar la cena.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: El bolso, sí. Tú, no.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Deja el bolso junto a la puerta y se mete en tus brazos. La besas, manteniendo una mano en su cintura

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Captura visual archivada

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVISO
