story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Aquí para quedarme

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Recordaste lo que dijiste anoche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Lo hice.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Bien. Tenemos mucho tiempo para eso hoy.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: NOCHE — Comen juntos en el sofá, hablando sobre la tarde y los planes de {{name:lena}} para el jueves.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} se inclina para besarte. Vas a tu habitación y cierras la puerta

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?
I'm taking that as a yes.
I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: He estado deseando estar aquí contigo.
Yo también. Especialmente después de ayer.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estás sentado junto a {{name:lena}} en el borde de la cama. Ella te rodea con los brazos y te besa. La mantienes cerca, disfrutando del momento juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un beso antes de que se apaguen las luces

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Me alegra no tener que pensar en irme esta noche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La ayudas a quitarse el suéter. Ella se queda cerca mientras terminas de desnudarl.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Le quita el suéter por la cabeza

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
She lies back on the bed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ella se recuesta en la cama

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Yo también. Aunque todavía estoy pensando en esas fotos que enviaste ayer.
Ella se arrodilla entre sus piernas

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ella lo toma en su boca

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ven aquí. Te quiero dentro de mí.
Ella se queda debajo de él

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Se ha cambiado a la camiseta que preparaste para ella. Están ambos bajo el edredón. Ella se acurruca contra ti.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo fue. Estoy realmente feliz contigo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Yo también. Me encanta cómo van las cosas entre nosotros ahora.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Yo también. Estos últimos días contigo han sido perfectos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estoy feliz de poder quedarme aquí esta noche.
Estoy feliz de que tú también estés aquí.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sabes cuáles. La pequeña vista previa. Y la siguiente.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ella se acomoda a tu lado, su mano descansando en la tuya. La abrazas y se duermen juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ella se acomoda a tu lado, su mano descansando en la tuya. La abrazas y se duermen juntos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Se acomoda contra ti, su mano descansando en la tuya. La mantienes cerca mientras se queda dormida. Te quedas despierto un poco más.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Estabas empacando en encaje negro y sonriéndome como si supieras exactamente lo que hacías.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Funcionó. He estado esperando ver eso en persona.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vamos a tu habitación para que puedas ver mejor.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Empieza con la sala, yo me encargo de la cocina.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Alguien tiene que ser responsable en esta casa.
Eso es gracioso viniendo de ti.
Es hora de limpiar la semana

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: ¿En serio acabas de tomarme una foto mientras limpio?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: De que a veces haces tareas.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Voy a poner jabón en tu café.
No te vas a escapar de esto
De todos modos, la sala ya está lista.
Eso es lo que dicen los lentos.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sigue hablando y te haré limpiar el inodoro.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Te escucho todavía en la cama

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¡Buenos días ❤️! ¿Superaste ese nivel o sigue siendo un problema el control?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tengo un paquete que recoger, luego no mucho

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Algo emocionante en él?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un cargador de teléfono

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intenta contenerte cuando lo abras 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guardaré el envoltorio para ti

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Qué considerado ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Otro día completo para ti?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Clases, luego trabajo. Voy a casa antes de la cena esta noche

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Te cambiarás antes de irte?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, no quiero llevarme todas mis cosas de trabajo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finalmente lo superé. Resulta que necesitaba dejar de apresurarme

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu bolso agradecerá una noche libre

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se lo ha ganado 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No dejes tus llaves dentro cuando cambies de bolso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena como algo que yo haría

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aún ni siquiera he decidido qué ponerme

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te verás bien de cualquier manera

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias, guapo ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Al menos estoy lista para esta parte del día

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ves? Ya te ves bien

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Así que el control tuvo una recuperación milagrosa 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me estás haciendo difícil dejar mi teléfono tranquilo 😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te dejo ir. Espero que la cena esté rica esta noche

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias, y perdona si hoy no puedo hablar mucho ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te escribiré cuando llegue, y cuando regrese

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien, no hay prisa por responder entre medio

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien. Que tengas un buen día

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tú también

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te quiero, hablamos luego ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo también

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Preferiría no hablar de esa parte

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muy conveniente 😌 ¿Pudiste dormir un poco después?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí. ¿Y tú?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dormí bien, y me levanté cuando sonó la alarma por una vez

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una mañana exitosa para los dos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No nos emocionemos, aún no he salido de casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Qué harás más tarde?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ESTA TARDE — Has organizado tus planes con {{name:hailey}} lo suficientemente temprano para estar en casa antes de que {{name:lena}} llegue a las cinco.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
No point going back and forth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: No tiene sentido ir y venir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So what, I don’t know how to teach?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujeto respondiendo a la dominación verbal

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Esto ya no parece enseñanza, y no puedo quitarme la preocupación que hay detrás de mis celos.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK capturó el inicio del acto oral después de que el profesor ordenara al sujeto que chupara más fuerte.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Soy demasiado buena, eso es todo.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujeto mostrando resistencia y cumplimiento mixtos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Esa reacción contradictoria me preocupa, y un informe no puede decirme si está bien.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Siguiendo la provocación del sujeto, el profesor forzó una penetración más profunda. El sujeto emitió una reacción ahogada.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pero no hay bus por otra hora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El sujeto aceptó el desafío del profesor y lo llevó al clímax. El intercambio verbal posterior confirma la anticipación mutua de futuras sesiones.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La próxima vez mejor que estés lista.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I was stuck on the last exercise
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Me quedé atascada en el último ejercicio

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: 15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15 MINUTOS DESPUÉS — Has llevado a {{name:hailey}} a casa. Ella se dirige a su habitación, y tú guardas tus llaves.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ¿Puedes llevarme si tu pierna no está tan mal?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Una hora y un poco más

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¡Hola ❤️! Estoy lista para irme, y recordé mover mis llaves a la otra bolsa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dije que le avisaría cuando estuviera en casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Esa no es la parte con la que tengo problemas

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El gerente ha traído su bolso; {{name:lena}} saca su teléfono

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ella se sienta un poco apartada de él ahora, mirando la pantalla; ambos están completamente vestidos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahora está mirando su teléfono. Espero un mensaje de la misma persona, pero no sé cómo leer sus palabras como lo hacía esta mañana.
Podrías quedarte a pasar la noche

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Disfruté la cena. No es lo único en lo que estoy pensando ahora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tiene que convertirse en una discusión

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No estoy discutiendo contigo. Estoy pensando en lo que le voy a decir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Necesito un poco de tiempo para mí

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Tu chaqueta está junto a la puerta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay un autobús en veinte minutos. Tomaré ese

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} está en la puerta del apartamento abierta con su chaqueta puesta y su bolso al hombro

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El gerente se hace a un lado y vuelve a mirar su trasero

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's finally leaving. I thought that would make me feel better, but now I'm dreading the message saying she's home.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por fin se está marchando. Pensé que eso me haría sentir mejor, pero ahora temo el mensaje diciendo que ha llegado a casa.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Spanish.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the bus ride, once she is back at her own place...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después del viaje en bus, una vez que está de vuelta en su casa...
Ya estoy en casa ❤️ Lo siento, es tarde

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I'm okay. Got back without any trouble
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, estoy bien. Regresé sin problemas

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to tell me about it tomorrow
Nothing big enough to make a story. I'm going to get ready for bed now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada lo suficientemente grande como para contar una historia. Ahora me voy a preparar para dormir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh okay, I'm glad you got back all right then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, está bien, me alegra que hayas regresado bien

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was still up anyway. I collected that charger, by the way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De todos modos, todavía estaba despierta. Por cierto, recogí ese cargador

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After she puts her phone in her bag and goes inside...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de que pone su teléfono en su bolsa y entra...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've left the spare by the sofa for next time you're here
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He dejado el de repuesto junto al sofá para la próxima vez que estés aquí

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation is detected near {{name:lena}} inside the apartment
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se detecta una conversación cerca de {{name:lena}} dentro del apartamento

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said a few people from work were having dinner. I'm trying to hold on to that while I wait for the next update.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dijo que algunas personas del trabajo iban a cenar. Intento aferrarme a eso mientras espero la siguiente novedad.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There you are. You look good

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que me veo bien

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm appreciating the effort. Much better than yesterday's paperwork
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aprecio el esfuerzo. Mucho mejor que el papeleo de ayer
Ese es un estándar muy bajo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't looking at the paperwork much either
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo tampoco estaba mirando mucho el papeleo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me take your jacket. You can put your bag on that chair
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjame tomar tu chaqueta. Puedes poner tu bolsa en esa silla

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Try not to sound so amazed
The manager takes {{name:lena}}'s jacket as she sets her bag on the chair by the entrance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La manager toma la chaqueta de {{name:lena}} mientras coloca su bolsa en la silla junto a la entrada

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dining table behind them is set for two; no other guests are present
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La mesa detrás de ellos está puesta para dos; no hay otros invitados presentes

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A table for two, after I asked if it was a group thing and she told me it was. I keep reading that message as if it might change.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una mesa para dos, después de preguntarle si era un plan de grupo y que me dijera que sí. Sigo leyendo ese mensaje como si pudiera cambiar.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At the table, once he has served dinner...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En la mesa, una vez que ha servido la cena...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could let me finish chewing
You already know whether it's good
Do you need applause too, or can I keep eating?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Necesitas aplausos también, o puedo seguir comiendo?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me what you think of the sauce next
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedes decirme qué piensas de la salsa después

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I expected a speech about a secret family recipe
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esperaba un discurso sobre una receta familiar secreta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can make one up if you need an impressive story
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puedo inventar una si necesitas una historia impresionante

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you've done enough self-promotion for one meal
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, ya has hecho suficiente autopromoción por una comida

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you've stopped looking as though you're here for a meeting
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y has dejado de parecer que estás aquí para una reunión

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hay comida y no has mencionado una hoja de cálculo. Eso ayuda

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I changed my mind twice before putting this on
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias ❤️ Cambié de opinión dos veces antes de ponerme esto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Across my desk, pretending you're only listening because I pay you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al otro lado de mi escritorio, pretendiendo que solo escuchas porque te pago

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At work, that is usually why I'm listening
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En el trabajo, esa suele ser la razón por la que escucho

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying to enjoy dinner
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta noche estoy intentando disfrutar de la cena

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena termina con una discusión sobre si su música es elegida para los invitados o para presumir de sus altavoces. Cuando ella finalmente admite que le gusta la canción, él parece demasiado satisfecho. Recoge los platos y le deja agua en la mesa de café.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come sit down for a while
You don't want help with those?
I've got a dishwasher. I'd rather have your company
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo un lavavajillas. Prefiero tu compañía

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits on the sofa. He puts the last plate in the kitchen, then joins her.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ella se sienta en el sofá. Él pone el último plato en la cocina y luego se une a ella.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've wanted to kiss you since you walked in
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He querido besarte desde que entraste

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager moves closer on the sofa and initiates a kiss
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: El gerente se acerca en el sofá e inicia un beso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} returns it; he rests one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} lo devuelve; él descansa una mano en su cintura

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She isn't moving away from him. I told her to enjoy her evening, and now those words make me feel sick.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No se está apartando de él. Le dije que disfrutara de la noche, y ahora esas palabras me revuelven el estómago.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're looking very pleased with yourself again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te ves muy satisfecho contigo mismo otra vez

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't make me regret saying anything
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me hagas arrepentirme de decir algo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take that before I start changing things again 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo tomaré antes de que empiece a cambiar cosas otra vez 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me back. I'm allowed to enjoy it
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me besaste de vuelta. Tengo derecho a disfrutarlo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He moves behind her on the sofa and kisses her neck
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él se mueve detrás de ella en el sofá y le besa el cuello

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both hands slide up and massage her breasts over the dress
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ambas manos suben y masajean sus pechos sobre el vestido

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going further, and I'm still here with the phone in my hand. I want to put it down, but not knowing feels unbearable too.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esto va más lejos, y yo sigo aquí con el teléfono en la mano. Quiero dejarlo, pero no saber también parece insoportable.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been thinking about this since the office
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Has estado pensando en esto desde la oficina

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me yesterday and then spent the evening pretending you hadn't
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me besaste ayer y luego pasaste la noche pretendiendo que no lo habías hecho

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had dinner with him. That's not pretending
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cené con él. Eso no es pretender

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying not to think about him for five minutes. You're not helping
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta noche estoy intentando no pensar en él por cinco minutos. No estás ayudando
Entonces deja de hablar de él

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. I need to go or I'll be late
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tú también, guapo. Necesito irme o llegaré tarde

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She lies back on the sofa, dress pushed up
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ella se recuesta en el sofá, con el vestido subido

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kneels between her thighs and goes down on her
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él se arrodilla entre sus muslos y la complace

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't turn this into an innocent dinner anymore. Every new update takes away another excuse I was trying to believe.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya no puedo hacer que esto parezca una cena inocente. Cada novedad me quita otra excusa en la que intentaba creer.
Ella se arrodilla entre sus rodillas

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She takes him in her mouth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ella lo toma en su boca

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Another capture, and it still hasn't stopped. I keep reaching for the edge of the screen, then pulling my hand back.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Otra captura, y esto sigue sin parar. Sigo acercando la mano al borde de la pantalla y luego la retiro.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's choosing to stay close to him. What hurts most is how little the version of tonight she gave me matches any of this.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está eligiendo seguir cerca de él. Lo que más duele es lo poco que la versión de esta noche que me dio se parece a todo esto.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, outside her manager's apartment...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alrededor de las siete, afuera del apartamento de su manager...
Ella traga y se queda arrodillada

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a moment I just stare without taking anything in. Then it hits me again, and I don't know what I'm supposed to do with all this hurt.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por un momento solo miro sin asimilar nada. Luego vuelve a golpearme, y no sé qué se supone que haga con todo este dolor.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don't look that pleased
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quería hacerlo. No pongas esa cara de satisfacción

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to keep checking the time
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tienes que estar mirando la hora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've arrived ❤️ I'll text you when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: He llegado ❤️ Te escribiré cuando regrese

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You looked really pensive in the car earlier
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Te veías muy pensativa en el coche antes

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: That’s actually a really good idea
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Esa es una muy buena idea

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I think I’ll do exactly that
Look at you becoming strategic
I learn from the best
Flattery won’t save you next cleaning day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Los halagos no te salvarán en el próximo día de limpieza

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Worth a try though
Anyway
I’m going to sleep and plan my revenge properly
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Voy a dormir y planear mi venganza adecuadamente

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Don’t go too hard on him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: No seas demasiado dura con él

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: No promises 😌
Did I?
Good night
Good night
After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Después de dejar tu teléfono, te acomodas de nuevo junto a {{name:lena}} y se quedan dormidos juntos.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Yeah
Is everything going okay with your professor?
It is
But he put me in difficulty with some exercises today
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Pero me puso en aprietos con algunos ejercicios hoy

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I kind of want revenge
Then do the same thing to him
Give him an exercise just as hard
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Dale un ejercicio igual de difícil

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?
By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Solo por una película de terror.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Cállate y ven a comer antes de que se enfríe.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Qué pena que ya estoy despierta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can’t come drag me out of bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No puedes venir a arrastrarme de la cama

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hola 😊 Antes de que se me pase el día, ¿dormiste bien?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alabanza alta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estaba pensando en ayer en tu casa mientras hacía el desayuno

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Finalmente has admitido que tenía razón sobre la película?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No. La parte donde tenía mi cabeza en tu hombro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh. A mí también me gustó esa parte

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te quedaste callado por una vez. Fue muy agradable ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podría ofrecer ese servicio de nuevo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Por favor, hazlo. Me gustaría tener otra tarde así pronto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Encontraremos una. ¿Ya has comido?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, antes de que empieces. Mira

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, ¿y tú?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te ves encantadora

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias 😊 El desayuno está fuera de cuadro, pero prometo que existe

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te creo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hay algo que quería preguntarte antes de irme

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} me envió un mensaje esta mañana

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bastante bien, considerando que puse una alarma y luego discutí con ella dos veces 😭.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me ha preguntado si quiero ir a su casa esta noche, solo nosotros dos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿No hay revancha de arcade con la invitación?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo verifiqué. Aparentemente puede pasar una noche sin un marcador 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gustaría ir. ¿Está bien para ti?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me mandó un mensaje sobre volver a vernos esta noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿El chico del café?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí 😊 Me ha invitado a cenar en su casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aparentemente está listo para defender su cocina en persona

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Ganaste?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena como una noche que vale la pena aguantar el día de trabajo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me gustaría ir. ¿Estás bien con que vaya a su casa?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, cariño. Me parece bien ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo que dije es en serio. Me gustaría que hicieras lo que quieras hacer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Aún quería preguntarte cómo te sientes sobre esta noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y me alegra que lo hicieras. No necesitas convencerte de no hacer algo que quieres

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien 😊 Primero iré a casa y me prepararé, luego iré alrededor de las ocho

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cuídate, ¿vale? Mantén tu teléfono cargado y mándame un mensaje cuando llegues

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Me levanté. Interprétalo como quieras

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo haré. Tengo la dirección y puedo tomar un taxi de regreso cuando lo necesite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Si decido quedarme, también te lo haré saber

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. No necesito un mensaje cada cinco minutos. Solo quiero saber que estás bien

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa parte te la prometo ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y me puedes decir si te sientes nervioso otra vez

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un poco. Pero eso no significa que desee que no fueras

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Trabajas hoy?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ayer ayudó. Me gustó saber que aún podíamos ser nosotros mismos juntos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Podemos. Incluyendo que yo robe tu cojín ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esa parte nunca estuvo en duda.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Estás siendo muy tranquilo sobre esto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: En realidad, estoy sonriendo a mi teléfono 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Entonces tenemos caras estúpidas a juego

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tuya es más bonita

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ahora solo intentas que me quede aquí ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hasta las seis, luego tengo que recoger un par de cosas de camino a casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cierto, necesito irme antes de que mi tranquila mañana se convierta en correr por la calle

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Que tengas un buen día. Come algo decente durante tu descanso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mira cómo te apoderas de mi trabajo 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alguien tiene que recordarte cuando estás ocupado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo. Te escribiré cuando esté en casa y preparándome ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te amo también. Hablamos esta noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voy a estar ocupada la mayor parte del día, así que no te sorprendas si estoy callada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intentaré no tomarme lo de ser abandonada por una lista de compras de forma personal

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tiene cosas mucho menos interesantes que decir que tú 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: TARDE TEMPRANA — Has organizado tus planes con {{name:hailey}} lo suficientemente temprano para estar en casa antes de que {{name:lena}} llegue a las cinco.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo no reacciones a sus tonterías.
{{name:hailey}} llega y salta a los brazos de {{name:aiden}}.
El sujeto saltó a los brazos de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hacen que parezca fácil, mientras yo sigo intentando ponerle nombre al nudo en mi estómago.
{{name:hailey}} saltó a los brazos de {{name:aiden}} al llegar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vamos, ponte al menos ropa interior
{{name:aiden}} desliza su mano mientras la sostiene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Más te vale no ponerte otro atuendo loco.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Es la recompensa para el mejor entrenador 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Está bien, juguemos antes de que nos moleste
{{name:hailey}} se sienta de nuevo en el regazo de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A ver si tú también puedes mantenerte concentrado
El sujeto se mueve intencionadamente en el regazo de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} siguió moviéndose en el regazo de {{name:aiden}} durante los juegos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ÚLTIMO JUEGO – EL PRIMERO EN TERMINAR GANA TODO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le diré a {{name:aiden}} que no te mire.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: El sujeto reclama victoria en circunstancias inusuales

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} afirmó que {{name:aiden}} terminó primero durante el último juego

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: These are honestly the best game afternoons
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Honestamente, estas son las mejores tardes de juego

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Looking forward to the next one
I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Me alegra que no esconda lo que quiere, pero también necesito ser sincero sobre lo que siento.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hombre, realmente estaba deseando jugar de nuevo 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Al menos no tendré que comer sola con {{name:mason}} como la última vez.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}} se queda esta noche. Te dejaré un plato para cuando regreses.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Gracias. Guárdame un poco de postre también.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola 😊 Finalmente en casa, y me estoy preparando para salir en un rato. ¿Cómo fue tu día?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No esta noche. Vine, no vine a dormir aquí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qué pena. ¿Él te ve después de esto?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él recibe un mensaje de que llegué a casa. Tú me puedes escribir mañana

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo aceptaré

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Acompáñame a la puerta sin un comentario ingenioso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE LLEGUE A CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ Estoy en casa. No pasé la noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias por decírmelo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No llegamos hasta el final. Quería contarte lo que pasó, en lugar de dejarte adivinando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te ves hermosa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de la cena nos besamos en el sofá. Luego puso su mano debajo de mi vestido y me tocó hasta que llegué

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después le hice sexo oral. Él llegó en mi boca. Tragué

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego volví a casa. Eso fue todo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Feliz. Un poco sonrojada. Contento de haber ido y de haberme ido cuando quería

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fue mi decisión. No estaba tratando de llegar a algún siguiente paso porque pensaba que debía hacerlo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que sepas cómo te sientes al respecto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Pasó la mitad de la noche tratando de averiguar si lo estaba haciendo mejor que tú. No respondí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es probablemente más amable que un ranking

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa era la idea 😌 Y quería un minuto contigo antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa era la respuesta que esperaba ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy feliz. Esta noche guardaré el resto de los detalles para mí, como hablamos

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Saber que estás en casa y cómodo es suficiente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo estoy. Aún quería un momento contigo antes de dormir ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN POCO MÁS TARDE, EN SU CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy aquí 😊 Encontré el edificio correcto y todo está bien

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. ¿Cómo va la noche?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Había otras respuestas aceptables?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Huele a cena en lugar de humo, así que elijo ser optimista 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, dime que no empezaste con eso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Primero dije hola.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Muy diplomático.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él está poniendo la mesa. Aquí tienes, la prueba prometida de que llegué.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Segura, sonriendo, y no a punto de ser envenenada por una pizza quemada 😊.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me siento tranquila sobre al menos dos de esas cosas.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No empieces 😭 Estoy bien, de verdad.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Diviértete, cariño. Estoy aquí si necesitas algo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Varias. La tuya fue la mejor.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias ❤️ Revisaré más tarde. Ahora voy a guardar mi teléfono.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE GUARDÓ SU TELÉFONO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo encontraste

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Primera vez. Por supuesto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo habría bajado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Por eso no te escribí desde la acera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso se ve mucho mejor que la cena que cuidadosamente dejaste fuera de tu foto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Iba a empezar con una disculpa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es una broma. Puedes dejar de disculparte por una pizza quemada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces pararé. Siéntate. Ya preparé tu lado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Llega bien, cariño.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi lado. Hemos tenido una librería y muchos mensajes

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estaba prestando atención

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo has estado?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mejor de lo que esperaba. El trabajo estuvo ocupado. Esta es la primera parte de hoy que se siente como mía

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tu novio?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Más callado de lo que parece. Pasa mucho tiempo decidiendo qué se permite querer.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso suena agotador.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo es, para él. Solía planear todo para que nada lo sorprendiera. Está intentando no hacer eso conmigo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Sabe que estás aquí?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo haré. Recibirás tu mensaje de llegada, no lo he olvidado.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Le dije que llegué. No necesita un resumen de la cena.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Justo. Yo tampoco querría una de sus noches.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te sorprendería lo que reconocerías.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Perdón?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nada. La salsa. Esto es realmente reconocible. Estoy impresionada.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No suenes tan sorprendida.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo derecho a estar sorprendida. Me enviaste una foto de tu cara en lugar de la comida.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La comida no sabía qué hacer con su cara.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si vas a mirar, al menos puedes darme el siguiente bocado.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abre, entonces.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí. Ahora estamos a mano con las fotos de anoche.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No creo que estemos a mano.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te veas tan orgullosa. Aún tienes salsa en el pulgar.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podrías lidiar con eso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come primero. Eres muy fácil de distraer.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viniste. Tengo derecho a distraerme.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vine a cenar. El resto puede esperar hasta que los platos estén limpios.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trajiste el libro.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Traje el libro. Incluso he pasado la marca de la página.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es más de lo que esperaba.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te acostumbres. Leí una página en el camino y luego pensé en ti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa es una mejor reseña de la que el libro iba a recibir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aquí, marqué la página de la que quería hablar contigo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Podemos hablar de eso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En realidad, el libro puede esperar. No vine aquí solo para comparar notas.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ven aquí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Más allá de los mensajes

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eso es lo que intentaba decir sin escribirlo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siéntate. Quiero mi mano sobre ti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No te veas tan sorprendida. Las fotos de anoche eran la advertencia.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Su Mano

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Más despacio. Sí, así.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu turno. Quiero tu boca.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Su boca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí. No pares.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy cerca.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ella Viene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Eso fue realmente bueno.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Todavía lo tengo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tranquilo. Salí un rato, luego volví a la increíblemente exigente tarea de no hacer nada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cállate

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me quedo esta noche. Debería irme mientras todavía lo pienso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mándame un mensaje mañana

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quizás

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE LLEGUE A CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hola ❤️ Ya estoy en casa. No me quedé

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Gracias por avisarme

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No llegamos hasta el final. Quería contarte lo que pasó

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Después de la cena nos besamos junto a la ventana. Usé mi mano con él

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN POCO MÁS TARDE, EN SU CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Luego me hizo sexo oral hasta que llegué. Regresé a casa después de eso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes al respecto?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Estoy feliz de haber ido, y feliz de no haber mantenido todo detrás de una pantalla

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Primero hablamos durante la cena. Cuando decidí, sabía que era lo que quería. También sabía que quería dormir en mi propia cama

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me alegra que te sintieras cómodo con él

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, la cena también estuvo buena, por si aún te preocupaba eso 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces dejaré de preparar el plan de rescate del restaurante

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
