story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mantén el plan. Podríamos usarlo para nosotros en algún momento ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy en casa de {{name:aiden}} 😊 Todo bien, como prometí.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy feliz. Esta noche guardaré los detalles para mí, pero quería que supieras que llegué a casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. No tienes que decirme más que eso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias ❤️ Fue una buena decisión ir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tú? ¿Cómo estás?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Lo encontraste fácil?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Necesité un segundo antes de responder, pero estoy bien

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se siente diferente ahora que estamos aquí. Prefiero decirlo que fingir que nunca me pongo nervioso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferiría que tú también lo dijeras. ¿Te gustaría que te llamara?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, me alegra que estemos hablando. Solo necesitaba un momento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Está bien. Puedes decírmelo si eso cambia ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo haré. Me alegra que hayas tenido una buena noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Y tú? ¿Cómo estás?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Me gustó ver llegar tu mensaje

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Abrió la puerta con dos platos.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eres muy dulce esta noche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tengo mis momentos 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo haces. Más de lo que a veces te doy crédito ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Intentaré no arruinar este

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te amo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Yo también te amo ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje por la mañana, antes de que empieces a hacer planes para quedarte con mi cuchara

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensé que ahora era mía

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De ninguna manera. Tampoco es mi lado del sofá 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Platos de verdad. Me estaba preparando mentalmente para comer directamente de una caja para llevar 😭.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ambos están a salvo. Duerme un poco, cariño

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y gracias de nuevo por todo eso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No me agradezcas. Ambos lo queríamos. Estoy feliz de que estemos haciendo esto juntos ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buenas noches

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buenas noches ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces, está haciendo un esfuerzo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aparentemente. Una foto rápida mientras los pone.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Segura, adentro y a punto de comer 😊 Puedes dejar de preguntarte si me perdí.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gracias por avisarme. Disfruta tu noche.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, acepta mi simpatía 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo haré ❤️ Ahora voy a guardar mi teléfono. Hablamos después.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy aquí si necesitas algo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE QUE GUARDÓ SU TELÉFONO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿He pasado la inspección?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dije que llegué. No estaba escribiendo una reseña de tu casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. La silla con todo apilado encima me haría perder una estrella

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me di cuenta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Por supuesto que sí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Él me dijo que tuviera una buena noche. Podrías empezar por darme de comer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Compré la cena de camino a casa. No estoy pretendiendo que de repente aprendí a cocinar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo estuvo el trabajo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honesto y organizado. Esa es una combinación inesperada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cuidado. Otro cumplido y pensaré que te gusta estar aquí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí me gusta. Puedes aceptar eso sin tener que hacer un discurso completo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voy a buscar la comida

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Excelente decisión

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estás mirando mi boca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te estás tardando demasiado. Abre

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Lo alimentan así, o es un servicio especial?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te estás haciendo el loco

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo suficientemente ocupado como para que siempre encontrara mi café frío cuando me acordaba de él

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y ahora tienes salsa en el pulgar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entonces, encárgate de eso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Con gusto. Él no recibe esta parte, ¿verdad?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come. Luego puedes ser molesto en algún lugar más útil

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DESPUÉS DE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Espera, ¿es esa la tira de la cabina de fotos?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se veía mejor allí que en mi bolsillo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pusiste la que tiene los ojos cerrados al frente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No estaba mirando a la cámara

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Recuerdo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero todo en mi lista está hecho, y mi teléfono está cargado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Quieres que le dé la vuelta?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Déjalo ahí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te has quedado callado

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gusta que lo hayas guardado en un lugar donde lo verías.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me gustó la noche. Guardar las fotos parecía obvio.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esa fue una buena respuesta.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ocasionalmente puedo manejar uno. ¿Mejor que un informe?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ven aquí antes de que lo estropees.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Aquí?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sabes a qué me refiero.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Suena como si estuvieras contento de tener la noche de vuelta.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No hace falta una puntuación.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Era esa la recompensa por una buena respuesta?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Eso fue porque quería besarte.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Incluso mejor. ¿Lo besan así después de la cena?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deja de hablar. Siéntate y mantén las manos donde las pongo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Bajo el vestido?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: EN EL SOFÁ

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Dos dedos?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí. Lento, luego menos lento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sí, mucho. Déjame mostrarte algo antes de ponerme los zapatos.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dime si lo hago mejor que él

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No voy a responder eso. Sigue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bajo el Vestido

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahí. No te atrevas a llevar la cuenta de eso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estás cerca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. No pares

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ese sonido. ¿Él también lo siente?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Recuéstate. Es mi turno

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: SU TURNO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tienes que—

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sé. Quiero hacerlo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Es esta la parte donde pierdo contra él a propósito?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esta es la parte donde dejas de hablar. Manos en mi cabello. No me saques a menos que lo diga

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entre sus rodillas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Estoy cerca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Quédate ahí

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En su boca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No tenías que tragar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quería hacerlo. No te pongas tan contento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quédate

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mira 😊 logré parecer que tuve más de veinte minutos para prepararme.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Es para recompensarme por estar tan atenta a mis estudios 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aún me queda el resto de la recompensa para disfrutar

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
How did the practice test go?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ¿Cómo te fue en el examen de práctica?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aquí parece segura de sí misma, y todavía estoy aprendiendo qué significa eso para mí.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} dando cunnilingus como recompensa después del examen de práctica exitoso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Cuidado… si terminas demasiado pronto, te darán puntos de penalización
{{name:ethan}} aumentando la intensidad a pesar de la advertencia

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: No solo eres bueno en los estudios...

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Para las próximas lecciones… ¿cuál es el objetivo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pero tendremos que profundizar más en los temas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Entonces realmente espero profundizar en todo eso 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: ¿No estás tan decepcionado de no recibir el castigo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: La parte donde viste todo durante la sesión de juego 😌
Y a ti también te gusta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Espero con ansias la próxima sesión de entrenamiento 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Si admites bien, te mostraré algo aún mejor

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Mira cómo me dejó tu mejor amigo cuando se fue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: La parte donde te envié una foto de mi recompensa 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Y esa es la locura que te encanta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
I don’t know what you’re talking about
Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Qué pena... tenía otra sorpresa para ti si te gustó

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Por finalmente admitirlo, tú también recibes una recompensa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Después de dejar tu teléfono, te acomodas de nuevo junto a {{name:lena}} y se quedan dormidos juntos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
Trying to wake up slowly
Of course you are 😏
I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Juro que nunca descansas tus pulgares.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Estás feliz cuando mis dedos se usan para enviarte mensajes, ¿no?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
By the way…
About the tickets for our trip
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sobre los boletos para nuestro viaje

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ni siquiera sé qué hacer con ellos ahora.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Dáselos a alguien que realmente necesita un descanso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mantenlos y ¿por qué no ir con {{name:aiden}}?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mantenlos y encuentra a alguien más con quien ir.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
That's actually really kind of you 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eso es realmente amable de tu parte 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You always try to do the right thing
Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Por supuesto que lo estoy, mira cuánta suerte tengo estos días gracias al karma 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ¿No es suficiente tenerme como tu novia?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ¡Lo es! Soy el hombre más afortunado del mundo ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
I swear
I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: También soy la chica más afortunada del mundo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ¿Por tener un vegetal como tu hombre? No estoy seguro de eso 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
You're too sweet
With {{name:aiden}}?
Why?
He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Siempre quiso ir a esa isla y al menos tiene sus dos piernas.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: No creo que me sienta muy cómodo yendo solo con él.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Incluso si es mi amigo y tu mejor amigo, se siente raro, ¿no?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ahora que lo dices así, supongo que sí.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Pero confío en ustedes dos y no quiero que se pierdan el viaje solo por mí, y al mismo tiempo él finalmente tendrá el viaje a la isla que tanto quería.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Y es en más de un mes, así que tengo tiempo para pensarlo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
You won't be jealous?
Of course I will
My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ¡Mi mejor amigo se va de vacaciones que preparamos y pasa tiempo con mi novia en mi casa! ¿Quién en la tierra no estaría celoso?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eso es cierto, y dulce, muestra que te importa mucho sobre mí ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
That's called love
You're too much of a sweet talker
Only with you ❤️
You better 😌
Someone else?
That feels a little cold 😕
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eso se siente un poco frío 😕

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Sorry I didn't mean it that way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Lo siento, no quise decirlo de esa manera.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm good 😊
It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Es más como que necesitas encontrar a alguien más que quiera ir a la isla contigo para que puedas disfrutar del viaje, incluso si no es conmigo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
You're upset?
No
I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Quiero decir, simplemente no esperaba que dijeras algo así.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: ¿Por qué? No lo dije de mala manera.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Lo siento, sé que hice un gran problema de nada.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Es solo que estoy triste de no ir contigo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Pero la próxima vez, tan pronto como me recupere, iremos juntos ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Todavía en la cama, de hecho 🛌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I hope so
Promise
Also
I’m coming over today
Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sasha y yo pospusimos nuestros planes, así que puedo pasar el día contigo 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Realmente no tienes que venir hasta aquí en tu único día libre.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: No quiero que sientas que tienes que

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
But I want to
I miss you
And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Y vendría de todos modos, incluso si intentaras detenerme 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
That really means a lot
See you in half an hour ❤️
5 MINUTES LATER
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardo el conjunto de anoche para mi salida aplazada con Sasha. Los planes cambian, las buenas elecciones se quedan.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardo el conjunto de anoche para mi salida aplazada con Sasha. Los planes cambian, las buenas elecciones se quedan.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And what are you doing?
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Guardo el conjunto de anoche para mi salida aplazada con Sasha. Los planes cambian, las buenas elecciones se quedan.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Va a estar bien. No lo pienses demasiado.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Y si algo sucede, encontraremos una solución juntos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
That’s good
You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: No deberías quedarte solo demasiado tiempo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Pasaré más tarde y ventilaré un poco tu habitación.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It needs fresh air anyway
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: De todos modos, necesita aire fresco.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Thank you
You’re welcome
How is the leg this morning?
It’s okay. Still a little stiff
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Está bien. Aún un poco rígido.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s normal
Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Solo no intentes ser valiente y exagerar.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
I’m alright
Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: El estrés está empezando a afectarme por volver al trabajo, pero lo manejaré.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: No tienes que preocuparte por mí

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you sure?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Haz una partida relajada más tarde, sin sudar en ranked.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Una partida más si quieres. Órdenes del modo doctor.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Avísame si te duele la pierna más tarde.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you actually doing this morning?
Head is still heavy from yesterday
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: La cabeza todavía está pesada de ayer.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I almost called because your replies were slow
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Casi llamé porque tus respuestas eran lentas.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Si esos tipos vuelven a aparecer, juro que les romperé...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Olvídalo, mala idea. Estoy tratando de mantener la calma.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Deja de actuar como si todo fuera un ataque.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Solo preguntaba porque te he visto ir más a menudo últimamente.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Estoy poniéndome en forma y requiere esfuerzo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Y no culpes a la pierna por todo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Sé cómo se ve mi cuerpo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Ahora mismo no puedo hacer ningún deporte.
Necesito que me devuelvas mi cargador de repuesto.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Pero cuando me recupere, volveré a estar en forma.
No la he visto desde el desayuno.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Si la ves, dile que lo quiero de vuelta antes del almuerzo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: En mi libro '{{name:hailey}} me debe una'

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Gracias por lidiar con mi lío de rugby ayer 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Sé que de alguna manera te lo solté como una pequeña amenaza 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Hiciste que sonara como una emergencia en casa.
Era una emergencia en la casa 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: Soy realmente rápido cuando quiero algo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Y ya puedo moverme un poco por mí mismo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Solo no quiero que te esfuerces y te lastimes porque no hay nadie cerca.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Así que pregunta si necesitas algo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Todo está doblado. Te lo daré cuando {{name:lena}} se haya ido

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Además, no lo olvides. Empiezo a trabajar de nuevo mañana.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Así que por la tarde no estaré aquí para ayudarte.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Pero {{name:hailey}} y {{name:mason}} estarán aquí para ayudarme.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: ¿Te hiciste daño cuando viniste a abrir la puerta?
La próxima vez no hagas eso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Llamaré a {{name:hailey}} o {{name:evelyn}} si están allí
Hmm… ten cuidado la próxima vez

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: De todos modos, te estoy enviando las fotos que tomé hoy 📸

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And send me the ones you took 😏
And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Y si lo hiciera... los guardaría para mí 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: No me importa 😤 Mándalos o te maldigo para siempre

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Oh vaya 😳 Tomaste más de lo que pensé

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Eres la chica más hermosa que conozco ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
Thank you for taking care of me today
Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Para… eso son demasiados cumplidos 😅, pero siento lo mismo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Voy a tomar una ducha ahora 🚿
¿Me envías una selfie en la ducha? 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: In the shower? You never stop!
It was the best part of my week
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Fue la mejor parte de mi semana.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Pero en serio, si necesitas agua, comida, o alguien que alcance una estantería porque tu pierna está siendo dramática, solo dilo 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Intenta no abusar del servicio, aunque 😌
No se entiende el abuso del servicio.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: {{name:evelyn}} me dijo que vuelve a trabajar mañana

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Así que si necesitas algo mientras ella está fuera, dijo que tendrás que suplicar por mi ayuda 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Eso suena sorprendentemente poco como algo que {{name:evelyn}} diría.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Ella lo dijo, yo estaba allí 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Está bien, está bien, tal vez ella no dijo nada sobre suplicar 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Wow, how quick of you to turn to the truth
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Vaya, qué rápido has recurrido a la verdad.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Please appreciate how much personal growth this is 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Por favor, aprecia cuánto crecimiento personal es esto 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_10_MASON_EVELYN_FOOD_LEG.translation: Muévete con cuidado para que {{name:evelyn}} deje de preocuparse

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I need to pick an outfit for tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Necesito elegir un atuendo para mañana.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: You look good in all of them
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Te ves bien en todos ellos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I don’t want to look out of place
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: No quiero parecer fuera de lugar.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I feel a little better now
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Me siento un poco mejor ahora.
No te quedes despierto hasta muy tarde.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Yes, see you and good luck
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Sí, nos vemos y buena suerte

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: It’s been so long that I don’t even know what to wear anymore
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Ha pasado tanto tiempo que ni siquiera sé qué ponerme ya.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Just tell me which one makes me look the least ugly
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Solo dime cuál me hace ver menos feo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Show me and I’ll tell you which one looks best
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Muéstrame y te diré cuál se ve mejor.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Talk nicely or I delete the photo 😈
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Habla bonito o borro la foto 😈

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I feel clean and sleepy 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ahora me siento limpio y soñoliento 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But I may have a little gift for you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Pero puede que tenga un pequeño regalo para ti.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I need to see it
You don't even know what it is 😶
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ni siquiera sabes lo que es 😶

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If it's from you it's already perfect
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Si es de ti, ya es perfecto.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And don't show them to anyone
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Y no se los muestres a nadie

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So now I can talk to you until I fall asleep 💤
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Así que ahora puedo hablar contigo hasta que me quede dormido 💤

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Emotional reassurance strengthens trust and intimacy
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: La reafirmación emocional fortalece la confianza y la intimidad.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Playful ambiguity detected, tension may increase attraction
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Se detectó ambigüedad juguetona, la tensión puede aumentar la atracción.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Critical moment detected, distancing may weaken emotional security
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Momento crítico detectado, la distancia puede debilitar la seguridad emocional.
Por supuesto que no lo haré ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That's why I sent them to you

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Así que no me pongas a prueba

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I loved having you here with me
When you're better we should go somewhere together
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Cuando te sientas mejor, deberíamos ir a algún lugar juntos.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We'll do it when you're completely healed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Lo haremos cuando estés completamente curado.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: To make up for the missed trip
She has to go back to work tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ella tiene que volver al trabajo mañana.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: El dinero se está volviendo escaso y la necesitan.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Solo espero que no sea como la última vez.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Y cuando estés mejor, podrás ayudarla.
¿Una foto de buenas noches, por favor?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Me estoy quitando el maquillaje antes de dormir.

story/DAY4/DAY4_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Que tengas un buen día, ¿de acuerdo?
Me estoy preparando para la uni.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Estoy seguro de que ellos sentirán lo mismo, así que no te preocupes.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Hice el desayuno y está listo

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Do you want me to bring it to you?
Are you going to take a shower this morning?
How are you feeling this morning?
The store doesn't want to take her back
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: La tienda no quiere aceptarla de vuelta.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Así que tendremos que soportar su desastre hasta que muramos.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: O encontramos a algún loco que la quiera.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Estaré un poco ocupado esta mañana.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Necesito preparar todo para volver al trabajo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Mi bolsa, mi ropa y algunos documentos.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Así que si necesitas algo, pregúntale a {{name:hailey}} o {{name:mason}}

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Just do what you have to do
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Solo haz lo que tienes que hacer

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Thank you for taking care of me
The same stress as a first day I guess
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: El mismo estrés que un primer día, supongo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: But I'm happy to see my colleagues!
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: ¡Pero estoy feliz de ver a mis colegas!

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: (Soy una mujer adulta, soy una mujer adulta 😌)

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: ( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Suficiente para enterrarte en el jardín 🌸

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Lento está bien, o más bien a tu velocidad normal 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
Random warning 😇
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Verás lo que les sucede a las ranas malas cuando esté completamente curado.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Las amenazas no llegan a mis oídos de princesa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Necesito que {{name:aiden}} o {{name:mason}} me lleven al rugby el miércoles

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Estoy planeando con anticipación porque aparentemente eso es lo que hacen las mujeres maduras 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
How dare you say that 😤
That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Así no es como se supone que debe comportarse un buen mayordomo 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Más como una rana para mí.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Están teniendo una charla de chicas.
No es muy interesante para mí 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Dicen que es el chico más guapo de la uni.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
Still, it's true that he's handsome
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Aún así, es cierto que es guapo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Pero solo te miro, así que no me importa 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Solo te miro a ti también ❤️

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Te dejaré disfrutar del almuerzo con tus amigos.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Como preocuparse un poco el uno por el otro.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: ¿Desde cuándo te importa lo que haga?

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Es difícil tener una conversación contigo sin que te enojes.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Solo desearía que pudiéramos hablar un poco menos agresivamente.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Y que nos cuidemos un poco más.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It was in the living room
So I don't care about you

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Eso no es lo que dije.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Me quedé contigo todo el tiempo en el hospital.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Incluso te llevé a tu cama cuando llegamos a casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Y eso es casi todo sobre el accidente.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Never mind the rest of the year
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: No importa el resto del año

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And thank you again for that
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Y gracias de nuevo por eso.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Solo quiero que hablemos por razones distintas a necesitar algo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: No se trata de salir contigo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want to know you better
And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Y pasar un buen rato contigo a veces

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Entonces {{name:hailey}} lo tomó o el sofá se lo comió

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: ¿Es demasiado difícil para ti enviarme un mensaje por algo que no sean quejas?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Puedo jugar clasificatorias más tarde si te animas.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Sigue riendo, voy a dejar caer 30 esta noche.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Antes de que me critiques, sí, mi cabello se ve estúpido.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Haz tu rehabilitación y deja de intentar ser un héroe.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Puede ponerse ocupado por la tarde.
Eso es todo lo que quiero

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I checked your medication and your food
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Revisé tu medicación y tu comida
Por favor, no te saltes el almuerzo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stress too much okay
It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Todavía se siente un poco extraño volver.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Pareces el tipo de persona que presentaría una queja muy triste desde la cama 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Una muy mala si es realmente tarde, así que apúrate 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Déjame comprar un poco de veneno para ratas de camino a casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: No te mueras de hambre antes de que llegue, señor ratón🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: No te atrevas a burlarte de mí 😒

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Dado que estás roto y no hay nadie en casa

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Voy a volver con un amigo en su lugar.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Lo que significa que tu comida se entregará en tu habitación un poco más tarde de lo planeado 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Dices eso como si estuviera a punto de presentar una queja.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Entonces fui directo a la ducha 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So now you look unfairly pretty?
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: ¿Así que ahora te ves injustamente hermosa?

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Lo suficientemente bonita como para que necesite pruebas con mis propios ojos.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Estoy cansado y ahora me estoy sonrojando.
Mejor una vez que me enviaste un mensaje.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Así que no tienes que preocuparte

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Pero quiero hablar contigo un poco más.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Ve a descansar, lo necesitas después de tu largo día.
Estás demasiado seguro de ti mismo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Pero es verdad, así que eso me molesta aún más 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Solo lo digo porque me importas.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want you in good shape tomorrow
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Quiero que estés en buena forma mañana.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then go sleep if you understand
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Entonces ve a dormir si entiendes.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I made something quick when I got back

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Stopped at the gym on the way back
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Paré en el gimnasio de camino de regreso.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: A couple idiots there tried to waste my time
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Un par de idiotas ahí intentaron hacerme perder el tiempo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Didn't want you wondering where I was
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: No quería que te preguntaras dónde estaba.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: Or maybe he just understood boundaries this time
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: O tal vez esta vez simplemente entendió los límites.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I was a little slow at first
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Estuve un poco lento al principio.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But muscle memory comes back quickly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Pero la memoria muscular regresa rápido.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: And you, how was your day?
I'm going to prepare dinner earlier today, tell me when you're hungry, I will bring it to you directly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Voy a preparar la cena más temprano hoy, dime cuando tengas hambre, te la llevaré directamente.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I had forgotten how exhausting it can be
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Había olvidado lo agotador que puede ser.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But it felt good to be back
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Pero se sintió bien estar de vuelta

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I saw him during the evening

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Él era en realidad muy educado.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Would have been better with you next to me
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Hubiera sido mejor contigo a mi lado.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: And you, eat something this morning
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Y tú, come algo esta mañana.
Te enviaré un mensaje durante el almuerzo 💕

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: So thank you for forcing me to go to bed early 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Así que gracias por obligarme a irme a la cama temprano 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
But yes, this one was good
Better I think, i can move around more

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And how he's going to drag you outside the second you can walk again
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Y cómo te va a arrastrar afuera en cuanto puedas caminar de nuevo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And the girls are drinking his every word 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Y las chicas están bebiendo cada una de sus palabras 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: At this point I think the girls would eat him alive if they could
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: En este momento creo que las chicas lo devorarían vivo si pudieran.
Adivina quién se unió a nosotros

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He just sat down like he owns the table 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Él simplemente se sentó como si fuera el dueño de la mesa 😭
Él está hablando de ti ahora

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm thinking about you a lot today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Estoy pensando en ti mucho hoy.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I could just leave and come lay next to you for ten minutes
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Desearía poder irme y acostarme a tu lado por diez minutos.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Ten minutes would turn into two hours
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Diez minutos se convertirían en dos horas.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Uni is finally over for today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: La uni finalmente ha terminado por hoy.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: And then I would fail everything because of you
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Y entonces fallaría en todo por tu culpa.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Text me if you need anything okay?
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Mándame un mensaje si necesitas algo, ¿de acuerdo?

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I have to go back now
Now I still have work until 14
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ahora todavía tengo trabajo hasta las 14.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Then my part time job until 18 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Entonces mi trabajo a tiempo parcial hasta las 18 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not get used to it
I just want your brain occupied for a bit
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Solo quiero que tu mente esté ocupada un rato.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Send me one word later: alive
Or are you pretending to be productive today?
Liar, but I respect the confidence
Then we do chill games, no screaming
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Entonces hacemos juegos tranquilos, sin gritar.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if you do not feel it, we skip
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Y si no lo sientes, saltamos.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: A girl in class is losing her mind over some guy she barely knows
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Una chica en clase está perdiendo la cabeza por un chico que apenas conoce.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So now everyone is doing that whole crush autopsy 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Así que ahora todos están haciendo esa autopsia de enamoramiento 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I said people like confidence and good timing
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Dije que a la gente le gusta la confianza y el buen momento.
Eso no es un mal consejo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I know, what would your advice be?
Just be yourself, be funny, be kind, be honest, that's probably all
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Solo sé tú mismo, sé divertido, sé amable, sé honesto, eso probablemente sea todo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So all I need is a sparkling personality? 😌
Do you have five minutes or are you pretending to be very important?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: ¿Tienes cinco minutos o estás pretendiendo ser muy importante?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Okay, that's enough emotional labor for your afternoon 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Está bien, eso es suficiente trabajo emocional para tu tarde 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: If you need more help for your monologue, I'm here 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Si necesitas más ayuda para tu monólogo, estoy aquí 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I can make time for the small people
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Puedo hacer tiempo para la gente pequeña.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you fall for people fast or do you act difficult first?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: ¿Te enamoras rápido de las personas o primero actúas difícil?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Why? Are you planning on jumping from the roof onto someone? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: ¿Por qué? ¿Estás planeando saltar del techo sobre alguien? 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Then soda and a few biscuits 😌
Want me to change your clothes and brush your teeth too
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: ¿Quieres que te cambie de ropa y también te cepille los dientes?

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Might grab food too if the line doesn't piss me off
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Quizás también compre comida si la fila no me molesta.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: A drink and whatever is easiest 🙂
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Una bebida y lo que sea más fácil 🙂

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: You asked a guy with one busted leg
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Le preguntaste a un tipo con una pierna rota.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Your leg's hurt, you're not sick, asshole
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Tu pierna está lastimada, no estás enfermo, idiota.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I will pretend i didnt see that
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Haré como si no hubiera visto eso.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I knew keeping you around had value
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Sabía que tenerte cerca tenía valor

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Don't get emotional, you still haven't seen the options yet 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: No te emociones, aún no has visto las opciones 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I have a party on Saturday night
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Tengo una fiesta el sábado por la noche.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: So I may need your opinion on hair tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Así que puede que necesite tu opinión sobre el cabello mañana.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: And if it goes badly, you are legally required to save me
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Y si sale mal, estás legalmente obligado a salvarme.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Or you will have to pay for the damage
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: O tendrás que pagar por los daños.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: How am I saving you from hair?
By telling me when I look insane before I leave the house 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Diciéndome cuando me veo loca antes de salir de casa 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: That seems hard, you will hear me everyday
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Eso parece difícil, me escucharás todos los días.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I'm going to sleep early tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Voy a dormir temprano esta noche.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Then don't stay up for me
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Entonces no te quedes despierto por mí.
Nada que valga la pena mencionar

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: At least you didn't skip dinner
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Al menos no te saltaste la cena.
