story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Si lo hago, {{mason:he}} actuará como si yo hubiera inventado el tráfico 😌.

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: Don't let it go to your head 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Why would I show you my ass ??
It was my back and arm !

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Está bien, está bien, mi culpa.

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: You're not in a rush for just a few days, are you?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: No tienes prisa por solo unos días, ¿verdad?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Any lead on the coach thing?
Did you find someone legit or not?
I need to check a few things first
How am I not gaining muscle when I work out this much? 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: ¿Cómo es que no estoy ganando músculo si entreno tanto? 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Are you showing your back or your ass ??
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: ¿Estás mostrando tu espalda o tu trasero??

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: I might know someone who could help
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Podría conocer a alguien que podría ayudar.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: Just find out if he has something real
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Solo averigua si tiene algo real.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He knows trainers and too many people in general
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Él conoce a entrenadores y a demasiadas personas en general.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He could still point you to someone solid
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Él aún podría señalarte a alguien sólido

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: If he keeps it useful and short
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Si lo mantiene útil y breve
Así que eso no es un no.

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: {{mason:He}} looked annoyed, but I think that's just {{mason:his}} face after dark 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: {{mason:He}} parecía molesto, pero creo que es solo la cara de {{mason:his}} después de anoche 😇.

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: Hero only when I do what you ask?
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: ¿Eres un héroe solo cuando hago lo que pides?

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: So do it more often if you want to rise in my esteem 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: Así que hazlo más a menudo si quieres elevarte en mi estima 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How is the house chaos level tonight?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: ¿Cómo está el nivel de caos en la casa esta noche?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do you really need to ask?
Also I still owe you a clean win in co-op
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: También te debo una victoria limpia en cooperativo.

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: You mean I carry you again?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: ¿Quieres decir que te llevo otra vez?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep talking and I mute your mic
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Sigue hablando y silenciaré tu micrófono.
Mándame un mensaje cuando estés listo.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Tomorrow is the last push before the weekend
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mañana es el último empujón antes del fin de semana.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Do you have anything planned this weekend?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¿Tienes algo planeado para este fin de semana?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You mean drooling on your pillow?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¿Te refieres a babear en tu almohada?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'm really going to break your other leg, by accident of course
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Realmente voy a romperte la otra pierna, por accidente, por supuesto.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yeah, I was waiting for you
I'm showing this text to my lawyer, madame
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Estoy mostrando este texto a mi abogado, señora.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'll just kill you with kisses instead
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Te mataré con besos en su lugar.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You do have some guts, I'll give you that
Now sleep before I change my mind and come annoy you some more
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ahora duerme antes de que cambie de opinión y venga a molestarte un poco más.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Can I at least get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: ¿Puedo al menos recibir una foto de buenas noches?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Only because you waited for me
Wow, harder and harder to fall asleep now
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Vaya, cada vez más difícil dormir ahora.
Lo siento, pero no lo siento 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I didn't want to end the day without hearing from you
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: No quería terminar el día sin saber de ti.
Buenas noches, yo también te amo ❤️

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I thought you said I talk too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Pensé que dijiste que hablo demasiado.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: That's the only thing keeping me alive 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Eso es lo único que me mantiene vivo 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Pretty good, I'm feeling better and better
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Bastante bien, me siento cada vez mejor.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me if you need me
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mándame un mensaje si me necesitas

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: My body already knows it's the end of the week
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mi cuerpo ya sabe que es el fin de la semana.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje cuando pueda.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep okay at least?
But not enough to make me a morning person
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Pero no lo suficiente como para convertirme en una persona matutina.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We need to find a solution
Then tell me what you want me to do
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Entonces dime qué quieres que haga

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a stable route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se ha detectado una elección de compromiso, tu respuesta bloqueará permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} en una ruta estable.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a shared tension route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se ha detectado una elección de compromiso, tu respuesta bloqueará permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} en una ruta de tensión compartida.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a high risk route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se ha detectado una elección de compromiso, tu respuesta bloqueará permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} en una ruta de alto riesgo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We find a safer plan together
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Encontramos un plan más seguro juntos.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will find a job, something I can do from home
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Encontraré un trabajo, algo que pueda hacer desde casa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You should not do that alone
You do not need to suffer there
If I bribe him a little he should find me something quickly
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Si le soborno un poco, debería encontrarme algo rápidamente.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I did not answer because it was too late
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: No respondí porque era demasiado tarde.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I will take care of you even more
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Pero me ocuparé de ti aún más.
Se está volviendo más difícil allí.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Give me one or two days and I will find something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Dame uno o dos días y encontraré algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: In the meantime, just say you are sick
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mientras tanto, solo di que estás enfermo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I do not want you to carry everything
My manager is making it difficult for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mi gerente me lo está poniendo difícil.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: A few days will not kill us
We are not that poor yet
I still have the money I saved for the trip
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Todavía tengo el dinero que ahorré para el viaje.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will use it if we need to
But I do not think we will
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Pero no creo que lo hagamos.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just need the right opportunity
Then I will not go back tonight
But tell me quickly when you find something for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Pero dime rápido cuando encuentres algo para mí.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just have to bear with him
I know it is not the best
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Sé que no es lo mejor

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I cannot help you yet
As soon as I can walk again I will work
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Tan pronto como pueda volver a caminar, trabajaré.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: And you will be able to leave
I am sorry you have to endure him
If he gets too annoying just kick him in the balls
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Si se vuelve demasiado molesto, solo pégale en los huevos.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: He watches me like I owe him something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Me mira como si le debiera algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I also hate feeling like a burden to you
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Pero también odio sentirme como una carga para ti.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: If I find a few options, you might be forced to give your opinion later 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Si encuentro algunas opciones, es posible que te veas obligado a dar tu opinión más tarde 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Too bad it wasn't a question 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Qué pena que no fue una pregunta 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Better than yesterday and the day before
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Mejor que ayer y el día anterior

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Finally my room is going to get cleaned 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Finalmente mi habitación va a ser limpiada 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: You're so sweet in the morning
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Eres tan dulce por la mañana.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I might go shopping this afternoon
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Puede que vaya de compras esta tarde.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I need to find an evening outfit for Saturday night
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Necesito encontrar un atuendo de noche para el sábado por la noche.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: So this is a fashion emergency?
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: ¿Así que esto es una emergencia de moda?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: But still, how dare he try to steal my job and brag about it
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Pero aún así, ¿cómo se atreve a intentar robarme mi trabajo y presumir de ello?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I'm going to break his leg too
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Voy a romperle la pierna también.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I get it but that's not a good idea
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Lo entiendo, pero no es una buena idea.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He'd make you nurse him too
He won't even know how close to death he was
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ni siquiera sabrá lo cerca que estuvo de la muerte.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I have to go back now
I'm going straight to work after this
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Voy directo al trabajo después de esto.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I guess he feels lonely without you
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Supongo que se siente solo sin ti.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: So now I have to put up with him instead
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Así que ahora tengo que aguantarlo a él en su lugar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He's telling everyone he's your nurse now
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Él le está diciendo a todos que ahora es tu enfermero.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I never say no to gaming
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Nunca digo que no a jugar.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Except when I kick your ass
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Excepto cuando te pateo el trasero.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: My setup is finally clean for once
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: ¡Mi configuración está finalmente limpia por una vez!

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not zoom in, my cable management is still criminal
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: No acerques, mi gestión de cables sigue siendo criminal.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: That is a generous lie but I'll take it
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Esa es una mentira generosa, pero la aceptaré.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you doing right now?

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: If you need something else, ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} before they leave
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Si necesitas algo más, pregúntale a {{name:hailey}} o {{name:evelyn}} antes de que se vayan
Apúrate antes de que {{name:hailey}} llegue primero
{{name:evelyn}} dijo que te ibas a olvidar

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: Just enough to text you once 🙄
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Suficiente para enviarte un mensaje una vez 🙄
Mira lo amable que me he vuelto.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: For a moment you did sound like an adult 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Por un momento sonaste como un adulto 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Help me or I set your PC on fire 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Ayúdame o prenderé fuego a tu PC 😇
Está bien, está bien, te ayudaré.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tell me which one suits me best 😌
All of them look good on you 😌
So you admit I'm already a femme fatale 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Así que admites que ya soy una femme fatale 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: One look is cute and safe, one is a little bolder, and one makes me look like I'm pretending to be older than I am
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Una mirada es linda y segura, una es un poco más atrevida, y una me hace parecer que estoy pretendiendo ser mayor de lo que soy.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: I'm keeping your answer in mind 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Estoy teniendo en cuenta tu respuesta 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tomorrow's party is supposed to be fun, but suddenly it feels like everything means something
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: La fiesta de mañana se supone que será divertida, pero de repente siento que todo significa algo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.translation: No hay descanso para mí hoy

story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.source: Text me if anything feels off
story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.translation: Mándame un mensaje si algo se siente raro.

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It has been tense again today
story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ha estado tenso de nuevo hoy.

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: So I want to be there early
story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Así que quiero estar allí temprano.

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I will text when I can

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: At least today was my last day before the weekend
story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.translation: Al menos hoy fue mi último día antes del fin de semana.

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: Take a shower, eat, all that

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Spanish.
Termino el trabajo alrededor de las 6.

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: Want to play when I get home?
Alright, come get your ass kicked when you get home 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Está bien, ven a que te den una paliza cuando llegues a casa 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: And don't blame me if you cry after
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Y no me culpes si lloras después.

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: You really want to spend your life in a wheelchair?
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: ¿De verdad quieres pasar tu vida en una silla de ruedas?

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: I just want to give you the real version, not the rushed one
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Solo quiero darte la versión real, no la apresurada.
Así que espera un poco más

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: It should be ready later tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: Debería estar listo más tarde esta noche.

story/DAY8/DAY8_11_ONLYFUN_POST_EVELYN_2.source: Touching reunion with an old friend
story/DAY8/DAY8_11_ONLYFUN_POST_EVELYN_2.translation: Reencuentro emotivo con un viejo amigo

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Okay, real problem 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Está bien, problema real 😭

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: You're being dramatic
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: Estás siendo dramático.

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'm trying to cope 😇
