story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Actualización desde la oficina en casa 😮‍💨

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Tenía miedo de cómo se sentirían las cosas entre nosotros.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Pero creo que lo manejamos bien.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Y seguí pensando en lo que dijiste esta mañana.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: También me cambié a una de tus camisetas.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Eso se siente ilegal cuando no estoy allí.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
What a lucky man I am
And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Y soy una chica realmente afortunada de tenerte ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Voy a lavarme la cara y meterme en la cama antes de que empiece a extrañarte demasiado.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Y acuéstate mirando al techo por un rato.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Solo quería informarte que lo manejé yo mismo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Voy a volver a ese gimnasio en mis propios términos.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Si vuelven a molestarme, podemos resolverlo afuera 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Pero también podrías pedir que los echen del gimnasio.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Uno de ellos es el dueño del lugar.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Despierta 😭
Sí

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Dijo que puedo quedarme después de clase y revisará la tarea conmigo
Como una verdadera estudiante en emergencia 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Probablemente esa sea la forma más rápida de que aprendas
Lo sé
Esa es la parte molesta
Sonaba tranquilo al respecto

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Como si no estuviera condenada, solo mal organizada
Eso suena preciso 😇
Grosero pero preciso 😌
Pequeña crisis académica
También hay fiesta esta noche

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu elección de outfit sigue bajo investigación
¿Incluso con el modo de rescate del profesor?
Especialmente con el modo de rescate del profesor

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Si tengo que sufrir académicamente, ¡merezo lucir increíble después!

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Te actualizaré después de su sesión de ayuda 😇
En realidad, crisis académica mediana
La tarea sigue siendo un desastre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Mándala más tarde y la revisaré
Ese era el plan

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero la escuela ya respondió sobre las clases particulares

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Quieren que esté con mi profesor principal
Empieza mañana 😭
¿Ya?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mañana

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nuevos trajes o algo así

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Siento que será algo estúpido y no quiero cambiar de atuendo de todos modos.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Qué debo hacer si él me presiona con eso?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu respuesta aquí puede tener efecto en un futuro cercano

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Espera a ver los atuendos, luego háblale si no te gustan.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Confía en él, aunque sea molesto, ¿no maneja bien el bar?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si no está bien, díselo con calma y establece un límite.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Así que no me niego antes de saber qué es.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactamente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Buenos días, ¿cómo te fue en el bar anoche?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tienes razón, tal vez estoy haciendo un gran alboroto por nada.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Intenta confiar en él en el ámbito laboral.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es molesto, pero el bar sigue funcionando, así que está haciendo algo bien.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿De verdad lo crees?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo mantén la calma y no asumas lo peor demasiado pronto.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Intentaré darle el beneficio de la duda.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Estuvo bien

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: De cualquier manera, no te preocupes tanto por él, solo trabaja normalmente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Diviértete con tus colegas también

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y mándame un mensaje en cuanto algo se sienta mal

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo haré

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias por estar de mi lado.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es normal, no te preocupes.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mantuve la cabeza agachada y hice mi trabajo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero el gerente observaba todo como un halcón, dejaba de molestar.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va a estar bien

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo tienes que soportarlo un poco y te dejará en paz.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, tienes razón.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Al menos disfruto trabajar con mis colegas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh, además, ese bastardo dijo que podría traer nuevas reglas de código de vestimenta pronto.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Pero supongo que necesitaba la verdad

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eso no significa que se sintiera bien.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
It's not that I don't want you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: No es que no te quiera.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Es solo que en este momento no estoy listo para eso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Solo necesito un poco de tiempo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I really didn't want to hurt you
I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Voy a limpiar un poco y trabajar desde casa por un rato.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje más tarde.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Y... gracias por ser honesto anoche.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu habitación finalmente perdió la batalla

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Finally ! I always had hope in you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¡Por fin! Siempre tuve fe en ti

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
Hurry up and clean your room
Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di eso de nuevo y te voy a meter en la bolsa de donaciones

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} encontró una caja debajo de mi cama y me dio la mirada de madre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi abogado dijo que debería quedarme en silencio

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora tengo que irme antes de que encuentre más pruebas 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} decidió que hoy es guerra contra el polvo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: We are doing a huge cleaning session
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estamos haciendo una gran sesión de limpieza

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Mayormente no es un término médico.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Especialmente cuando actúas como si estuvieras bien

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Simplemente no confío en tus instintos de supervivencia.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Solo tómalo con calma hasta que termine.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Está bien, mi descanso casi ha terminado.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Necesito volver a actuar de manera útil.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje después de mi turno 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: No está mal, solo lo suficiente para que el tiempo se sienta lento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Básicamente estoy viviendo mi sueño en este momento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Entonces probablemente romperías el otro también 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm about to leave for the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Estoy a punto de irme al gym

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Cuanto antes me vaya, antes se acaba

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sigo sintiéndome mal por no poder ayudar realmente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
You'll run over there on one leg?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: ¿Vas a correr allá con una pierna?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buenas noticias, no trabajo esta noche ni mañana por la noche

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo concéntrate en recuperarte, eso es lo más importante ahora mismo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gracias por todo lo que haces.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo siento por ser una carga en este momento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: No digas eso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: No eres una carga.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y nada de esto es tu culpa.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo necesitas tiempo para recuperarte, eso es todo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Después de la cena de esta noche, podemos pasar un rato juntos si quieres 😊.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me encantaría eso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces haremos eso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Así que finalmente tendré algo de tiempo libre.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Creo que lo aprovecharé para limpiar la casa y lavar la ropa

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Tienes algo que necesite lavarse también?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, tengo algunas cosas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Pero estás segura de que no necesitas ayuda?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, no te preocupes.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Necesitas descansar hasta que estés completamente recuperada.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Estás segura?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sí, sé que quieres ayudar, pero puedo manejar esto.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Puede que llegue un poco tarde.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for setting everything up
Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Tómate tu tiempo, no empiezo sin ti 😊.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:mason}} está usando el baño ahora mismo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ni siquiera puedo cepillarme los dientes todavía.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Preparé la película y las palomitas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahora solo me faltan tú y {{name:mason}}

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
And yet you keep talking to me
I'll come out when I'm done
Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Porque has estado ahí por una eternidad

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: No necesitas cuarenta minutos para cepillarte los dientes

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: No me quedaré hasta muy tarde

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: También sí, hice la hoja de trabajo antes de irme

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: El profesor probablemente materializaría de las sombras si lo saltara

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero la fiesta es en realidad en la casa del hijo del director 😭
Versión oficial de la fiesta en camino

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo me dio un pequeño saludo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Pero ahora me siento extrañamente tímida por el atuendo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Porque no planeaba que me viera vestida así

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Deja de lucir tan satisfecho a través del teléfono

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Dijo que me veo más madura de lo habitual y ahora estoy culpando a ambos 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi profesor también dijo que estaba bonito, lo cual fue extrañamente estresante 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Lindo y seguro, justo como lo pediste

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Por favor, di que parezco una estudiante responsable que definitivamente estudia 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Vi a un montón de gente que no había visto en siglos

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Así que ahora mi batería social está completamente muerta

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Hablé un poco con mi profesor

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Me preguntó si estaba disfrutando de la fiesta y dijo que el atuendo me quedaba bien
Lo cual fue un poco estresante, en realidad

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: No esperaba encontrarme con él allí

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Pero siento que estoy mejorando en eso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Lo hace un poco más valioso.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: ¿Puedo verte antes de que te vayas a la cama?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Voy a ducharme y a acostarme.
Las mismas cosas una y otra vez

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Ven a jugar conmigo para que pueda darte una paliza.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Tu entrenador debería enviarme un mensaje durante el día si todo está bien.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
Or is it because you have no one? 😒
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: ¿O es porque no tienes a nadie? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena demasiado dramático para ayuda con tareas 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Si esto salva mis calificaciones y me mantiene fuera de la humillación escolar, entonces te debo una 😇

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Así que tu plan de {{name:tutor}} se está volviendo real

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Todavía no puedo creer que realmente necesite ayuda así de mal 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero tener a alguien en casa o en línea ya suena mucho menos horrible que quedarme después de clase con los profesores

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: A veces es hacer mucho trabajo ahí 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Realmente encontraste a alguien serio o solo estás improvisando con confianza otra vez?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
Your future is safe with me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu futuro está a salvo conmigo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey, ¿estás despierta?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I want to help
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quiero ayudar.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No eres inútil, tú eres quien mantiene todo funcionando aquí.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Además, estoy buscando algo que podamos hacer juntos.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Puede que tenga una pista.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero quiero verificarlo antes de comprometerte a algo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Qué tipo de trabajo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Is it safe?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Es seguro?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And is it legal?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Y es legal?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, claro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Principalmente es programar y conocer gente en público

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mañana, sí, me desperté hace unos minutos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sin bar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sin noches largas impuestas por un gerente

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Conocer gente?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Para qué?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Passive Insight dice que la forma en que enmarques tu próxima respuesta puede cambiar su reacción

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es como ser un amigo por un día, te pagan por tu tiempo y compañía

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Básicamente son citas pagadas, pero con reglas estrictas y solo en lugares públicos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Eso suena extraño

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿La gente paga solo por hablar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Algunas personas se sienten muy solas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Cómo te sientes hoy?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quieren compañía sin presión

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y tú eres buena haciendo que la gente se sienta segura

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y quién sabe, tal vez encuentres a alguien que te guste

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Te cuidaste de nosotros por mucho tiempo, es hora de que vivas tu vida también

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ya estoy muy grande para eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No, no lo estás, eres hermosa y aún joven, solo date una oportunidad

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hmm... lo pensaré

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Paid dates?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: ¿Citas pagadas?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mejor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That is not really my world
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ese no es realmente mi mundo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No significa que le debas nada a nadie, es más como actuar por un día

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es tiempo y conversación

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It pays really well
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Se paga muy bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y establecemos límites antes de que aceptes a cualquier cliente, así que no hay riesgo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y quién sabe, tal vez encuentres a alguien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Te cuidaste de nosotros por mucho tiempo, es hora de que vivas tu vida también

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ya estoy muy grande para eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No, no lo estás, eres hermosa, solo date una oportunidad

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo pensaré

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I still feel guilty
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero aún me siento culpable

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero no me gusta la idea de ser juzgada

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nadie te juzgará

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Y no estarás sola en esto, yo revisaré todo, hablaré con el cliente y te cuidaré todo el día

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Por ahora verificaré la plataforma y las reglas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si algo se siente mal, lo dejamos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Puedo intentarlo y si no me gusta, paro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Claro, de todos modos solo tienes una obligación de una semana

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Me quedé en casa como dijiste, pero siento que decepcioné a mis colegas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien, ¿cuándo empiezo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Te escribiré en cuanto sepa más

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Está bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Gracias por cuidarme y encontrarme trabajo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Es normal, ve a descansar un poco, te mereces tu día libre

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No te sientas culpable, trabajar allí no era bueno para ti de todos modos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Te dije que me encargaría del trabajo, y para tus compañeros está bien, aún puedes verlos fuera del trabajo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sí, eso es cierto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I do not want to be useless
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pero no quiero ser inútil

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Pero me alegra que me lo dijeras en lugar de ocultarlo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Solo creo que necesito un poco de tiempo ahora.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Para entender dónde estoy en todo esto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: No porque piense que me amas menos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Más porque no esperaba que las cosas se sintieran así.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Y no tienes que forzar nada por mí.
Por eso no estoy en pánico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Porque esto realmente es importante para mí

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Entonces dame un poco de tiempo para averiguar cómo me siento acerca de todo esto.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Tómate todo el tiempo que necesites

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Eso ayuda más de lo que piensas 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Voy a limpiar un poco y trabajar desde casa un rato.
Te enviaré un mensaje más tarde 💕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Todavía un poco nublado pero mejor 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Y... gracias por ser honesto conmigo anoche.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pasé por una tienda de ropa después de clase

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Sabes lo difícil que fue no entrar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dices eso como si fuera una verdadera lucha

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu adicción a las compras necesita tratamiento profesional

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al menos mi ropa se ve bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Intentando disfrutar de una tarde tranquila

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I should have an answer sometime today
I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te avisaré tan pronto como tenga noticias

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por favor, no contrates a un genio aterrador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Hola

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eso suena como exactamente lo que ella necesita

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Normalmente empiezo identificando las materias que más problemas causan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Luego creamos un plan de estudio y lo vamos siguiendo paso a paso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ella puede hacerlo bien, pero...

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: A veces le cuesta mantenerse motivada

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Eso es muy común

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: La mayoría de los estudiantes son más capaces de lo que piensan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Solo necesitan estructura y consistencia

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: ¿Cuándo estarías disponible?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Mañana por la tarde me viene bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Soy Ethan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Puedo pasar, conocerla y evaluar en qué punto está

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfecto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Se lo haré saber

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Genial

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: No dudes en escribirme si tienes alguna pregunta antes de eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Recibí tu solicitud de tutoría más temprano hoy

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Gracias por ponerte en contacto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Busco a alguien que pueda ayudar a {{name:hailey}} a prepararse para sus exámenes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: ¿Con qué tipo de estudiantes sueles trabajar?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Principalmente trabajo con estudiantes de secundaria y universidad

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfecto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Y mi objetivo no es solo explicar lecciones

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: También ayudo a los estudiantes a construir hábitos de estudio y mantenerse enfocados

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: El chico claramente sabe lo que hace

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: De hecho, tiene un cuerpo increíble

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Well that actually makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Bueno, eso me hace sentir un poco mejor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: At least I already know him
And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Y sé que no es un extraño raro que encontraste en línea

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Realmente no tienes fe en mí

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Querías mantener su nombre como sorpresa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sigo siendo más agradecido de lo que mereces 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dile a {{name:aiden}} que estoy lista cuando él lo esté

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Es un entrenador joven que acaba de mudarse a la ciudad

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: ¿De verdad ha entrenado a alguien antes?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And where did you even find him?
He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Solía ser uno de los entrenadores de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ok, eso suena mucho menos sospechoso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Si entrenó a {{name:aiden}}, probablemente sabe lo que hace

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Tengo curiosidad por ver lo que puede hacer

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dile a Chris que estoy lista cuando él lo esté

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Mayormente no es un término médico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Especialmente cuando pretendes que estás bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: No confías en mí en absoluto.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Simplemente no confío en tus instintos de supervivencia.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Por favor, tómalo con calma hasta que termine.
Está bien, el descanso casi ha terminado.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Te enviaré un mensaje después de mi turno 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: No está mal, solo lo suficiente para que el tiempo se mueva lentamente.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Básicamente estoy viviendo mi sueño en este momento.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oye, ¿estás realmente segura de que podré hacer ese trabajo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero no puedo evitar preocuparme un poco por eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es perfectamente normal, es un gran cambio después de todo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pero estoy segura de que lo harás genial

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora mismo solo me estoy asegurando de que todo sea legítimo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quiero verificar todos los detalles antes de decirte que empieces

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso me hace sentir un poco mejor

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente debería tener todas las respuestas mañana

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si todo está en orden, podrás comenzar después de eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Ya mañana?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es más pronto de lo que esperaba

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Por supuesto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Te explicaré todo con más detalle mañana

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ahora tienes mi atención

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo curiosidad por saber qué encontraste

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y tal vez un poco nerviosa también

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso es perfectamente normal

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo tomaremos un paso a la vez

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Está bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entonces esperaré tu mensaje más tarde 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: ¿Por qué preguntas?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porque sigo pensando en ello

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: No soy tan inteligente y no tengo mucha experiencia en esas cosas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y me pregunto si realmente seré lo suficientemente bueno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eso no es cierto, eres más capaz de lo que piensas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Y aunque no tengas experiencia, puedes aprender

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Estaré ahí para ayudarte con todo lo que necesites

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sé, y realmente lo aprecio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey 😊 la cena está casi lista

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
I made steak and french fries
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Hice carne asada y papas fritas

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I know how much you love that
Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ahora estoy aún más motivado para bajar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Te veré en un minuto entonces

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Debería obligarme a moverme un poco

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Hey, imagina lo injusto que va a ser esto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Ten cuidado o cancelar tu entrenador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Gracias por tomarte el tiempo de buscar a alguien y encontrarme un entrenador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Es una cosa menos de la que tengo que preocuparme

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Que tú te ocupes de algo por tu cuenta habría sido un milagro de todos modos

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Voy a conseguir un cuerpo de ensueño mientras tú estás atrapado en la cama con tu cuerpo roto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Un cuerpo de ensueño no va a arreglar tu cara
Pero la cara sigue siendo mala

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: La envidia no te queda bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Tampoco te quedará todo ese músculo cuando sigas perdiendo contra mí en todo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Esperaba que te olvidaras de eso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Él quiere ver en qué punto estás y qué necesita trabajo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Él va a descubrir lo perdida que estás 😔

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: You're enjoying this way too much
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Te estás divirtiendo demasiado con esto
Vale, mañana el profe particular y esta noche la fiesta 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Intentaré causar una buena primera impresión mañana 😊
Eso es todo lo que pido

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ya voy a la fiesta con las chicas. Buenas noches, entrenador

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Pásalo bien en la fiesta y vuelve a casa con cuidado

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked to him this afternoon
And he knows how to work with students preparing for exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Y sabe cómo trabajar con estudiantes que se preparan para exámenes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: ¿Así que estás diciendo que mi misión de rescate académico está oficialmente en marcha? 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Pero siento que estoy mejorando en eso.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Lo hace un poco más valioso.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: ¿Puedo verte antes de que te vayas a la cama?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Voy a ducharme y a acostarme.
Las mismas cosas una y otra vez

ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.source: Laurent runs his own consulting firm and spends most of his time working. He values discretion, easy conversation, and a quiet hour without expectations.
ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.translation: Laurent tiene su propia firma de consultoría y pasa la mayor parte del tiempo trabajando. Valora la discreción, la conversación amena y una hora tranquila sin expectativas.

ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.translation: Laurent tiene su propia firma de consultoría y valora la discreción. Prefiere reuniones tranquilas, buen café y mujeres que entiendan los límites.

ui.auto.lucas_is_confident_without_rushi.translation: Lucas es seguro sin apresurarse. Disfruta de planes bien elaborados, generosidad tranquila y citas que se sienten elegidas en lugar de improvisadas.

ui.auto.lucas_likes_planned_full_day_out.translation: A Lucas le gustan las salidas planificadas de todo el día y el juego de roles afectuosos como pareja. Es directo sobre las expectativas y acepta preguntar antes de cualquier contacto físico.

ui.auto.lucas_likes_planned_full_day_out.translation: A Lucas le gustan las salidas planificadas de todo el día, buenos restaurantes y mostrarle a alguien una versión pulida de la ciudad.
